title: Account Executive Accounting - France 🇫🇷
descriptionHtml:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot,based on 60,000 reviews. Our cultureputs customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 byAlexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.


Join us as an Account Executive Accounting to help newly onboarded Qonto clients get their accounting right from day one. You'll be part of a strategic new positioning of Qonto, owning the full sales cycle yourself from first call to signed contract. Astrid Liska, our Sales Lead Accounting, will guide and mentor you closely every step of the way.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Engage clients right when it matters: You'll reach out to newly onboarded business creators within days of account creation and guide them to the right offer.

  • Stay on it when others give up: You’ll stay proactive with accounts that go quiet, following up thoughtfully and creating more opportunities to keep the conversation going.

  • Use a soft-selling approach: You'll diagnose each client's accounting needs and handle competitive and objection-based negotiation with confidence.

  • Close the deal: You’ll own the deal end to end, from the initial conversation through to the signed contract.

  • Use AI to work smarter: You'll lean on AI tools to prep calls, personalize outreach, and speed up qualification.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • You've closed before: At least 1 year of full-time sales experience (CDI), with closing experience and ownership of at least one full sales cycle from end to end. A strong closing rate is a plus.

  • You are fluent in French and English : Both are mandatory languages to master, with a minimum proficiency of C2 in French and C1+ in English.

  • You're comfortable on the phone: You reach out with confidence and build trust fast and bring a consultative mindset to every call.

  • You thrive in an early-stage environment: You're comfortable with processes that are still being created, like to give feedback and you adapt fast when things change.

  • You don't quit: You keep going on unresponsive accounts without losing energy or tact.

  • You're AI-fluent: You use AI tools naturally to sharpen outreach, prep, and follow-up.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A brand-new team with real stakes: You'll help build one of Qonto's strategic priorities for 2027, from the ground up. You'll help shape a new path at Qonto and experience its early stages firsthand.

  • A space to try, learn and build: You'll have the autonomy to test ideas and help establish the ways of working that will set this new team up for success.

  • Growth you earn: Challenge yourself, grow through your achievements, and see your impact translate into real growth at Qonto.

  • Qonto's sales school: Hands-on coaching and transferable skills that open doors and are a real launchpad.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Astrid Liska, Sales Lead Accounting. Before Qonto, she built her sales career at Qobra and PayFit France, and she's the one who built Qonto's Regate SDR team from scratch. She's now taking on the same build-from-zero challenge with this new accounting team.

Having evolved from an SDR to an Account Executive and Key Account Manager before stepping into leadership, she has mastered every stage of the sales cycle and understands exactly what it takes to perform and grow in this environment.

Astrid is dedicated to building a collaborative and high-performing team. She uses her diverse experience to provide concrete mentorship, helping you sharpen your skills and navigate complex sales challenges to reach your full potential.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

title: Account Executive, Affiliate Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Position: Account Specialist, Affiliate Marketing  

The Account Specialist position is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel may be required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and other events. Please note: This role requires fluency in both German and English.

The Role:  

As an Account Specialist, you will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs. The ideal candidate will have 1-2 years of work experience. Affiliate marketing experience is not required. You will manage affiliate communications, reporting, and general account maintenance, including recruitment, newsletters, fraud checks, and data analysis. You’ll work closely with your manager and peers to maximize program effectiveness and create opportunities for growth. Duties are performed across one or more assigned client accounts, which will vary over time.

Top 5 Responsibilities:  

  • Account & Client Communication  
    Build and maintain client and affiliate communications, including creative newsletters and updates about promotions, program developments, and general client information. Develop relationships with clients and partners to understand their goals and objectives, providing clear and proactive communication across channels.  
  • Reporting & Data Management  
    Utilize Excel (pivot tables, v-lookups, etc.) to produce detailed reports, track performance, and analyze data for insights and trends. Summarize findings and provide actionable recommendations to optimize program performance. Proactively track key metrics and report on campaign performance.  
  • Strategy Execution & Task Ownership  
    Own and manage client tasks with minimal supervision, ensuring deadlines are met and tasks are completed accurately. Prioritize tasks effectively, flagging any potential delays and keeping the team informed. Consistently leverage tools and client tracking platforms to support program goals.  
  • Program & Portfolio Management  
    Manage multiple affiliate campaigns, maintaining a balanced focus across each, and organizing tasks by priority. Identify areas for process improvement, and provide proactive support to peers and clients. Manage risks, track fraud, and ensure compliance with program terms and conditions.  
  • Team Collaboration & Growth  
    Collaborate with peers and management to contribute ideas for process improvements and training. Serve as a resource for peers and help drive continuous improvement across the team, sharing best practices and insights.  

What Success Looks Like:  

By 6 Months:  

  • You will be proficient in the day-to-day operations of multiple affiliate programs, including managing reporting, affiliate applications, recruitment, and creative asset deployment.  
  • You will regularly present new campaign ideas to managers and demonstrate a clear understanding of program performance, ensuring regular fraud checks and compliance.  
  • You will have developed strong relationships with clients and affiliates and will be able to execute tasks with minimal guidance.  

By 1 Year:  

  • You will troubleshoot and resolve account and affiliate issues independently, providing valuable insights and actionable recommendations to clients and internal teams.  
  • You will be an integral part of each program, developing new ideas and improving processes to create efficiencies.  
  • You will take on new account responsibilities with support from your manager and serve as a thought leader within the team, contributing to relationship-building and firm development.  

Qualities of the Ideal Candidate  

  • Strong sense of curiosity  
  • Critical thinker  
  • Confident and comfortable being uncomfortable  
  • Flexible, resilient, coachable  
  • Relationship and service oriented  
  • Proactive and outcome oriented  
  • Strong work ethic and personal standards  

Qualifications & Skills:  

  • Fluency in German
  • 1-2 years of experience- background in online marketing, e-commerce, or affiliate marketing beneficial.  
  • Familiarity with affiliate networks and SaaS platforms (e.g., ShareASale, Commission Junction, Impact) is a plus.  
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.  
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (v-lookups, pivot tables, formatting, etc.).  
  • Knowledge of HTML is a plus.  
  • Ability to travel when necessary for conferences and team meetings.  

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?  

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content and B2B partnership marketing.   

AP Perks & Benefits - What we offer  

  • 100% remote work for everyone  
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off  
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December  
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off  
  • Focus Fridays (no internal meetings)  
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits  
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowance  
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!  
  • Target salary range: £27–37K depending on location and experience  

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.  

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual's age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

title: Account Executive, Commercial Accounts
descriptionHtml:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

Über die Position

Als Account Executive Commercial bist du dafür verantwortlich, in deinem zugewiesenen Markt Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im öffentlichen Sektort zu entwickeln und erfolgreich abzuschließen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Partnervertrieb. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Identifikation, Entwicklung und Beschleunigung von Vertriebschancen gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sowie auf der erfolgreichen Realisierung von Abschlüssen und Up- und Cross-Selling-Potenzialen.

Standort: Raum Frankfurt oder Raum Hamburg

Dein Tätigkeitsfeld

  • Entwicklung und erfolgreicher Abschluss von Geschäftsmöglichkeiten mit definierten Kunden
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Vertriebsabschlüssen bei deren Endkunden
  • Aktive Neukundenansprache, einschließlich Kaltakquise, zur Entwicklung von Vertriebsaktivitäten mit einer Vielzahl neuer Endkunden im Mid-Market- und gehobenen Kundensegment
  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Up-Selling- und Cross-Selling-Potenzialen innerhalb des bestehenden Kundenstamms
  • Pflege von Forecasts sowie Account- und Opportunity-Informationen in Salesforce
  • Vorschlag, Koordination und Teilnahme an Marketingaktivitäten im definierten Vertriebsgebiet

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung im direkten Vertrieb und in der Neukundengewinnung
  • Erfahrung mit Anbietern aus den Bereichen Virtualisierung, Cloud und SaaS ist von Vorteil
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb über Partnerkanäle sowie im Direktvertrieb
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge im Vertrieb an IT-Infrastruktur-Spezialisten
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, neue Vertriebschancen zu entwickeln
  • Eigeninitiative sowie die Fähigkeit, sich schnell in neue Themen einzuarbeiten
  • Hohe Motivation, Energie und Abschlussorientierung im Vertrieb
  • Freude an einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten schnell verändern können
  • Reisebereitschaft von mindestens 50 %
  • Gültiger Führerschein der Klasse B
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Unsere Benefits:

  • Umfassende finanzielle Absicherung – Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Lebensversicherung und Unfallversicherung zum Schutz für Sie und Ihre Familie
  • Großzügige Auszeiten – 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr sowie unternehmensweite VeeaMe Days für Erholung, Wohlbefinden und Self-Care
  • Unterstützung für Wohlbefinden und mentale Gesundheit – Zugang zu vertraulicher Beratung und professionellen Unterstützungsangeboten im Rahmen unseres Employee Assistance Program für Mitarbeitende und deren Familien
  • Engagement über den Arbeitsplatz hinaus – Bezahlte Freistellung für ehrenamtliches Engagement im Rahmen des Veeam Cares Programms
  • Gesundheits- und Wellnessleistungen – Angebote zur Unterstützung Ihrer Gesundheit und Ihres Wohlbefindens, damit Sie beruflich und privat erfolgreich sein können
  • Weitere Lifestyle-Vorteile – Zusätzliche Benefits und mitarbeiterfreundliche Angebote, die Ihr Wohlbefinden im Alltag unterstützen

Please note: If an applicant is permanently located outside of Germany, Veeam reserves the right to decline the application for this position. #LI-CA1 #LI-REMOTE

title: Account Executive - Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Le compte professionnel représente un enjeu central dans la stratégie de Pennylane :

  • Pour ses clients : Assurer le meilleur service possible en intégrant le compte professionnel directement dans leur outil de gestion/compta, assurant la possibilité de gérer l’entièreté de leur activité depuis 1 seul et même outil : Pennylane

  • Pour Pennylane : Faire grossir la part des Financial Services dans le revenu global de Pennylane.

C’est pourquoi nous créons une équipe dédiée sur ce périmètre.

🛣️ Mission et objectifs

👀 Vision

  • Transformer tous les utilisateurs en utilisateurs du compte pro Pennylane,

  • Faire des financial services un des principaux leviers de croissance de Pennylane.

Objectifs 2026

  • Part des Financial Services dans le revenu de Pennylane : x2,3

  • Nombre d’utilisateur de notre compte pro intégré ⇒ x1,9

2027

  • Part des Financial Services dans le revenu de Pennylane ⇒ x2 vs 2026

  • Nombre d’utilisateur de notre compte pro intégré ⇒ x2,3

2030 → Faire des financial services un des principaux leviers de croissance de Pennylane.

🫡 Mission

L’équipe AE Financial Services - SME a pour mission de transformer les TPEs (0-9 employés) clientes de Pennylane, en titulaires et utilisatrices d’un Compte Professionnel intégré à leur outil, leur permettant de gérer depuis Pennylane leurs achats (paiements fournisseurs, notes de frais, cartes bancaires, dépenses online) et vente (réception des paiements clients).

🎯 Objectif

L’équipe est objectivée sur le nombre de compte professionnels ouverts.

🖼️ Périmètre et responsabilités

Sales

Responsable de l’entièreté du cycle de vente

  • Identification des clients prioritaires ;

  • Contacting ;

  • Qualification ;

  • Closing.

Reporting

  • Documenter les actions dans Salesforce ;

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Financial Services, Marketing, Ops, Produit ;

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration du playbook (scripts, méthodologies …) et du funnel ;

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des process.

  • Reporting.

⇒ En tant que création d’équipe, la capacité à identifier, remonter, optimiser, sera clé dans la réussite de la mission.

🫵 Profil recherché

  • Expérience en vente SDR, customer success/AM (avec forte appétence acquisition) ;

  • Goût pour les objectifs de conversion ;

  • Capacité à gérer un volume important de leads ;

  • Aisance au téléphone ;

  • Capacité à expliquer simplement un produit financier ;

  • Très bonne organisation ;

  • Rigueur CRM ;

  • capacité à travailler avec des équipes internes et des prestataires ;

  • capacité à identifier un blocage et à escalader au bon interlocuteur ;

  • Connaissance monde bancaire est un plus.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. descriptionHtml:
At Deliverect, our API-first platform is revolutionizing commerce by providing a connected suite of on and off-premise solutions. We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Join us in this exciting journey, where your contributions will directly impact how businesses connect with their customers in a rapidly evolving global market.

Department Focus:

The Sales team at Deliverect— the pulsating heartbeat of our journey towards growth and the delivery of exceptional value to our customers. We're not just on the front lines; we are the front lines, simplifying order management and shaping the future of how businesses thrive.

For us, it's not merely about transactions; it's a transformative journey, fostering lasting connections and redefining the very essence of order management. Beyond selling, we are builders of consultative relationships, drivers of innovation, and creators of a landscape where our customers not only survive but thrive.

Meet our team—a force that doesn't just make deals; we make life easier for our customers, embodying a spirit that redefines order management. In our ranks, colleagues are not just colleagues; they're innovators, champions of excellence, and the driving force behind Deliverect's continued success. Welcome to a team where every interaction is a step towards not just closing a sale but opening a door to transformative relationships.

Your Impact:

As an Mid-Market Account Executive at Deliverect, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth by acquiring and managing small to mid-sized restaurant and hospitality businesses. Your focus will be on building strong relationships with business owners and key decision-makers, understanding their operational challenges, and offering tailored SaaS solutions that improve efficiency and drive results. This role is essential to expanding Deliverect’s footprint in local and regional markets.

*This is a full-time, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 4 days in London office and 1 day from the comfort of your home.

title: Account Executive Pro - English & Italian speaker
descriptionHtml:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.
From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.
As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.
Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.
We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

We're looking for an Account Executive Pro to join our growing team, based in Paris, France.

We are looking for a highly motivated, quota-driven individual to join our Account Executive team and drive growth primarily across the Italian market, with additional opportunities across other international markets.

This is a high-volume, efficiency-focused role where you will qualify inbound leads, close deals quickly with our packaged PRO offering, and build momentum through a strong pipeline.

You will own the full conversion process for your segment, driving revenue growth while maintaining the quality of relationships that turn customers into long-term advocates. Your ability to balance volume, velocity, and sound escalation judgment will be key to your success in this role at Brevo.


Your impact at Brevo:
Client Engagement & Relationship Management
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through effective communication, active listening, and tailored solutions. Respond to inquiries with clarity and professionalism while adapting to client feedback and evolving needs.
    • Sales Execution & Deal Management
  • Drive the full sales cycle : outreach on warm leads, qualification, demo, negotiation and closing. Deliver compelling, benefit-focused product presentations. Use persuasive communication to convey value and secure commitments.
    • Lead volume & Pipeline Management

title: ad/mbo-stage Informatiebeheer, Documenten Ordenen & Kwaliteitszorg
descriptionHtml:
ad/mbo-praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij iemand die graag orde schept in de chaos?
Krijg je energie van uitzoeken, structureren en dingen overzichtelijk maken?
Werk je graag met digitale systemen?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

We hebben honderden documenten met informatie over ons beleid en genomen besluiten. Deze documenten zijn relevant voor veel collega’s. Om die reden willen we de documenten graag op een overzichtelijke manier aanbieden, zodat alle collega’s snel en makkelijk het document kunnen vinden dat ze zoeken. We hebben al een idee hoe we dit willen gaan doen. Tijdens jouw stage ga je ons idee verder uitwerken en in de praktijk toepassen.

Dit zijn de concrete activiteiten:

  • Je gaat alle beleidsdocumenten verzamelen die nu nog op verschillende plekken zijn opgeslagen.

  • Je maakt een mappenstructuur aan, waarin de documenten op een logische plek komen te staan.

  • Je deelt de documenten in volgens de nieuwe structuur en voorziet ze van labels en metadata voor een optimale vindbaarheid.

  • Je controleert of documenten dubbel voorkomen en verwijdert dubbele, verouderde en niet meer relevante documenten.

  • Je kijkt of de nieuwe structuur in de praktijk goed werkt en of gebruikers de documenten gemakkelijk kunnen terugvinden.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en doet waar nodig voorstellen voor verbeteringen.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen

Je loopt stage bij het team Staf van Dataverzameling (DVZ) van het CBS in Heerlen. Vanuit deze directie wordt een groot deel van de data verzameld die het CBS nodig heeft voor zijn werk. Je krijgt dus een kijkje achter de schermen bij een organisatie die dagelijks met veel verschillende soorten data werkt.
Jouw stageopdracht gaat over kwaliteitszorg voor alle teams binnen DVZ.

Je staat er tijdens je stage natuurlijk niet alleen voor: je hebt collega’s om je heen bij wie je terechtkunt met vragen en ideeën. De sfeer op de afdeling is informeel en gezellig. Collega’s zijn makkelijk aanspreekbaar en helpen elkaar graag. Natuurlijk wordt er hard gewerkt, maar er is ook tijd voor een praatje bij de koffieautomaat of een gezamenlijke lunch. Als je wilt, kun je tijdens de lunch ook aansluiten bij een lunchwandeling.
Kortom: je krijgt bij ons de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen, nieuwe dingen te leren en echt mee te werken in een team.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een ad- of mbo-opleiding informatiebeheer, administratie, business services of management support.

Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met:

  • Het werken met documenten en informatie en deze op een overzichtelijke manier ordenen.

  • Het werken met digitale programma’s en systemen en het snel wegwijs worden in nieuwe systemen.

  • Nauwkeurig en gestructureerd werken en het leuk vinden om dingen netjes en overzichtelijk te maken.

  • Samenwerken en overleggen met collega’s, vragen stellen en meedenken over hoe iets beter of makkelijker kan.

Je werkt graag netjes en gestructureerd, bent betrouwbaar en vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te leren. Je pakt uit jezelf dingen op, denkt mee en stelt vragen als iets niet duidelijk is. Ook vind je het prettig om samen te werken en makkelijk contact te maken met collega’s.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • praktijkervaring opdoet met document- en informatiebeheer en leert hoe je informatie overzichtelijk en goed vindbaar maakt;

  • zelfstandig aan de slag gaat, maar ook samenwerkt en overlegt met collega’s;

  • leert hoe je duidelijk communiceert, vragen stelt en goed afstemt met je stagebegeleider;

  • leert om problemen en verbeterpunten op tijd te herkennen en deze samen met je collega’s te bespreken;

  • feedback krijgt en en toepast, zodat je tijdens je stage steeds meer leert en groeit in je werkzaamheden.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: AIT Electrical/Harness Technician
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a hands-on AIT Electrical/Harness Technician to help us in our mission by building, integrating, maintaining and documenting Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) and electrical harnesses used for FM1 integration and on-site ground testing, to ensure that our mission will succeed and our system will work in space!

Key Responsibilities

In your role as an AIT Electrical/Harness Technician, your role will include the following responsibilities:

  • Build, wire, assemble and inspect EGSE assemblies and associated electrical harnesses in accordance with released drawings, bills of materials and work instructions

  • Where drawings or complete work instructions are unavailable, use available information and agreed engineering direction to support practical build decisions, capture the as-built configuration and any assumptions or open points, and seek review and approval before the equipment is used

  • Manufacture, terminate, label, route, inspect and maintain electrical harnesses and test cables used during FM1 integration and ground testing

  • Perform prescribed electrical checks, such as continuity, pinout and polarity checks, using approved procedures, equipment and acceptance limits

  • Support installation, setup, connection, disconnection and removal of EGSE and harnesses in integration areas and at on-site ground-test locations

  • Maintain and troubleshoot EGSE, harnesses and test cables; identify faults and report discrepancies for engineering or quality disposition before making changes outside approved instructions

  • Support engineers and test teams during integration and ground-test activities by preparing equipment, maintaining tidy cable routing and assisting with approved checks

  • Maintain accurate build, inspection, test, maintenance and as-built records, including equipment identification and configuration status

  • Keep track of tools and measuring equipment used for the work, including their serviceability and calibration status where applicable

  • Follow applicable electrical-safety, ESD, clean-work-area and hardware-handling requirements

  • Support the packing, transport, deployment and return of EGSE and harnesses for ground-test campaigns

  • Help maintain an orderly workshop, equipment inventory and stock of consumables.


What we would love to see from you

In the role of AIT Electrical/Harness Technician, ideally you will bring the following skillset, mentality and experience:

  • Vocational training or apprenticeship in electrical/electronic engineering, electronics, mechatronics or a comparable qualification; equivalent practical experience will also be considered

  • Hands-on experience assembling electrical wiring, cable harnesses, electrical panels or rack-based equipment; experience in aerospace AIT or with EGSE is an asset

  • Practical skills in wire preparation, crimping, connector termination, cable routing and labelling; soldering experience is an asset where required by the work instructions

  • Ability to read and follow electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, connector pinouts, assembly drawings and work instructions

  • Experience using hand tools and basic electrical measurement equipment, such as a multimeter or continuity tester

  • Careful approach to workmanship, inspection, configuration control and recording completed work

  • Willingness to stop and raise a discrepancy when a drawing, label, measurement or instruction does not agree, rather than making an unauthorised change

  • Basic fault-finding skills and the ability to communicate findings clearly to engineers and test teams

  • Willingness to work hands-on in workshops, integration areas and on-site test locations, including supporting time-critical campaign activities

  • Sense of responsibility and a clean, organized and safety-conscious way of working

  • Fluent in written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel for ground-test and launch campaigns.

 

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

Working cross-functionally with both external and internal science, engineering, and product teams you will deliver high-impact AI solutions. We are made of researchers, engineers, product builders, ex-founders who love tackling the most complex real world problems in the industry.

What you will do

  • Set the technical direction for robotics in Applied Science: which problems, models, data, and benchmarks we invest in.

  • Lead the technical execution of high-stakes robotics projects with customers and partners, from scoping to deployment.

  • Build and mentor a team of robotics Applied Scientists and Research Engineers.

  • Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art models on clusters with thousands of GPUs.

  • Own the data strategy: generate and curate datasets (image-text, video-text, teleoperation, simulation), and build evaluators/benchmarks for perception, navigation and manipulation tasks.

  • Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases.

  • Manage research projects and communications with client research teams, and engage senior stakeholders.

About you

  • Fluent in English with excellent communication skills — at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience leading a technical AI, science or engineering team. Balancing technical IC work with team leadership and stakeholder management.

  • Expert with PyTorch or JAX.

  • Deep experience with Vision Language Models (VLM), Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, perception, navigation and manipulation, simulation tools (e.g. Isaac SIM), with a track record of shipping models on real robots.

  • Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance.

  • Doesn’t need roadmaps: moves independently and navigates uncertainty with confidence.

Nice to have

title: Art Director
descriptionHtml:

Quality and client-facing work

Your background

title: Associate, AI & Robotics
descriptionHtml:
About Marble

Marble creates hard tech companies for the New Climate Era, across energy, industry and resilience. Since 2021, we have launched 15 companies backed by some of the best investors across Europe and North America.

About the role

We are hiring an Associate to drive venture creation across multiple opportunity areas in physical AI, robotics, and autonomy in a broad range of sectors (e.g. energy, logistics, construction, manufacturing, mining, etc)

Reporting to Partners, this role gives exposure to every aspect of venture creation: opportunity research, founder recruitment, tech and product development, economic analysis, go-to-market, fundraising, investment decisions, portfolio management.

Because we work at pre-company stage, the job requires to identify what will be relevant and fundable in 2-3 years, not just what is hype today.

Location: Paris, France (occasional travel for events)

Language: Fluent English required. French or German is a plus.

Responsibilities

As part of the Venture Lead team, you will be responsible for driving our venture creation process on the opportunity areas that you own:

  • Opportunity research: build conviction on priority areas where Marble should create new companies, based on deep technical and market analysis.

  • Talent sourcing: identify talent with high founder potential and relevant domain expertise and hire them as Founders in Residence to build with Marble.

  • Building: work with Founders to develop venture ideas, systematically de-risk them, and turn them into new companies with team, funding and a roadmap to seed. You'll ensure robust diligence to support progress / stop decisions.

Alongside these, you will take on supporting work and special projects based on priorities and your profile, such as: external content creation, events, founder resources development, portfolio support, ecosystem relations, etc.

Requirements

This role is ideal for an engineer or computer scientist who can build, reason from first principles, with enough technical foundations to navigate various domains where intelligent systems interact with the physical world:

  • Technical expertise in AI/ML applied to physical systems, robotics and autonomy. You hold a PhD or MS in Computer Science (ML/RL), Robotics, or related (EEng, MechEng), with applied experience in startup or industry.

  • Experience shipping systems in a real-world environment. You understand operational constraints such as safety, uptime and latency, human-in-the-loop workflows, and integrations with other systems.

  • Commercial orientation. Beyond tech alone, you enjoy thinking about product, customers, economics, deployment, manufacturing or supply chains.

  • First principles reasoning. You can break down a problem into its core constituents to understand what needs to be true for things to work.

  • Clear communicator. You can articulate complex ideas and defend a conviction with sharp memos and engaging presentations.

  • Talent intuition. You know a great founder when you meet them, and if you want to work with them, you know how to persuade them.

  • Makes things happen. Team player who moves fast, with high standards for excellence, and high ownership on projects from start to finish.

We would love to hear from you if this sounds like you:

  • You have prior experience working with early stage startups, deep tech commercialisation, applied R&D, or industrial tech development.

  • You are AI native. You can combine frontier tools and human judgment to maximise productivity and leverage in your work.

  • You are relentlessly curious. You stay current in your own field, you enjoy learning about new domains, and you learn very fast.

  • You have a superpower. For example: technical mastery in a field, the ability to see patterns where others cannot, truly original ideas, high EQ and energy level, strong network in a relevant domain, extraordinary writing skills, etc.

  • You are playing to win. You know that venture is competitive and follows a power law, and the challenge motivates you.

  • You are a pragmatic optimist with a driving motivation to solve the hardest problems in physical industries, AI and climate infrastructure.

Your ability to learn on the job matters more than ticking every box.

What We Offer

  • Full-time (CDI) contract, Associate level*

  • €60-70k gross annual base salary + 10% target bonus + stock options

  • Office in Paris. Occasional remote days are possible

  • Health insurance (Alan), meal and mobility vouchers (Swile)

  • Exposure to our network of top founders, investors, and advisors

  • Working with the brightest, most driven individuals you'll meet

  • Rapid learning curve and personal development

  • Enhanced parental support

What is hard to capture just with the above is the unique opportunity this role offers to join Marble in the early days of our journey, and shape the future of what we hope will become a top institution in climate and hard tech in Europe and beyond.

(*) We're opportunistically open to more experienced candidates who could potentially join at the Senior Associate level.

We believe that a diverse group of minds creates an unfair team advantage when building high impact companies. Hence, we actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds, genders and perspective to apply.

Studies have shown that under-represented candidates are less likely to apply unless they feel they meet every single qualification. If you are excited about the opportunity but your experience does not align perfectly - please apply anyway!

En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Chez Theodo HealthTech, l'entité experte en santé, nous accompagnons tous les acteurs de la santé dans le développement des dispositifs médicaux digitaux sur-mesure. Grâce à notre expérience du Lean et de la tech, combinées à notre connaissance de la santé, nous concevons et développons des dispositifs médicaux numériques qui s'intègrent dans le parcours de soins des patients (thérapies digitales - DTx, essais cliniques virtualisés, parcours de soins digitalisés). Notre but est de réaliser des produits qui changent la vie de leurs utilisateurs, qu'ils soient soignants ou patients.
Ton équipe : Tu intègres une équipe projet composée de développeurs, de designers et d'un Lead Product Manager. Leur rôle : concevoir des produits de qualité, les livrer dans les temps, avec un excellent niveau de service. Ton objectif en tant qu'Associate Product Manager est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité à ton client. Tes futures missions : - Piloter le delivery en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : prioriser les features, rédiger des user stories claires et s’assurer de respecter les jalons pour délivrer dans les temps. - Collaborer avec ton client pour comprendre ses besoins, challenger ses idées et co-construire des solutions digitales à forte valeur ajoutée. title: Associate Team Lead Support Financial Services N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 Financial Services (Télétravail depuis Lille)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1,000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Le poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support Financial Services N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 Financial Services pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Financial Services Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne au quotidien les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable. Elle intègre également un Compte Pro, qui permet aux entrepreneurs et aux PME de gérer leurs opérations bancaires courantes : cartes, virements, encaissements, dépôts de capitaux, financements…

L’équipe Support Financial Services N2 traite les demandes les plus complexes, qui nécessitent une expertise approfondie des produits bancaires et de la plateforme. Elle travaille en lien avec les équipes du Support Niveau 1 externalisé, du Support Technique, du Produit, de la Tech et des Ops, ainsi qu’avec nos partenaires bancaires.

Ce poste est centré sur le management de proximité. Tu seras le relais opérationnel du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services et accompagneras au quotidien une équipe de 6 à 12 agents pour leur permettre d’apporter aux utilisateurs des réponses efficaces, de qualité et empreintes d’empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité et à l’amélioration continue du support. Tu pourras intervenir ponctuellement sur des projets transverses, en apportant la vision terrain de l’équipe.

Notre culture

Au sein du Costumer Support de Pennylane, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience.

Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust.

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça

  • Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

  • Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

  • Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations et donner un feedback constructif.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité, notamment le temps de première réponse, le temps intermédiaire de réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume traité.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

  • Remonter les irritants liés aux produits bancaires, aux processus ou aux délais de réponse des partenaires externes.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des process, de la documentation et des outils internes.

Responsabilités

  • Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services, en les accompagnant dans leur activité, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.

  • Accompagner individuellement les collaborateurs qui ont besoin de soutien sur la qualité de leurs réponses ou l’efficacité du traitement des demandes : analyser les situations, donner des feedbacks concrets, proposer un coaching ou une formation adaptée et suivre les progrès.

  • Etre garant des indicateurs de performance de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, tout en veillant à la bonne prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et au suivi des demandes en cours.

  • Contribuer à l’organisation de l’équipe : préparer et ajuster le planning, anticiper les absences et organiser la couverture des files et des permanences, en veillant à une répartition équilibrée de la charge. Faire remonter au Senior Team Lead les besoins de renfort ou les arbitrages nécessaires.

  • Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes urgentes ou complexes concernant le Compte Pro, les cartes, les virements, les encaissements ou les dépôts de capitaux, et orienter ou escalader lorsque nécessaire.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les autres managers de proximité de l’équipe pour partager les pratiques, coordonner les priorités et assurer une continuité managériale cohérente.

  • Faire le lien avec le Support Technique, les équipes Produit, Tech et Ops, ainsi qu’avec les BPO qui traitent le Support Niveau 1, afin de partager les priorités, faire remonter les irritants et faciliter les escalades et la continuité de prise en charge.

  • Collaborer avec les partenaires bancaires, notamment Swan.

  • Identifier et proposer des améliorations des process, des outils, de la documentation et des modes de fonctionnement du Support, puis contribuer à leur mise en œuvre selon les priorités définies.

  • Mettre en place des plans d'action sur l'activité, en cas de besoin.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si

  • Tu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.

  • Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.

  • Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même lorsque les sujets sont complexes ou impliquent plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support Financial Services dans un environnement en forte évolution.

Qualifications

  • Diplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en banque, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Expérience préalable de minimum 2 ans au sein d'une équipe Support et expérience d’au moins 4 ans en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe.

  • Bonne capacité d’analyse, de prise de décision et de résolution de problèmes.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.

  • Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.

  • Aisance avec les outils de ticketing et de documentation, notamment Intercom ou Notion.

  • Anglais professionnel, niveau B2 minimum, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, afin de pouvoir collaborer avec des interlocuteurs anglophones et piloter des équipes multilingues.

  • Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide.

  • Sens du service et attention portée à l’expérience utilisateur.

Les nice to have

Ces éléments sont un plus, mais ne sont pas indispensables si tu as une forte appétence pour le support, le management de proximité et l’apprentissage produit et métier.

  • Connaissances dans le domaine bancaire ou des services financiers.

  • Expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou start-up.

  • Expérience du management d’une équipe principalement à distance.

  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes Produit, Tech, Ops ou des partenaires externes.

  • Utilisation de l’IA pour optimiser ses tâches.

Modalités pratiques

  • Tu reporteras au Senior Team Lead Support Financial Services.

  • Le rôle combine management de proximité, pilotage opérationnel et contribution ponctuelle à des situations complexes ou urgentes.

  • L’équipe collabore principalement en français, avec des interactions multilingues à venir selon nos développements à l’étranger.

 

🤝 Process de recrutement

  • Un première entretien avec notre Simon, Senior Recruiter (30 min)

  • Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec Nathan, Senior Team Lead Support FS (1h)

  • Une étude de cas à préparer en amont avec Nathan et Vincent, Associate Team Lead Support FS (1h)

  • Un échange avec une partie de l'équipe de Specialists Support FST (30 min)

  • Un entretien final avec Johan, Head Of Customer Support (45 min)

  

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

title: Automation Engineer (All genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Operations Excellence team sits within the COO organization and serves as a strategic partner to managers, team leads, and colleagues across Stark. By delivering data-driven insights, leading critical projects, and driving continuous process improvement, we help the organization operate more efficiently, scale effectively, and achieve its goals faster. As an individual contributor, you will take end-to-end ownership of complex initiatives with significant business impact. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will have the opportunity to influence key decisions, shape core operating processes, and contribute directly to the success of one of Europe’s fastest-growing unicorns.

YOUR MISSION

As Automation Engineer, you build and deploy automations that eliminate manual effort across operations and the back-office. You work across RPA, LLM-based tooling, and API integrations — and you are as likely to be automating an invoice approval chain as a production line data feed. You measure success in hours saved and errors eliminated.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Design and build RPA workflows for operational and back-office processes — UiPath, Power Automate, or equivalent
  • Develop LLM-based automation tools for document-heavy workflows: invoice extraction, quality certificates, order processing, email triage
  • Integrate automation solutions with ERP, MES, and business applications via APIs
  • Build agent-based workflows where multi-step reasoning or decision-making is required
  • Test, deploy, and maintain automations in production — including monitoring, alerting, and incident response
  • Document automation logic, dependencies, and maintenance procedures thoroughly
  • Work with operational and back-office teams to identify, scope, and prioritise new automation opportunities

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 3–6 years building automations in an operational or business process context
  • Has shipped working automations into production — not just proof-of-concept or demo environments
  • RPA tools — UiPath, Power Automate, or equivalent (hands-on production experience)
  • Python scripting — for custom automation logic, API integration, and LLM tool use
  • API integration — REST APIs, webhooks, data exchange across ERP and business systems
  • Process analysis and QA mindset — automations must be reliable, not just functional
  • BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or similar

NICE TO HAVE

  • LLM-based tooling — prompt engineering, agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • ERP system familiarity (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar)
  • Manufacturing or back-office finance/ops experience

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

title: Automation Engineer (PLC/SCADA)
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Automation Engineer to design the control software and automation architecture of our production line. As software and automation designer, you will develop PLC and HMI logic, define the interfaces between robots, transport systems, quality stations and the MES/ERP, and make the line run safely, traceably and at pace.

You will turn a process concept into a line that runs unattended for most of the shift. Your code will decide whether we reach our throughput targets, and your data will tell us why we don't.

About us

We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility in Steyerberg, Lower Saxony, and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you're ready to rise to the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Design the automation architecture of the pilot line: PLC and safety controllers, networks, HMI/SCADA and the data model across all stations.

  • Develop PLC control software (IEC 61131-3) for dosing, mixing, casting, curing, transport and buffer stations, including recipe and batch handling.

  • Define and implement the interfaces between PLCs, robot controllers, MES and ERP, including order handling and traceability (serial and batch IDs).

  • Implement safety-related control functions together with the safety engineering team (e.g., PROFIsafe, ISO 13849), and reflect explosion-protection requirements in the control concept.

  • Build the operational data layer: process data acquisition, alarm management, OEE and KPI reporting.

  • Commission and debug the line on site, support FAT and SAT, and contribute to process validation.

  • Maintain coding standards, version control, test procedures and documentation for all automation software.

What we are looking for

  • Significant professional experience in industrial automation (PLC programming and control architecture) in manufacturing or process plants.

  • Strong, demonstrable experience with a major PLC platform (ideally Beckhoff).

  • Solid knowledge of IEC 61131-3 and structured software development, including version control, testing and documentation.

  • Experience integrating PLCs with higher-level systems (MES, ERP, databases) via OPC UA or comparable interfaces.

  • Understanding of machine safety and functional safety principles.

  • The ability to debug live systems on the shop floor under time pressure.

  • A degree in electrical engineering, automation, computer science, mechatronics or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

Desirable experience

  • Python or a similar language for data analysis, test automation and tooling.

  • Robot integration (KUKA, ABB, Fanuc, or Beckhoff motion) and PLC-to-robot communication.

  • Recipe management and batch process control (ISA-88).

  • SCADA/HMI design (e.g., WinCC, Ignition, TwinCAT HMI).

  • Traceability systems, barcode/RFID or serial-number management.

  • Knowledge of explosion-protection requirements for electrical equipment (ATEX).

  • Commissioning experience in a startup or greenfield plant.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

title: Backend Engineering Team Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Netcraft

Netcraft is the global leader in cybercrime detection and disruption. We’re a trusted partner for three of the four largest companies in the world and many large governments. We've blocked over 225 million cyber-attacks to date, and we take down around 33% of the world's phishing attacks.

Our purpose and passion are focused on just one thing: protecting the world from cybercrime.

That passion shapes how we work, too. We’re proud of our talented team and the value each person brings, and we’ve built a workplace where people feel supported and inspired. From strong benefits and wellness programs to meaningful collaboration and team connection. 

The Role

We’re looking for a Backend Engineering Team Lead to establish and lead a new backend team responsible for several key Netcraft products, including:

  • The Integration Layer, which enables customers to integrate their SIEM platforms with Netcraft data
  • NSI, which supports engagement with criminals conducting conversational scams at scale
  • The Web and SSL Server Survey
  • Spam, which analyses emails from multiple sources to identify phishing and scam activity

These products are a mixture of legacy platforms that produce key data supporting Netcraft systems and new products that support our customer base. You’ll be a technical leader with expertise across a varied stack, with the commercial acumen to understand how to modernise legacy products as well as commercialise new products.

You will build a new team to manage and improve these products, contributing code, demonstrating best practice, and managing an exciting delivery roadmap.

You’ll be:

  • Working with Product and Design colleagues to evaluate each of your products, determining where immediate improvements can be made and helping to develop the long-term strategy for each
  • Operating with autonomy, taking the initiative to solve problems and recognising the importance of adhering to demanding delivery timelines
  • Managing requirements from key stakeholders and customers, understanding what needs to be done based on business needs without necessarily needing to be told
  • Prioritising, refining, and sequencing the team’s workflow while retaining approximately 30–50% of your time for hands-on engineering
  • Deeply embedded in conceiving and executing engineering solutions, creating performant systems and services to delight our customers
  • Upholding high engineering standards with a demonstrable commitment to code quality, a test-driven approach, and a modern continuous integration/continuous deployment delivery flow
  • Well-versed in how AI-first development techniques can materially boost productivity
  • Responsible for building and leading a high-performing team of talented and enthusiastic engineers

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Strong and demonstrable leadership skills, with a constructive attitude to problem-solving and the ability to switch effectively between priorities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to distil technical concepts for a range of stakeholders and motivate a team
  • A strong engineering background spanning a range of technologies, including Go, OpenSearch, and MongoDB, with Perl experience considered an advantage
  • A demonstrable track record of identifying opportunities to create significant value within existing products and taking ideas from concept through to production
  • Experience partnering closely with Product Managers and Product Owners to shape product strategy, define priorities, and translate customer and business needs into effective technical solutions
  • Experience working with AWS technologies and a range of machine learning tools and frameworks
  • An interest in reverse-engineering codebases, where necessary, to understand the inner workings of legacy products
  • Experience interviewing and hiring engineers, building effective teams, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Strong Go development skills, particularly in technology modernisation or uplift projects
  • Experience with generative AI technologies and where and how to apply them to improve customer experiences
  • Practical experience managing engineers at different career stages, from recent graduates to seasoned professionals

The Rewards Package

  • 33 days annual leave - includes public holidays which can be worked if you prefer 
  • Generous enhanced family leave and pay 
  • Enhanced company sick pay from day one of employment, with additional support after your first six months’ service
  • Salary sacrifice pension with matched employer contributions up to 5% + NI savings 
  • Private health cover, including access to a private GP service 
  • Life Assurance at 4 x salary 
  • Equity tracking scheme (eligibility criteria apply) - allowing you share in Netcraft's long term success 
  • Hybrid and flexible working options 
  • Meals, snacks, and drinks provided in the office 
  • Comprehensive health, safety, and wellness service available 24/7 for you and your family 
  • Two paid Learning & Development days per year plus access to learning resources such as Udemy and Coursera to support your career 
  • Two Volunteering Days per year, to allow you to contribute to your wider community or charity 
  • Employee Referral Bonus scheme 
  • Spot reward bonus scheme to reward truly outstanding contributions 

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 

This is deeply important to us. Through our ally network, we support under-represented groups and maintain a working environment free from bias, harassment, or discrimination. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

We’re also happy to make adjustments to the hiring process to ensure every candidate can participate fully. 

Please note: Netcraft does not accept unsolicited approaches from external recruiters.
