title: Global Investigator (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defense in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close.

The impact you will have:

  • Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline.

  • Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

  • Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations.

  • Take the highest-priority complaints beyond disposition: trace funds through consolidation wallets to regulated exchanges or other actionable endpoints

  • Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4 or more years of investigative or analytical experience in the public or private sector, including hands-on blockchain analysis.

  • Demonstrated experience tracing funds across chains and attributing addresses to real-world actors, including the judgment to tell an unattributed service from a privately controlled (unhosted) wallet

  • Experience building or contributing to cases that led to a freeze, seizure, arrest, or takedown.

  • Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

About the Team:

  • The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone.

  • Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

  • Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events.

  • Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

title: Golang Technical Lead (Perm, UK, Remote + Travel)
descriptionHtml:
This is a permanent, full-time remote opportunity open to candidates based in the UK. While the role is primarily remote, occasional travel to client sites across the UK may be required to attend meetings, workshops and other project-related activities.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.  

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products. 

Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Technical Lead Role:

As a Technical Lead at Nearform, you will be responsible for leading and guiding development teams while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into impactful applications. However, as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects in your time here, your responsibilities may also include:

  • Provide technical and line-management leadership to your development team.
  • Take responsibility for the successful delivery of projects.
  • Identify and resolve blockers before they become issues.
  • Ensure best practices in software development, DevOps, and agile methodologies are upheld within the team.
  • Work directly with clients, translating requirements into technical briefs.
  • Shape and define architectural decisions ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Provide updates to client and Nearform leadership to ensure clear understanding of project status and drive good decision-making.

What we are looking for in this person:

  • Significant experience in software engineering as either a Senior Engineer leading projects and mentoring or as a Technical Lead. For this particular role, you will ideally be using Golang, experience with additional other languages such as JavaScript or Python would be desirable. 
  • Experience working directly with clients or customers to understand technical requirements.
  • Experience leading software engineering teams through technical delivery and either direct line management or mentoring.
  • Deep understanding of agile ways of working, best practices and design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of test-driven development and testing best practices.
  • Deep understanding of version control tools, e.g. Git.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Understanding of operational concerns (such as monitoring, performance testing, security considerations, accessibility, GDPR)
  • Empathy and people skills
  • Financial services industry experience 


Benefits and Perks we offer at Nearform

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance. 
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem! 
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances - We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.

Our Interview Process

Talent Call (30 mins via Zoom)
An initial conversation with a member of our Talent Team to explore your background, leadership experience, and career goals. We’ll provide an overview of Nearform, discuss potential alignment, and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.

Technical Lead Assessment (90 mins, Zoom)
A structured assessment led by a senior Technical Lead or Head of Engineering, designed to evaluate key aspects of a Technical Lead role. This session includes a selection of tasks to cover:

Architecture Design – We want to see how you approach a high level problem, demonstrating your design thinking and decision-making process.
Technical Implementation – How do you turn a design into reality, taking into account business needs?
Code Standards and Feedback – We want to see not just your own skills, but also how you improve those around you

Hiring Manager Interview (45 mins via Zoom)
A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.

There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project. 

Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.



Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence.

title: Graduate Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward graduates to join the first graduate cohort at Resonance in Berlin as Applied AI Engineers. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent, and we're building our Berlin hub to serve clients across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Graduate Applied AI Engineer in Berlin, you’ll build production AI systems for our clients across DACH from your first month, working alongside Senior Applied AI Engineers who review your code and coach you. You’ll ship agents, integrations, data pipelines and evals, working across the stack from the AI layer to the client’s core systems and the interfaces people use. You’ll sit with the people who do the work today, see how AI changes it, and help client teams run and extend what we build. You’ll also contribute to Resonance’s own AI products and shared platform, take on more ownership as you grow, and help shape how we train, build and grow as one of our first graduate cohort.

Your first year: Comprehensive training when you join, covering AI engineering, our platform and how we work with clients. You’ll be on a client team from your first month, in a small team where you know everyone by name, founders included, and work closely with colleagues in London. Nobody expects you to know it all when you start: asking for help early is part of the job, and senior people make time for it. You’ll start as a Junior Engineer and typically become an Engineer within 18–24 months.

What we’re looking for: You take the initiative, learn fast and go looking for hard problems. You’re AI-obsessed, trying new models and tools the day they come out. You’re finishing a degree in Computer Science or a closely related subject, such as Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science or Mathematics with a strong programming component, or you graduated in one in the last two years, and you can show what you’re capable of through your grades, competitions, internships, societies or things you’ve built. You write good code in Python or TypeScript and have built something with LLMs: a project, a hackathon entry or an open-source contribution. A software engineering internship, ideally at a startup or fast-moving product team, AI side projects or a company you founded are a plus, and so is German for client work in DACH. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Instead of one product at one company, you’ll ship several production AI systems a year across industries, and help build our own AI products and platform. You’ll learn alongside engineers and operators who have embedded AI into 50+ businesses, in a team aiming to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe and worldwide. Europe is falling behind on AI, and every build moves another European business to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: Berlin, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in DACH and Europe. English is our working language; German is a plus. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates. Start date Summer 2027 (dates to be confirmed). We also offer Summer 2027 internships for students in the penultimate year of their degree.

Apply

Send your CV with your grades, your GitHub if you have one, and a short note on something you've built with AI.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: Growth Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Peec AI

AI search is changing how brands are discovered and chosen. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Google’s AI answers what they used to search for, and AI assistants increasingly shape the journey from discovery to purchase. Winning customers now means winning over the AI systems that influence their decisions.

Peec AI is an AI search platform that helps marketing teams understand and improve how their brands are discovered, represented, and recommended. We show them where they stand, what’s shaping it, and where to act. Since launching in January 2025, Peec AI has passed $20M ARR and 4,000 paying customers. We’re a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, with 100+ people across our Berlin HQ and our New York office.

About the role

We are hiring a Fullstack Engineer for our Growth team. You will run experiments across the whole self-serve journey: from the moment someone first hears of Peec AI to the day they renew, refer a friend or leave. That covers the website, signup, pricing and checkout, the trial and onboarding. It also covers the moments in the product where we ask people to do something, like connect a tool, invite a teammate or upgrade. You can work on any of these, and we decide together where the focus goes each month or quarter.

You come up with the hypothesis, design the experiment and discuss it with the team. Then you run the rest of the loop yourself: build it, instrument it, ship it behind a flag, read the result and write down what happened.

You report to the VP of Growth and work with our Growth PM, our growth engineer, and the marketing and design teams.

What you'll do

  • Go after big swings. We size every idea first and look for changes that could move a funnel step by 30 to 40 percentage points. It is fine if most of them fail.

  • Build and improve the experimentation infrastructure. Feature flags, assignment at the account level, exposure logged when someone becomes eligible, outcomes recorded on the server, and holdouts we read.

  • Keep conversion data accurate. Event design, funnel definitions and readouts the team can rely on.

  • Own what you ship after launch. You watch it, read the result on the date you set, and decide whether we keep it, change it or remove it.

  • Build internal tools that let the team run more experiments with less manual work.

What we're looking for

  • You have run growth experiments end to end. You formed the hypothesis, designed the test, built it and read the result. Not advised on them, not analysed someone else's.

  • You write production code today. Strong React and TypeScript on the frontend, comfortable in Node.js and databases on the backend. Our stack is React, Node.js and Next.js.

  • You know what your volume can detect. You can size a test, say how long it needs to run, and tell us when a result is not readable.

  • SQL and analytics fluency. Funnels, cohorts, event design.

  • B2B SaaS experience.

  • You ship with Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent.

  • Product judgement. You can tell which changes need a test, which can ship without one, and which are not worth building.

  • Product taste. You care about how the things you ship look and feel. You can turn an idea into a screen that belongs in our product, and you know when to bring in our design team.

Bonus points

  • You set up an experimentation practice from scratch and grew it into a regular part of how the team works.

  • Product-led growth experience. Onboarding, activation, paywalls, pricing, checkout.

  • Acquisition experience. Website and signup experiments, SEO or paid funnels.

  • Experiments on low-volume B2B funnels, where only big changes are readable.

  • Experimentation platforms and feature flags. Statsig, GrowthBook, PostHog, or your own.

  • Billing and subscriptions. Stripe or similar.

  • You founded a company, or you were an early engineer at one.

  • Side projects and experiments you can show us.

What we offer

  • Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe's fastest-growing Series A startups

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Aggressive equity compensation package

  • Paid Dinner & Uber home when working late

  • The most beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin

Compensation: €100K – €130K • Offers Equity

title: Growth Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Buena

Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

Über die Rolle

Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht. Viele unserer Eigentümer wollen irgendwann verkaufen. Wir sitzen direkt an der Quelle und kennen Objekte, Eigentümer und Timing.

Deine Aufgabe ist, daraus eine planbare Akquise-Maschine zu bauen: Du identifizierst die richtigen Eigentümer aus unserem Bestand, sprichst sie gezielt an und wandelst erstes Interesse in hochqualifizierte Leads für unsere Makler um. Das ist keine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien und Roadmaps. Du baust selbst: Kampagnen, Outbound-Workflows, Automatisierungen, Funnels. Du weißt jede Woche, welche Zahl du bewegt hast. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Akquise-Engine aufbauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache.

  • Marketing selbst umsetzen: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment.

  • Funnel und Zahlen verantworten: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat, trackst Kosten pro Lead und Conversion und optimierst so lange, bis die Unit Economics stimmen.

  • Schnell testen: Daten-Trigger, Kanäle, Messaging und Lead-Magneten. Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren willst, und misst es sauber.

Du passt, wenn du

  • 3+ Jahre operative Erfahrung in Growth oder Performance Marketing, mit eigener Verantwortung für Leads, Conversion oder Umsatz.

  • Du hast Dinge von null aufgebaut, etwa als Gründer:in, als Geschäftsführer:in eines kleinen Unternehmens oder in einer frühen Startup-Phase. Das ist für uns ein starkes Signal.

  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit datengetriebener Akquise: Outbound, Datenanreicherung, CRM und Automatisierung.

  • Marketing-Erfahrung mit Performance-Kanälen und Kampagnen ist ein klares Plus.

  • Erfahrung in Immobilien, PropTech oder Marktplätzen ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1). Du sprichst täglich mit Eigentümern und unseren Hausverwaltungen.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder ziehst her und reist gern zu unseren Standorten in ganz Deutschland.

Deine Benefits

  • Ein Vertical, das du von Anfang an prägst, mit 70.000 Einheiten als Basis und voller Rückendeckung vom Leadership-Team.

  • Ein Inside-Sales-Team, auf das du zugreifen kannst: Es übernimmt Anrufe und die Bearbeitung deiner Kampagnen, damit du dich auf den Aufbau der Akquise-Engine konzentrieren kannst.

  • Einen direkten Weg zur Verantwortung: Wenn Brokerage funktioniert, skalierst du es weiter.

  • Top-Vergütung inklusive virtueller Aktienoptionen und 500 € Wohnzuschuss pro Monat in der Nähe unseres Büros.

  • 110 € Lunch-Budget und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss pro Monat, täglich Frühstück und Spezialitäten-Kaffee im Office.

  • 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr.

title: GTM Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Nylon builds AI research tools that are changing how lawyers and accountants work. 2,000+ firms across New Zealand, Australia and the UK trust our platform, from the biggest firms in the world to small specialist practices.

Our go-to-market team runs on data. The quality of our outreach lists, the accuracy of our CRM and the reliability of the systems that connect them decide how well our sales and marketing efforts perform. We're hiring a GTM Engineer to own that data layer.

The role

You'll build and maintain the pipelines that find, enrich and deliver prospect data to our sales team, keep the CRM clean and trustworthy, and connect the tools in our stack so information flows without manual effort. It's a hands-on technical role at the intersection of sales operations, data and automation. Not a sales role, and not a pure engineering role. You'll report to our Head of Go-to-Market, work closely with our account executives, SDRs and marketing, and have a lot of freedom in how you solve problems.

What you'll be doing

Outreach data and list building

  • Building targeted prospect lists across NZ, AU and the UK from the ideal customer profiles the GTM team defines, covering firm type, size, practice area, location and seniority

  • Sourcing data from multiple channels, including scraping public sources, enrichment platforms (Clay, Apollo or similar), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, professional body registers and our own product and website data

  • Designing waterfall enrichment flows that verify contact details, fill gaps and score leads, keeping bounce and unsubscribe rates low

  • Using AI tooling to research accounts at scale, qualify fit, personalise outreach inputs and automate the repetitive parts of list building

  • Maintaining data quality, deduplication and consent standards so lists arrive usable and compliant with the Privacy Act, Australian Privacy Principles and UK GDPR/PECR

CRM and integrations

  • Owning the health of our CRM (Attio), including object and field design, pipeline stages, data hygiene, deduplication, ownership rules and reporting views

  • Building and maintaining integrations between the CRM and the rest of the GTM stack, including our dialler (JustCall), scheduling (Calendly), billing (Stripe), analytics (Metabase and our product database) and marketing channels (Meta Ads, website forms)

  • Writing automations and scripts (Python or JavaScript, webhooks, Zapier/Make/n8n or direct API work) so leads, activities and revenue events land in the right place without anyone re-keying them

  • Querying our data warehouse and Metabase in SQL to report on pipeline, conversion, attribution and rep activity, and to reconcile CRM records against source-of-truth systems

  • Documenting how the stack fits together and training the team on the parts they touch

About you

  • 3 to 5 years in revenue operations, sales operations, growth engineering, data or a similar role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company

  • Proven experience building outreach or prospect lists with scraping and enrichment tools such as Clay

  • Strong CRM administration on at least one modern platform (Attio, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar), including data model design and hygiene rather than just day-to-day use

  • Solid SQL and comfort in a BI tool such as Metabase

  • Working proficiency in Python or JavaScript, plus experience with REST APIs, webhooks and automation platforms

  • Practical experience using LLMs and agentic tooling in real workflows, with a clear view of where they help and where they don't

  • A high bar for data quality and the discipline to keep systems tidy over time

  • Clear written communication, translating what sales and marketing need into systems that deliver it

  • Experience with accounting or legal firms, or professional body datasets in NZ, AU or the UK, is an advantage

  • Familiarity with marketing attribution and multi-touch pipeline analysis is an advantage

  • The right to work in the UK

What you'll get

  • No legacy stack to work around and no committee to get through. If you can show a better way of finding customers or running the CRM, you'll ship it

  • A small, well-funded team where the systems you build directly determine how well the company grows

How to apply

Alongside your CV, include a short note about one data or automation problem you've solved for a sales team and how you did it. Links to anything you've built (repos, Clay tables, dashboards, write-ups) are welcome.

title: [Internship] Product Manager - trader/quant platform
descriptionHtml:
TwoWay builds a real-time trading intelligence platform for institutional traders. Founded in 2024 and based in Paris, TwoWay transforms the real-time flow of broker communications into structured market intelligence for front-office traders across FX, Fixed Income, and derivatives. Deployed at leading tier 1 and tier 2 financial institutions across Europe.

We're at seed stage, a small team, and moving fast.

About the role:

This is TwoWay's first product hire. You'll work directly with the CEO, not inside a PM team, not supporting a roadmap someone else owns. You'll be embedded in the product from day one, with direct exposure to clients.

Your job is to bridge the world of our users (traders across FX, fixed income, rates, and derivatives) with the product we're building and our tech team (CTO, head of data, and senior developers).

Tasks

You follow product development from discovery to spec, design, and testing, to client delivery and support, staying close to the client post-launch and iterating until the job is actually done.

  • Participate in discovery sessions with traders at client banks: understanding their workflows, pain points, and what good looks like for them

  • Iterate on the platform design with the users and the design lead
  • Test the app alongside the tech team, contributing to quality benchmarks and helping decide when outputs are ready to ship
  • Work on roadmap prioritization: what we build next, and why

Requirements

You'd be a great fit if you

  • Combine engineering and finance backgrounds: You're finishing a Grande École (Polytechnique, Centrale, Mines, ENSAE, or equivalent) and completing or having completed an M2 in financial mathematics or quantitative finance
  • Are curious. You have already learned the basics at school or in a previous internship, but most importantly, you are keen to keep learning, ask questions, and get deep into the topics you’ll get to work on.

Benefits

Why join TwoWay now

  • First product person: real ownership, real influence on what gets built
  • Your users are traders and quants at leading European institutions.
  • You'll see what it takes to build AI products in a highly regulated, latency-sensitive domain.
  • Direct access to the TwoWay founding team, combining decades of experience in trading and product development

Send a short note (not AI-written, we’d like to hear from you). Tell us what you'd want to work on and why this problem interests you. Include your CV.

title: IT-Administrator (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mit dem Blick für das Ganze.

Deine Karriere bei REVISA.

Fünf Leistungsbereiche, zwei Standorte und über 180 engagierte Persönlichkeiten. Wir stehen seit über einem halben Jahrhundert für ganzheitliche und holistische Beratung aus einer Hand und sehen uns heute in der Verantwortung, die Zukunft von morgen zu gestalten. Unser Miteinander als Team ist ebenfalls von der Vielfalt und Kompetenz eines jeden Einzelnen geprägt und ist die Basis für unseren zukunftsorientierten und wertschöpfenden Beratungsansatz.

Das Beste für Dich und Deine Entwicklung.

Mit der zunehmenden Technologisierung unserer Kanzleiprozesse wird Deine Arbeit dabei immer wichtiger. Du sorgst für verlässliche Systeme, unterstützt bei technischen Fragen und gestaltest mit uns die digitale Zukunft bei REVISA. Dein Tätigkeitsfeld setzt sich dabei aus folgenden Bereichen zusammen:

Netzwerk & IT-Infrastruktur

  • Netzwerkbetreuung und Behebung von Systemstörungen
  • Unterstützung bei IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz (DSGVO)
  • Pflege der IT-Dokumentation

Helpdesk & First-Level-Support

  • Erster Ansprechpartner bei IT- und DATEV-Fragen
  • Ticketannahme, Dokumentation und Lösung von Standardfällen
  • Strukturierte Weitergabe komplexer Supportanfragen

Optional: DATEV-Systemlandschaft

  • Betreuung, Konfiguration und Pflege der DATEV-Anwendungen
  • Benutzer-, Rechte- und Zugangsmedienverwaltung
  • Unterstützung bei Updates, Migrationen und Schnittstellenanbindungen

Optional: Digitalisierung & Prozessoptimierung

  • Analyse und digitale Optimierung von Kanzleiabläufen im Team
  • Mitwirkung an Software-, KI- und Digitalisierungsprojekten
  • Entwicklung eigener Ideen zur technischen Arbeitserleichterung

Qualifikation

Dein Know-how für unseren gemeinschaftlichen Erfolg.

Profil.

IT-Support ist Teamwork. Wir suchen Menschen, die Erfolg als Ergebnis eines starken Kollektivs sehen und sich mit uns kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln möchten. Als IT-Administrator (m/w/d) solltest Du Dich darüber hinaus von den folgenden Punkten angesprochen fühlen:

  • Eigenverantwortliche und serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Gute analytische Fähigkeiten und Offenheit für neue Technologien
  • Kenntnisse in IT-Systemen, Netzwerken und optimalerweise (kein Muss) DATEV-Anwendungen
  • Sorgfalt und Bewusstsein für IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz

Benefits

Du für uns, wir für Dich.

Benefits.

Was für unsere Mandanten zählt, gilt auch für unser Team. Wir haben den Anspruch, einen positiven Einfluss auf die Zukunft unserer Mitmenschen zu haben, und bieten deshalb Benefits, die mehr als „Nice-to-have“ sind. Neben spannenden Tätigkeiten, individuellen Entwicklungschancen und echter Wertschätzung kannst Du Dich bei REVISA auf Folgendes freuen:

  • Attraktive Vergütung gepaart mit einer finanziellen und fachlichen Förderung Deiner Karriere
  • Kurze Wege, durchlässige Strukturen und steile Karrierechancen

title: Junior Data Quality Analyst
descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
As a Junior Data Quality Analyst, you will play a crucial role in safeguarding the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of Kpler’s global commodity market data, with a primary focus on Oil Market Data. Working cross-functionally across business units, you will monitor data health metrics, identify system anomalies, and build actionable dashboards that empower decision-makers. In this role, you will also help pioneer internal workflow automation by experimenting with modern AI-driven tools to streamline data validation and analysis
Key Responsibilities
  • Monitor and safeguard data integrity: Track data quality KPIs across multiple systems to detect inconsistencies, anomalies, and gaps, escalating critical issues to protect global commodity data reliability.
  • Build intuitive visual analytics: Design, deploy, and maintain dynamic BI dashboards and reports to present clear data health insights to key stakeholders.
  • Perform exploratory analysis: Utilize SQL and BI software to investigate datasets, discover underlying patterns, and resolve complex data quality challenges.
  • Drive process automation & AI integration: Streamline data validation workflows by leveraging automation tools, prompt engineering, and modern AI techniques.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner closely with Data Operations, Business Unit Engineers, Data Engineers, and BI teams to align data quality standards with business needs.
  • Conduct root-cause investigations: Address ad-hoc stakeholder inquiries and deliver swift, accurate data analysis to support operational decision-making

    • Experience & Background
  • 1–2 years of hands-on experience in a data-focused role or internship (e.g., Data Analysis, BI, or Data Science).
  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in a quantitative field such as Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Solid foundational SQL skills with the ability to query, filter, aggregate, and join complex tables efficiently.
  • Practical familiarity with Python, GitHub, and spreadsheet tools (Excel or Google Sheets) for data manipulation and profiling.
  • Working experience with modern BI visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and a desire to take end-to-end ownership of data accuracy.

    • Nice-to-haves:

  • Exposure to or strong interest in energy, commodities, or Oil & Gas markets.

title: (Junior-) Sales Development Representative (all genders) Outbound & Messen, B2B SaaS für KMU
descriptionHtml:
Buchhaltung ist für die meisten Gründerinnen und Gründer ein Blackbox-Posten: teuer, langsam, und am Ende weiß niemand genau, wofür er zahlt.
mika ändert das. Wir bauen KI-gestützte Buchhaltung, die Unternehmen selbst in die Hand nehmen können, ohne Steuerberater dazwischen. Belegerfassung, Klassifizierung, E-Rechnung, Validierung und Meldungen laufen automatisiert, statt im Monatsrhythmus über einen externen Schreibtisch zu wandern.
Wir sind 30 Leute, betreuen rund 900 Kunden und haben unsere Seed-Runde frisch abgeschlossen.

Aufgaben
Unser Inbound funktioniert. Leute, die uns finden, überzeugen wir. Was wir jetzt aufbauen, ist die andere Richtung: Gespräche mit Unternehmen, die noch gar nicht wissen, dass ihre Buchhaltung ein lösbares Problem ist.
Genau da sitzt du. Du baust deine Pipeline selbst auf, statt eine fertige zu übernehmen.

Outbound (ca. 50 %)

  • Zielkunden identifizieren und priorisieren: Agenturen, Beratungen, SaaS-Unternehmen und E-Commerce im deutschen Mittelstand

  • Eigene Multichannel-Sequenzen aufsetzen (E-Mail, LinkedIn, Telefon) und laufend gegen Antwortraten optimieren

  • Kaltakquise am Telefon, ohne dass es dir die Woche verdirbt

  • Erste Gespräche führen, in denen du Bedarf überhaupt erst sichtbar machst


Qualifizieren und Abschließen (ca. 40 %)

  • Demo-Anfragen und Trials aus Content, Website und Partnern schnell qualifizieren

  • Kurze Qualifizierungs-Calls führen und die tatsächliche Buchhaltungssituation verstehen: aktuelle Kanzlei, Volumen, Systeme, Schmerzpunkte

  • Produktdemos halten, die auf den konkreten Fall zugeschnitten sind statt auf die Feature-Liste

  • Einwände zu Steuerberater-Wechsel, Haftung und Migration sauber auflösen

  • Abschluss und strukturierte Übergabe an Customer Success


Messen und Events (ca. 10 %)

  • Du bist auf Messen und Startup-Events vor Ort, am Stand und davor

  • Du sprichst Leute an, die nicht vorhaben, mit dir zu sprechen, und machst daraus ein Gespräch

  • Gute Gespräche bringst du direkt zum Abschluss, der Rest geht sauber in die Nachverfolgung


Systeme und Zahlen

  • Pipeline sauber in HubSpot führen

  • Deine Conversion-Raten je Stage kennen und wissen, woran es hakt

  • Einwände, Gewinn- und Verlustgründe dokumentieren, damit das ganze Team daraus lernt


Qualifikation
Wir schauen hier mehr auf Persönlichkeit und Richtung als auf Jahre im Lebenslauf.

  • Erste Vertriebserfahrung: Praktikum, Werkstudium oder ein bis zwei Jahre in einer Sales-Rolle, gerne SaaS, gerne auch aus einer ganz anderen Ecke

  • Wirtschaftlicher Hintergrund aus Studium oder Ausbildung. Du musst kein Steuerexperte sein, aber Begriffe wie Gewerbesteuer, Körperschaftsteuer oder Jahresabschluss sind für dich keine Fremdwörter

  • Du gehst von dir aus auf fremde Menschen zu, am Telefon wie am Messestand, und ein Nein bringt dich nicht aus dem Takt

  • Du willst verkaufen und zwar das hier. Unser Produkt verstehst du in Tagen, nicht in Monaten

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: du weißt zu jedem Zeitpunkt, wo deine Gespräche stehen und warum

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, weil du mit Geschäftsführern über ihre Finanzen sprichst

  • Berlin oder Umzugsbereitschaft



Nice to have

  • Erste eigene Outbound-Erfahrung, Sequenzen von null aufgebaut

  • Erfahrung auf Messen oder im Eventvertrieb

  • Verständnis für Buchhaltung, Steuerberatung oder Fintech-Produkte

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder Sales-Engagement-Tools



Benefits

  • Bis zu 55.000 € Fixgehalt, rund 100.000 € OTE bei guter Zielerreichung, Provision ungedeckelt

  • Ein Produkt mit klarem Kostenvorteil gegenüber dem Status quo

  • Vertriebs- und Kommunikationstraining von Anfang an, du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern, kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Reporting-Schichten

  • Eigene Accounts und eigene Pipeline in dem Bereich, der 2026 das Wachstum trägt

  • Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg, hybrid mit mindestens 3 Tagen im Office

  • Budget für Weiterbildung und Sales-Tooling

  • Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club

  • Deutschlandticket

  • Zugang zu Corporate Benefits und Firmenrabatten



Hiring-Prozess

  1. Intro-Call mit dem Recruiting (~30 Min.) — Kurzer Abgleich zu Rolle, Timing, Erwartungen und Vergütung.

  2. Gespräch mit dem Hiring Manager (~60 Min.) — Wie du an Menschen herangehst, was du bisher verkauft hast, und ein kurzer Probepitch: du pitchst mika, wir spielen den Gegenüber.

  3. Founder-Call (~30 Min.) — Weniger Skills, mehr Werte, Ziele und langfristiger Fit.



Bei mika schätzen wir Vielfalt und arbeiten an einem Umfeld, in dem alle im Team ihr Bestes geben können. Bau mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen für kleine Unternehmen.

title: Lead Database Administrator
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Lead Fullstack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Über Protofy

Wir sind Protofy, die Outcome Agency aus Hamburg, und entwickeln seit über 10 Jahren digitale Produkte, Plattformen und KI-Systeme, die messbar wirken. Technologie ist für uns kein Selbstzweck, sondern ein Business Case, den wir in Umsatz, Effizienz und Wachstum übersetzen.

Deine Rolle

Als technische*r Lead führst Du engagierte Teams und sorgst dafür, dass auch komplexe Projekte pragmatisch, sorgfältig und wirtschaftlich umgesetzt werden. Wir entwickeln Websites und Mobile-Apps für Branchen wie E-Commerce, Wissensmanagement und Sport. Unsere Projekte laufen drei bis neun Monate oder werden als Produkte langfristig weiterentwickelt. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin mit und hast ein sehr gutes Verständnis von Architektur.

Den Entscheider*innenunserer Kund*innen begegnest Du auf Augenhöhe: Du leitest Architekturworkshops eigenständig und unterstützt uns bei Pitches. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleg*innen aus Produkt Designer*innen und Product Owner*innen verantwortest Du Spezifikation, Umsetzung, Testing und Deployment von Features.

Neue Technologien erschließt Du hands-on und machst sie für das Team nutzbar. Außerdem gestaltest Du professionelle Standards in der gesamten Organisation mit, insbesondere für KI-gestützte Entwicklung. Den Großteil Deiner Zeit arbeitest Du selbst im Code, daneben übernimmst Du Führung, Kundenkontakt und Themen der Organisation.

Deine typische Woche

  • Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner*in für die Entscheider*innen unserer Kund*innen und berätst sie strategisch

  • Du unterstützt Pitches, erarbeitest Slides und technische Konzepte und präsentierst sie

  • Du führst Projekte technisch ganzheitlich, von der Architektur bis zum Deployment

  • Du entwirfst neue Funktionen mit Produktmanager*innen und UX-Designer*innen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit Deinem Team um

  • Du baust neue Themen und Technologien hands-on im Projekt auf, z. B. neue Shopsysteme, Frameworks oder Cloud-Provider

  • Du begleitest Dein Team, gibst regelmäßig Feedback und förderst Deine Kolleg*innen durch Tech-Mentoring

  • Du gestaltest Entwicklungsprozesse pragmatisch mit, insbesondere KI-gestützte Entwicklung (Tools, Workflows, Qualitätssicherung)

  • Du behältst die Wirtschaftlichkeit im Blick: Du schätzt Aufwände, achtest auf Budgets und unterstützt das Projektmanagement

  • Du entwickelst die gesamte Organisation aktiv mit

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Web- oder App-Entwicklung

  • Du hast 4+ Jahre Erfahrung als Tech Lead bzw. in der technischen Führung von Teams

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit React sowie in Node.js, Flutter oder Kotlin

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der technischen Verantwortung mittelgroßer Projekte (500+ Personentage)

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Application Architecture und begleitest Teams dabei, Anwendungen auf der grünen Wiese aufzusetzen

  • Du kannst Projekte ganzheitlich technisch führen

  • Du behältst auch in intensiven Projektphasen einen klaren Kopf und gehst gelassen mit Unsicherheit um

  • Du übernimmst gern Verantwortung über Deine eigene Arbeit hinaus und lernst gern Neues

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch

Deine ersten Monate bei Protofy

In deinen ersten Wochen wirst du dich in unsere bestehenden Projekte und Architekturkonzepte einarbeiten und erste Features für unsere Kund*innen umsetzen. Du tauschst dich eng mit dem Team aus und übernimmst schrittweise die Verantwortung für die technische Ausrichtung von Web-Anwendungen. Wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen auf Anhieb erfüllst, aber das nötige Fundament mitbringst, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Das bieten wir dir

Dich erwartet ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag bei einer wöchentlichen Arbeitszeit von 40 Stunden und einer Probezeit von 6 Monaten sowie 29 Urlaubstagen im Jahr. Wir unterstützen deine berufliche Bildung und bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit zum vollständigen Remote-Arbeiten oder im Homeoffice, wofür wir dir eine passende Home-Office-Ausstattung und einen Firmenlaptop zur Verfügung stellen. Zusätzlich profitierst du von Betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, einem Fitnessabo, einer Entschädigung für Reisekosten, Vorteilen bei öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, einem Sabbatical, Unterstützung der psychischen Gesundheit, Mitarbeiterrabatten sowie regelmäßigen Teamevents und Firmenfeiern. Vor Ort oder remote erwarten dich zudem kostenlose Getränke, kostenlose Snacks, eine lockere Kleiderordnung und die Möglichkeit, Haustiere mitzubringen.

Vergütung

Unser Gehaltsrahmen für diese Position liegt bei EUR 77,500–90,000 per year.

title: Lead Plant Robotics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Lead Plant Robotics Engineer to develop the manufacturing solutions that allow us to mass-produce solid rocket motors. As the lead, you will own the robotic handling strategy for our pilot plant, from the first layout concept through commissioning and scale-up, and you will lead the robotics team.

This is a unique opportunity to define how rockets are built at scale. The pilot plant is the blueprint for the production lines that follow, and the robotic cells you lead will handle containers, motor casings and energetic materials every day.

About us

We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility, and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you're ready to rise to the challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the robotics architecture of the pilot plant: robot selection, cell layouts, end-effectors, and handling concepts for buckets, transport boxes, motor casings and carriers.

  • Lead the development of robotic handling solutions for dosing, mixing, casting, curing and demolding stations, including the explosion-protection concept (enclosure, pressure-resistant encapsulation or ATEX-certified equipment).

  • Define robotics requirements for the full line and manage the interfaces with automation, process engineering, ERP/MES and external integrators.

  • Lead the robotics engineering team and external suppliers, including specification, tendering, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT).

  • Drive cycle-time, throughput and availability targets using offline programming, simulation and data from the pilot line.

  • Lead the risk assessment and safety concept for robotic cells together with safety engineering (Machinery Directive, ISO 10218, ISO 13849).

What we are looking for

  • Significant professional experience (typically 3+ years) designing and commissioning industrial robotic systems, ideally in manufacturing or process environments.

  • Lead-level experience: you have led technical teams or acted as technical authority on a robotic project from concept to production.

  • Strong knowledge of industrial robot platforms (ideally ABB, Fanuc), including programming, offline programming and simulation.

  • Solid understanding of machine safety (Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC, ISO 10218, ISO 13849) and of structured risk assessment.

  • A hands-on engineering mindset: you can move from a concept sketch to a CAD layout, and you can debug a cell on the shop floor.

  • The ability to work with autonomy and at pace, and to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A degree in robotics, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may also be relevant.

Desirable experience

  • Robotic handling in explosion-protected or hazardous environments (Directive 2014/34/EU, TRGS 720 ff.), or with powders, pastes or chemicals.

  • Vision systems, force-torque sensing, or automated quality checks (X-ray or CT integration).

  • Multi-robot coordination, gantry systems, or AGV integration at production scale.

  • Experience with manufacturing execution systems (MES) and PLC integration.

  • Experience building production capability from zero in a startup or scale-up environment.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

 

Compensation: €80K – €100K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Manager: Compliance Advisory (and Data Protection)
descriptionHtml:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

You'll join our Service guild and work across first line operations, sales and produt. Working closely with Protect (our second line) you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance solutions look like. Then implement them , keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow.

The opportunity

We want compliance and data protection built into how we design, sell and run our products, not bolted at the end.

As our hands on compliance adviser in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into.

Compliance advisory is the heart of this role and will take around 70% of your time. You’ll also pick up a smaller, complementary slice of work as our Data Protection Officer (DPO), around 30% of your time. DPO experience is a plus but not essential, and we’ll train you if you need it.

What success looks like

In your first year, compliance advisory is where you’ve made your mark. You’ve sought out our operations, sales and product teams and shown them that working with you makes things smoother, not slower. Now they bring you in early by default. You’ve guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. You’ve put clear governance and outcome monitoring in place for our live products, so Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation.

Alongside that, in the smaller DPO part of your role, you’ve taken ownership of our data protection agenda. You’ve gone looking for ways to improve, made the changes happen, and given our senior leaders an honest picture of where we stand.

To do this you'll be involved in:

Compliance advisory (around 70% of your time)

  • Product development: turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments, from first idea through product approval to launch, with data protection built in from the start.

  • Product lifecycle management: keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures.

  • Sales: helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material.

  • Marketing: working on marketing materials, both ours and our customers’, to make sure they comply with regulation and our own policies, and that our financial promotions are properly challenged.

  • Service (Operations): building regulatory and data protection requirements into how Service works day to day, with procedures and controls people actually use.

  • Regulatory change: working out what new rules mean for us, and making sure the right teams make the right changes on time.

  • Issues and reporting: investigating and fixing compliance issues, including personal data breaches, and reporting clearly on compliance risks and customer outcomes.

  • Working with second line (Protect): bringing them in early, sharing the evidence they need, and acting on their challenge.

Data Protection Officer (around 30% of your time - training will be provided if needed)

Being our DPO means:

  • advising our teams on their obligations, including data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) and transfer risk assessments (TRAs)

  • monitoring how well we comply with the UK GDPR, other global data protection laws and our own policies

  • training colleagues and raising awareness of data protection

  • being our contact point for the ICO and for people with questions or requests about their data

As our DPO, you’ll report directly to our COO and have the independence you need to do the job well. We’ll involve you early in anything that affects personal data.

We expect you to shape this role: This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

We need a proactive compliance doer first and foremost. You get stuck in without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable tackling regulations you haven’t met before. You use your experience and expertise to help our teams find simple, clear and compliant solutions. Your advice is balanced, easy to follow and focused on the risks that matter most. You want to push the business forward, and you see good compliance as part of how we get there.

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • Compliance experience in the first (preferred) or second line of a UK regulated firm, ideally a bank, e-money institution or payments firm.

  • Practical knowledge of the rules behind our products, like Consumer Duty, BCOBS, CASS, FISMA, the Payment Services Regulations and the Money Laundering Regulations. As well as familiarity with HMRC requirements like BBSI and AEOI reporting.

  • Hands-on experience turning regulation into practical requirements for product, sales or operations teams.

  • An openness to picking up data protection as part of the role: a genuine interest is enough, DPO experience isn’t required.

  • A curious, questioning approach. You know the right questions to ask before signing something off, not just the rules to check it against.

  • The confidence to challenge, clearly and kindly, when something isn’t right.

  • A love of writing. We have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write).

Ideally, you would also:

  • Have deep expertise in at least one specialist area, such as payments, cards, Consumer Duty, BCOBS, financial promotions or similar.

  • Have been a DPO, or worked closely with one, in a regulated firm.

  • Have worked in finance or banking.

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Salary: £ 80-90 (DOE)

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks

How long will the process take?

We move as fast as possible, but it normally takes us about 2-3 weeks to get to know to each other.

  • Step 1: An initial phone call with our Talent Team for us to tell you more about Griffin and learn about your recent experience.

  • Step 2: Meet your manager to talk through your experience and how that relates to the requirements.

  • Step 3: A task based on what you’ll be doing on a day to day at Griffin.

  • Step 4: Meet with peers in your team for a more in-depth technical interview.

  • Step 5: Culture and Founder interview: Learn more about this here.

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team.

Any CVs sent to any member of our team on a speculative basis will not be recognised and we will not accept liability for any fee or commission should we subsequently employ a candidate who applied to us directly or was introduced by an instructed agency that may also have been submitted speculatively by an uninstructed agency.
