title: Mechanical Engineer – Design & Simulation (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

About the Role

As a Mechanical Engineer – Design & Simulation, you’ll perform engineering analysis and simulation work across Focused Energy projects, helping design and validate complex mechanical systems before hardware is committed. You’ll provide the analytical confidence needed to make sound design decisions across structural, thermal, dynamic, and fluid-system performance.

Working closely with senior mechanical engineers, systems engineers, project teams, and other engineering disciplines, you’ll use modelling and simulation to identify design risks early, recommend mitigations, and ensure mechanical designs are technically sound, manufacturable, safe, and ready for integration. Your work will contribute to systems including vacuum chambers, laser integration, diagnostic structures, and facility infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform structural, mechanical, and thermal analysis using FEA tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL, or equivalent.

  • Carry out fluid-system analysis and thermal modelling to support mechanical design decisions.

  • Assess vibration, stability, and dynamic behaviour of mechanical assemblies and identify potential design risks.

  • Validate simulation outputs against design requirements, engineering standards, and expected operating conditions.

  • Translate analysis results into practical design recommendations that improve performance, safety, manufacturability, and system compatibility.

  • Develop and maintain 3D CAD models and engineering drawings using Autodesk Inventor or a similar tool.

  • Define and execute verification activities, prepare analysis reports, and provide simulation evidence for design reviews.

  • Collaborate with mechanical, systems, and project engineering teams to define interfaces, communicate results, and support multidisciplinary design decisions.

Who You Are

  • You are an analytical and technically rigorous mechanical engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems through modelling and simulation.

  • You take a methodical approach to setting up analyses, checking assumptions, interpreting results, and documenting conclusions.

  • You can translate complex simulation outputs into clear, actionable engineering decisions.

  • You identify design risks early and proactively propose practical mitigation strategies.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, adapting the level of detail to the audience.

  • You collaborate effectively across mechanical, systems, and project engineering disciplines.

  • You take ownership of the quality, traceability, and accuracy of your analysis work and design evidence.

  • You are detail-oriented and committed to applying sound engineering fundamentals and standards consistently.

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Experience performing structural, thermal, dynamic, and fluid-system analysis in a professional mechanical engineering environment.

  • Proficiency with FEA tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL, or equivalent, together with experience validating and documenting simulation results.

  • Experience with 3D CAD tools, preferably Autodesk Inventor, and the ability to connect analysis outputs with practical mechanical design decisions.

  • Knowledge of CFD tools such as ANSYS Fluent or OpenFOAM, vacuum or cryogenic mechanical systems, laser or optical integration, or scientific instrumentation.

  • Familiarity with design for manufacture and assembly (DFMA), prototype build and commissioning support, verification planning, and engineering documentation in experimental or multidisciplinary environments.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

title: Modelling Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Software organisation at Fractile

PerfSim sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing.

About the team and role

To build hardware that doesn't yet exist, you first have to model it — with precision, depth, and an eye for the trade-offs that matter. At Fractile, high-fidelity pre-silicon models shape our architecture, performance, and product design long before hardware exists. The Simulation team includes C++ and SystemC specialists, verification and validation engineers, system architects, and embedded engineers. This is not a support function — it is the group that defines how Fractile's hardware behaves.

As a Modelling Engineer you will develop the pre-silicon models of Fractile's AI acceleration hardware, enabling architectural exploration and definition, functional modelling, performance modelling and bottleneck analysis, and early software development on virtual platforms. You will work closely with hardware, software, and ML teams in a true hardware–software co-design loop.

About you

You have a genuine curiosity for hard problems and the depth to operate across architecture, performance, and functional correctness. You understand that the models you build will shape the architecture of Fractile's accelerator, determine performance trade-offs, enable early runtime and compiler development, unblock software teams months before silicon exists, and reduce risk across the entire product lifecycle. You take that responsibility seriously and bring the rigour it demands.

Key Requirements

  • Experience in pre-silicon modelling of complex semiconductor IP

  • SystemC or equivalent modelling frameworks

  • C++ for high-performance simulation

  • Performance modelling and architectural analysis

  • Verification and functional modelling

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ML workloads or ML accelerator architectures

  • Prior startup or small-team experience

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Offensive Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Shape our offensive security services

Ready to immerse yourself in the world of securing critical IT by thinking and acting like a real adversary? Join our security team at Schuberg Philis! We are an engineering company with a people-centric approach and a focus on customer satisfaction, dedicated to delivering mission critical IT solutions to our customers.

As an offensive security specialist, you will collaborate with about 30 customer-oriented teams managing critical system environments. Your role is pivotal in ensuring the security of Schuberg Philis and its customers by identifying and exploiting realistic paths in our complex, one-of-a-kind environments. You will scope, execute, and report on penetration tests, purple and red teaming engagements, and threat modeling assessments tailored to our unique and complex mission-critical environments. We focus on what real-world adversaries search for and abuse, not compliance-driven checks that look good on paper but don't raise resilience.

You will engage closely with engineers, customer teams, external experts, vendors, and stakeholders to define and drive work that measurably strengthens these environments. The engagements are hands-on and technical, and we want someone who can own an engagement end-to-end: from a customer saying "we want to test something, can you help us figure out what?" all the way to presenting the results of a bespoke engagement to their board.

At Schuberg Philis, we thrive on growth and innovation, offering an exciting environment for security enthusiasts. We are actively seeking security professionals at various seniority levels to join our security team. We provide a challenging and rewarding atmosphere where autonomy in your day-to-day operations is valued.

We are a small team and we are part of the team that works on our value propositions for security. This means we have a lot of mandate to define and shape offensive security services within Schuberg Philis.

In this role, you will work with cutting-edge technologies, spanning private and public clouds and VMs to serverless - all highly automated. As an offensive security specialist your skills will be put to the test in a diverse technological landscape.

Success in this role requires a unique blend of skills and traits

  • 7+ years of experience (the more the better) in an offensive security role.
  • A security mindset aimed at identifying realistic attack paths from a real-world adversaries' perspective.
  • Giving security advice that fits the unique and challenging mission-critical environments we manage to help our teams set up strong defense-in-depth. Recommendations should fit the environment in front of you, not a textbook fix that can't be applied there.
  • You will have the experience and judgment to run engagements on your own, and the collaborative instinct to tackle the hardest problems together. Our teams will love you if you can take them by the hand through the entire process.
  • Experience and understanding at least one of the major clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Strong risk management thinking, sense of ownership, and a solid BS radar.
  • Eagerness to learn, coupled with a stubborn determination to make things happen.
  • Experience with building solid tools that support our activities.
  • Experience in IT engineering and IT engineering heavy environments preferred.


What will be your focus?

  • Help scope, lead, execute, and report on various types of complex offensive security engagements. Every environment is unique, and we expect our engagements to treat them as such as well.
  • Build and maintain tools to help scale our offensive security services well beyond a small team. As an example: by building and maintaining a secure AI penetration testing methodology and toolkit that can be used by our customer teams.
  • Collaborating with all customer teams, offering guidance on security-related topics.
  • Evaluating and improving the security resilience of Schuberg Philis itself through red and purple teaming engagements.
  • Using your technical and soft skills to guide the organization in adopting security measures along with the broader security team. We show impact, and can help limit it.


Where we would love to grow as a team
We care more about mindset, experience, and being calm under pressure than a checklist of specific technologies. Our best work comes from people who can rely on experience and the right mindset to tackle the unfamiliar. However, if you bring depth in advanced malware development, Kubernetes, or OT security, you'll find eager sparring partners and plenty of room to make those areas your own.

Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. 

It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.

descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

A strong partner ecosystem is crucial to the success and growth of Kong's business. Partners are a strategic imperative for Kong's continued growth and market expansion. As customer requirements become more complex, we need partners with the capability and capacity to help customers implement, support and grow their usage of Kong. We work closely with cross-functional leadership to ensure partners are integrated throughout the sales cycle, both pre- and post-sale.

The Partner Sales Director owns Kong's partner business within the DACH territory. That means recruiting the right partners, building a real go-to-market motion with them, and driving sourced incremental revenue, not slideware pipeline. The PSD is the single point of contact for anything partner-related: for field sellers who need partner help on a deal, for partners who need a path into Kong, and for leadership setting regional strategy. The ecosystem spans channel resellers, technology partners, GSIs, and hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP), and the PSM works across all four. At the Intermediate level and above, this is a senior individual contributor role: the PSD runs their territory as their own business, in close partnership with the territory's sales leader.

Responsibilities

  • Own the partner revenue number for your assigned territory. Sell Kong's full portfolio (products, renewals, professional services, and support) through and with focus partners.

  • Build the joint go-to-market plan with your territory's sales team. Identify and sign new partners where there are gaps.

  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline: set targets, run the cadence, and hold partners (and yourself) accountable to them, favoring net-new sourced business over tagging partners onto deals you'd close anyway.

  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline by coordinating deal registration, lead sharing, and co-selling motions for Kong Gateway, Kong AI Gateway, Kong Mesh, and Konnect.

  • Build joint assets with focus partners, such as reference architectures, blueprints, and solution briefs that field teams on both sides actually use.

  • Build a focus partner plan for your territory and execute it alongside sales engineering, SDRs, customer success, and marketing.

Could that be you?

title: Patient Support Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
At Montu UK, our Patient Support Coordinators do much more than answer calls. They play an important role in supporting patients who rely on us for their treatment, care and ongoing wellbeing.

This is a demanding but incredibly rewarding position, where the conversations you have can make a genuine difference to someone's life. Many of our patients are living with complex, chronic or debilitating medical conditions, and we recognise that accessing treatment can sometimes be an emotional and challenging experience.

We are looking for people who genuinely care about others, who have the patience to listen, the resilience to manage difficult conversations and the ability to provide compassionate, professional support in a busy environment.

This is not a traditional customer service role. It requires empathy, emotional intelligence and a genuine commitment to patient care. For the right person, it is an opportunity to be part of something meaningful, where every conversation has the potential to make a difference.

What is the job?

As a Patient Support Coordinator, you will be one of the first points of contact for patients accessing treatment through Montu UK.

This is a predominantly telephone-based role, handling approximately 450 calls each week. You will support patients with a wide range of enquiries, from appointment bookings and treatment-related administration to more complex and sensitive situations requiring patience, understanding and reassurance.

No two conversations will be the same. Some patients may be anxious, frustrated or distressed, and you will need to remain calm, professional and compassionate while finding practical solutions to their concerns.

The role requires you to balance a high volume of calls with delivering a consistently high standard of patient care. It can be challenging, but the support you provide has a direct impact on the patient experience and their confidence in accessing treatment.

This is a fully remote, UK-based position, working 40 hours per week across five days. Shifts are either 7:30am to 4:30pm or 9:30am to 6:30pm, with Saturday working required as part of the five-day working week.

We are looking for someone who understands the demands of a busy patient-facing environment and takes genuine pride in providing care and support to those who need it.

What will you be doing?

  • Managing a high volume of inbound and outbound patient calls, approximately 450 per week

  • Supporting patients with a wide range of enquiries, including complex, sensitive and emotionally challenging situations

  • Providing reassurance, guidance and practical support throughout the patient journey

  • Booking appointments, completing documentation and resolving patient queries accurately and efficiently

  • Managing difficult conversations with empathy, patience and professionalism

  • Working closely with our Clinical and Pharmacy teams to ensure patients receive timely support and continuity of care

  • Maintaining accurate patient records and ensuring compliance with GDPR and internal procedures

  • Balancing call volumes and performance expectations while maintaining a compassionate and patient-centred approach

What do you need?

  • Previous experience in a high-volume, telephone-based customer service, contact centre or patient support environment

  • Experience handling complex enquiries and managing difficult or emotionally challenging conversations

  • Genuine empathy, patience and a strong desire to help others

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to listen actively and adapt your approach to different situations

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to remain calm and professional under pressure

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Confidence using multiple systems, with excellent attention to detail

  • The ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining connected to a wider team

Previous healthcare experience would be beneficial, but what matters most is your attitude, resilience and genuine commitment to supporting patients.

Why join Montu UK?

  • Meaningful work: Make a genuine difference to patients living with complex medical conditions

  • Remote working: Work from home within the UK

  • Annual leave: 25 days, increasing to 27 days after one year and 30 days after two years, plus bank holidays

  • Pension: Employer matching contributions of up to 5%

  • Career development: Opportunities to learn, develop and progress within a growing healthcare organisation

  • Patient-centred purpose: Be part of a business dedicated to improving access to treatment and patient care

About Montu UK

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments.

Our mission is to improve patients' lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring people receive the support they need throughout their treatment journey.

As our patient community continues to grow, our Patient Support team remains central to the care and experience we provide. Every conversation matters, and every member of the team has an important part to play.

Compensation: £27K

title: Photonics Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Overview

This role will focus on the design, optimisation, and development of high performance photonic components for next generation Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs), contributing directly to our future tape-outs and core IP roadmap.

You will work closely with photonics designers, layout engineers, and testing teams to improve the performance of integrated photonic devices through theoretical analysis, simulation, modelling, and design innovation.

This is a highly technical role suited to someone who enjoys solving difficult physics and engineering problems in a collaborative deep-tech environment. You will contribute to the development of key building blocks within our optical switching and photonic systems roadmap, and other integrated photonic components critical to future high port count architectures.

Depending on experience, we are open to candidates at Senior, Lead, or Principal level.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and optimise integrated photonic components for silicon photonics and related PIC platforms

  • Perform electromagnetic simulations, modelling, and theoretical analysis to improve device performance

  • Validate simulation results against experimental measurement data

  • Develop innovative component designs informed by current research and emerging techniques

  • Collaborate with layout engineers to integrate components into PDK libraries and tape-out flows

  • Work closely with fabrication and testing teams to iterate on device performance

  • Contribute to the development roadmap for future photonic components and architectures

  • Support long term improvements in PIC loss, manufacturability, and scalability

  • Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and cross functional problem solving

  • Stay current with advances in integrated photonics through research literature and conferences

What we're looking for

  • PhD, or equivalent industry experience, in Photonics, Physics, Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field

  • Strong theoretical understanding of guided optics and photonic device physics

  • Hands-on experience designing and simulating integrated photonic components

  • Experience working with silicon photonics or InP photonic platforms

  • Strong analytical and mathematical problem solving capability

  • A track record of meaningful technical contributions, whether through publications, patents, or shipped technology

  • Experience using photonic simulation tools and modelling workflows

  • Python programming experience for simulation, analysis, or automation

  • Deep understanding of Photonic IC design and fabrication flows

  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes

  • Experience working in commercial R&D or product development environments

  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail

  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams

You will join a highly ambitious deep-tech company operating at the intersection of AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and photonics. We are building foundational technology with the potential to reshape the performance envelope of future AI systems.

Alongside a collaborative and research-driven environment, you will have the opportunity to work on genuinely difficult engineering problems with direct impact on product direction and company growth.

If you're excited by integrated photonics, advanced device design, and solving hard engineering problems at the frontier of AI infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

descriptionHtml:
Consumer PR - Account Director
Large Beauty FMCG 

Department: Consumer PR & Influence 
Location: London 
Contract type: 12-Month FTC

Reporting into: Business Director 
 
 

About Ogilvy:  

Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. The agency specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fueled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Lloyds Banking Group, Madri, Unilever and Mondelēz International. 

Ogilvy’s influencer marketing practice is the largest globally and the agency also hosts the world’s biggest festival of behavioural science and creativity, Nudgestock – which is now in its 12th year. James Murphy is the CEO of Ogilvy Group UK, which includes Ogilvy UK and New Commercial Arts (NCA), a boutique creative agency he co-founded in 2020, recently acquired by WPP. 
 
  

The Role:  
As Account Director, you'll champion "earned first" thinking to create impactful, culturally relevant consumer PR campaigns. You'll lead a team, build strong client relationships, and drive innovative strategies that generate buzz and deliver measurable results. This role is fun and energetic, offering great opportunities to learn and develop with a variety of complex but rewarding clients. You will be responsible for fostering a positive and collaborative work environment within the account management team, encouraging open communication and constructive feedback. You will manage relationships with third-party vendors, to ensure the agency delivers high-quality work that meets client expectations. You will also act as a liaison between the client and the agency's internal teams, providing clear communication and direction to ensure all parties are aligned on project goals and timelines. You can see opportunity in risk and you’re not afraid to be brave and challenge your clients to want to achieve a better result for all. 
  
 

Key Responsibilities:  

  • Inspire & Lead: Mentor a team to develop and execute breakthrough, "earned first" PR & Influence campaigns. 
  • Client Partnership: Build trusted advisor relationships with clients, understanding their business and anticipating their needs. Guide them across media and social communications. 
  • Creative Strategy: Collaborate with creative teams to develop compelling narratives and assets that resonate with target audiences.

  • Crisis Management: Develop and implement crisis management plans to protect client reputation. 
  • Inclusivity: Champion inclusiveness, diversity, and equity in all aspects of work.

  • Extensive experience in consumer PR and influence, with a proven track record of driving successful campaigns.

  • Interest and desire across beauty and FMCG projects

  • Share and use media knowledge to guide clients on what you believe is the best for their brand 
  • Deep understanding of consumer behavior and ability to develop creative strategies that resonate with target audiences. 
  • Demonstrated ability to think "earned first" and create campaigns that generate organic buzz. 
  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.  
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. 
  • Data-driven mindset and analytical skills. 
  • Knowledge of industry trends and best practices. 
  • Experience in crisis management. 

  • Champion inclusiveness, diversity, and equity in all aspects of work.
     

How we help you Thrive:

title: Principal Engineer - Platform
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We want our engineers to ship regulated medical software as fast as AI now lets them write it. Our software includes medical device software, holds members’ health data and keeps our clinics running, so every change has to be tested, traceable and ready for an auditor, and that is what makes this problem hard and worth solving.

 

You’ll build the shared AI engineering platform that makes it possible, setting the architecture and writing much of it yourself: a golden path that makes the best way to build with AI the default for every team, agents that do real engineering work end to end, and a pipeline that proves compliance on every change instead of documents written after the fact. This is a director-level individual contributor role, one of the first Principal Engineer roles in our software organisation, working directly with our Chief Software Officer. You make the key calls on which agents and tools we build or adopt, and you take on the hardest problems across teams, some of which reach clinic devices and the test rigs that recreate a scan room.

 

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • 0→1 set the target architecture for the AI engineering platform, including the build or adopt decisions on agents, orchestration and developer tooling

  • Ship a golden path for AI-assisted engineering, with shared context, tools and guardrails, that teams choose because it is the fastest way to ship

  • Put agents to work on real engineering jobs end to end, such as feature implementation, code migrations, automated review and on-call triage

  • Run agents in sandboxed environments with audit trails and clear separation from member health data

  • Shorten the path from merged code to production for regulated software: safe releases, fast rollback, and compliance evidence produced by the pipeline

  • Measure what changes with numbers engineers trust, such as the share of agent pull requests that get merged and how long a change takes to reach production, and share them openly

  • Take on the hardest cross-team technical problems, inside and beyond the platform, where no one has the answer yet

 

Minimum Qualifications

  • You have designed and built platforms or core infrastructure that other engineers relied on every day, and you wrote a meaningful part of the code yourself

  • Deep backend and distributed systems experience in production, with the judgement to make architecture calls in a large, existing codebase

  • Your own engineering is AI-first: you use agents for work you used to do by hand, and can explain where they help, where they fail, and what changed in speed and quality

  • You take a clear position on hard technical questions with incomplete information, defend it with reasons, and change it when the evidence changes

  • Engineers outside your own team changed how they work because of something you built and the technical case you made for it

  • Able to work from our London, New York or Stockholm office

     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with durable workflow orchestration, for example Temporal or Azure Durable Functions, and a clear view on when it is worth it, since long-running agent work has to survive failure

  • Work where software meets hardware or physical operations, such as connected devices, edge computing or hardware-in-the-loop testing

title: Principal Field Engineer, US Remote
descriptionHtml:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

Our Solutions Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers are aligned to accounts, segments and Account Executives. This role isn't. As a Principal Field Engineer, you work across the whole business: every region, every segment, presales and post-sales. Your job is to make Exa impossible to ignore for developers and technical buyers, and to make every Field Engineer better at showing what Exa can do.

You'll build the demos, workshops and on-demand training the team and our customers use everywhere, take Exa on the road to conferences, meetups and user groups, and become the go-to expert the team pulls in when a deal or a customer needs someone who knows Exa inside out. You'll spend a lot of time where developers are, and a lot of time on a plane. This is not a slideware role. You are an engineer who builds, teaches and shows.

In this role, you will:

  • Build the demos the whole team uses: flagship demos, sample apps, cookbooks and reference architectures that show Exa on real problems, and keep them current as the product ships

  • Design and deliver workshops, hands-on labs and technical webinars for prospects, customers and developer communities, and package them so any Field Engineer can run them

  • Create on-demand training content: video tutorials, self-paced courses and recorded labs that teach customers, developers and new Field Engineers how to build with Exa, without anyone in the room

  • Represent Exa at events: conference talks, booth demos, hackathons and partner events, in person, wherever the audience is

  • Start and run meetups and user groups in key cities, and grow a community of developers building with Exa

  • Be the team's subject-matter expert on Exa's products, search quality, evals and agent use cases; join key deals and customer escalations when SAs and FDEs need deeper help

  • Turn new launches into field-ready material: demos, talk tracks and competitive positioning, so the team can sell what Product ships on day one

  • Partner with Marketing on technical content, blog posts and events that generate pipeline

  • Bring what you hear back to Product: what developers try to build, where they get stuck, and what competitors are doing

Requirements

  • Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can build polished demos and sample apps from scratch, fast, and you enjoy it

  • 4+ years in a technical customer-facing role (solutions architect, sales engineer, developer advocate or similar), ideally at an AI-native, API or developer-first company

  • A track record of teaching and presenting to technical audiences: talks, workshops, webinars, video tutorials or community events

  • Strong communication skills: you can hold a room of engineers, then explain the same thing simply to an executive

  • Self-directed: you can set your own priorities without a segment or a quota to tell you where to go

  • Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time, including internationally

You might excel if you...

  • Have spoken at developer conferences, run a meetup, or built a community around a technical product

  • Have built with LLMs, RAG or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality

  • Have a following or a body of public work: open-source projects, technical blog posts, talks, videos

  • Love the moment a room full of developers sees a demo and gets it

  • Thrive in early-stage environments where your job description changes monthly

  • Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

This is a remote role based in the US, with travel to events, customers and our San Francisco HQ. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

At Unmind, we're here to create better mental health.

We believe mental health should be a source of strength, not struggle – for people, teams, and entire organisations.

We combine science, technology, and human care to help companies like Uber, Disney, Major League Baseball, and the NHS improve mental health and drive performance.

Now we’re looking for more brilliant people to help us do it.

🚀 Our Values

We’re building a company where ambition and empathy go hand in hand.

Outpace the rest – Move fast. Deliver excellence.

Stronger together – We go further, faster, together.

Client first – We win, when our clients win.

🌈 Inclusion & Belonging

We’re building a place where everyone feels seen, heard, and supported – and where difference is celebrated.

If you need adjustments during the process, tell us when you apply or email Learn more about how we hire and our commitment to equity in our Candidate FAQ →

🎯 The Role — Principal Information Security & Data Protection Officer

Working closely with Commercial, Engineering, Product and Legal to lead Unmind's Information Security and Data Protection programmes and act as Unmind's designated Data Protection Officer (DPO). We process health information at scale, so trust is central to what we offer. We're looking for a hands-on, senior individual contributor who can own both disciplines end to end and give the business clear, practical advice.

This role sets security and privacy requirements, advises and assures.

Overall responsibility for;

Information Security

  • the management of Information Security within the business;

  • maintaining ISO 27001:2022 and Cyber Essentials certification, chairing the ISMS Board and running the ISMS day to day – policies, risk management, controls, evidence and internal audits;

  • liaising with Engineering, Product and Data & AI on information security threats and vulnerabilities and recommending mitigations;

  • Information Security incident management and remediation;

  • managing the Application and Infrastructure penetration testing and vulnerability management process, tracking findings to closure;

  • leading AI governance operations, including the AI policy and register, AI use-case risk reviews and readiness for ISO 42001;

  • managing the Information Security pre-sales, RFP and contractual process, and keeping trust materials in Conveyor current;

  • managing the business's security education and awareness training programme;

  • reporting information security compliance and risk to ELT and the Board.

Data Protection Officer

  • performing the statutory duties of the DPO under UK and EU GDPR, including acting as the contact point for the ICO and other data protection authorities;

  • maintaining Unmind's privacy framework, including privacy notices and retention;

  • advising on privacy for new products, suppliers and AI use cases, including coordinating DPIAs;

  • managing data subject rights requests and personal data breach assessments;

  • leading privacy review of DPAs and client assurance with Legal and Commercial, and reporting data protection risk to ELT and the Board.

🌟 About You

We know great people come from all sorts of backgrounds, and we want to make sure we’re focusing on what really matters. We welcome applications from people with different experiences and perspectives, while recognising that certain qualifications are essential for this role. You’ll find these outlined below.

ESSENTIAL:

  • Experience of implementing and maintaining ISO 27001 certification within a global technology business;

  • Expert practical knowledge of UK and EU GDPR, including DPIAs, rights requests, personal data breaches, and international transfers;

  • Experience acting as, or working closely alongside, a Data Protection Officer;

  • Confident client-facing presence, able to explain Unmind's data security and privacy approach clearly to prospective and existing clients;

  • Experience advising engineering and product teams on mitigation solutions for application and infrastructure security risks;

  • Sound understanding of AI-related security and privacy risks;

  • Ability to give clear, independent advice and challenge to senior leaders;

  • Commitment and attention to detail;

  • Able to manage multiple competing requests across the business, prioritising by risk and deadline;

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Credible and behaves with the highest levels of integrity.

DESIRED:

  • Experience with health or other special category data, or digital wellbeing products;

  • Experience in a high growth business environment;

  • Familiarity with ISO 27701 and ISO 42001;

  • A recognised security or privacy certification (such as CISSP, CISM, CIPP/E or CIPM), or equivalent practical experience.

Tip for candidates: If you’re unsure whether to apply – do. We know great people don't always tick every box.

title: Principal Penetration Tester
descriptionHtml:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place. 

About the Role: 

Our Professional Services Team is seeking Associate Principal OT Penetration Tester who will provide technical leadership across vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and adversary emulation activities supporting customer services engagements. You will shape engagement strategy and uncover real‑world attack paths across ICS/OT networks through hands‑on exploitation and deep technical analysis, working closely with customers across critical infrastructure sectors such as oil and gas, electric, water treatment, and manufacturing. You will also translate findings into clear, actionable remediation guidance, influencing detection and platform development. You will mentor team members and be an advisor and representative of Dragos within the broader OT security community.

Responsibilities: 

  • Serve as primary technical lead and trusted advisor for Dragos’s most complex, high-impact industrial penetration testing, purple teaming, and vulnerability assessment engagements, shaping engagement direction and aligning deep technical execution with client business goals.
  • Set the technical bar for OT penetration testing excellence by defining methodologies, assessment frameworks, and red team tactics informed by threat intelligence and adversary emulation. Design and lead offensive campaigns modeled on known and unknown TTPs to uncover complex attack paths across IT/OT boundaries and within industrial environments.
  • Translate hands-on findings into strategic R&D priorities, guiding the development of proprietary tools, behavioral analytics, and detection content by identifying gaps in visibility, response, and prevention in customer environments.
  • Evolve internal playbooks, runbooks, and operating procedures, applying field lessons, threat intelligence, and emerging adversary behaviors to improve the efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness of the penetration testing practice.
  • Engage executive stakeholders, internally and externally, with strategic cybersecurity guidance, risk prioritization, and remediation recommendations tied to business objectives, delivering clear, authoritative presentations to C-suites, boards, and technical leadership.
  • Represent Dragos as an industry thought leader through original research, top-tier conference presentations, whitepapers, and public engagements that advance OT security with unique insights and innovation.
  • Mentor engineering, threat intelligence, and consulting teams across functions, cultivating future leaders and a culture of continuous learning, technical curiosity, and mission-driven execution.

Qualifications: 

  • 8+ years of hands-on cybersecurity experience in vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, or red teaming within the OT space, with in-depth knowledge of OT penetration testing methodologies in white, gray, and black-box contexts.
  • Deep understanding of OT-specific architectures and services, including DCS, historians, SCADA networks, transmission/distribution management, AMI, related communication protocols, and other control systems.
  • Extensive knowledge of OT cyber threats, attack paths, exploits, and adversary TTPs.
  • Hands-on experience with offensive security tooling such as Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, Cobalt Strike, Burp Suite, common LOTL toolsets, and C2 frameworks.
  • Advanced experience with networking components (routers, switches, load balancers, firewalls), plus the ability to analyze network traffic and host data in a cybersecurity context.
  • Proven experience using large language models (e.g., Claude) to support penetration testing execution and reporting, including reconnaissance, exploit development, and drafting findings, with sound judgment in validating AI-generated output and securely handling client data.
  • Strong report-writing and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and coordinate across distributed teams, with willingness to travel up to 30-40% (domestic and international) to support customer engagements.

Compensation: 

  • Salary: £105,000
  • Competitive Equity Package  
  • Comprehensive Benefits Plan

All new hires must pass a background check as a condition of employment.

title: Principal Product Marketing Manager, API
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

Synthesia is the #1 Enterprise AI video generation since 2016, and today we work with 90% of the Fortune 100. Our core product, Studio, lets anyone turn a script into a polished video with an AI avatar, no camera or crew required.

Now we're entering a new chapter, and the API is at the center of it. Our Interactive Avatar API lets any company build real-time, conversational avatars directly into their own products.

What You’ll Do

You're the first product marketing hire dedicated to the API, and you'll build the GTM motion from scratch.

There's no playbook here yet. You'll set the foundational positioning, write the developer-facing messaging, stand up the launch process, and figure out how we reach developers and win them.

We’d Love to Hear From You If You Have

  • You get energy from building from scratch, and have a hacker mentality.

  • You use gen AI video tools and created content with them. You're in every new model the week it drops.

  • You've built with APIs yourself: called endpoints, read the code samples, wired up a webhook, shipped something small. You know how developers actually integrate and ship.

  • You've done product marketing, growth, or developer marketing for enterprise audiences.

  • You're an excellent communicator, written and spoken. You have experience managing senior stakeholders and complex program management.

 

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is £100,000 - £130,000.

We also offer equity and a comprehensive benefits package. Individual compensation will depend on experience, skills, and location.

title: Principal Software Engineer, GPS
descriptionHtml:
Principal Software Engineer, Global Public Sector 

Scale’s rapidly growing Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of:

  • Creating custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens
  • Generating high-quality training data for national LLMs
  • Upskilling and advisory services to spread the impact of AI

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to join a small team of our most senior engineers who take on the problems no one else can. You will work at the earliest stage of our engagements: shaping the technical approach with clients, defining the technology we build on, and turning ideas into working prototypes fast. You will step in when a project is stuck or a problem is unusually hard, and turn what you learn in the field into shared capabilities every team can build on.

This is a very senior, hands-on role. Our engineering organisation is young, so mentoring is a core part of the job: you will raise the bar for how we design, build and deliver, and grow the next generation of technical leaders around you. The role is based in London.

At Scale, we’re not just building AI solutions, we are building repeatable blocks to enable the public sector to transform their operations and better serve citizens through cutting-edge technology. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI in the public sector and be a member of our rapidly expanding team, we’d love to hear from you.

You will:

  • Take on the hardest technical problems across our programs, stepping in where projects are stuck or the path forward is unclear
  • Lead the technical side of early engagements: work with clients to scope problems, shape proofs of concept and keep the scope needed to prove value as small as possible
  • Build working prototypes quickly, from AI agents and evaluation pipelines to data and knowledge systems, and take the most promising ones to production
  • Define the technology and architecture our solutions are built on, keeping them cohesive, secure and reusable across clients
  • Mentor engineers across a young organisation through pairing, design and code reviews, and set the bar for engineering excellence
  • Partner with Directors, VPs and client executives to navigate high-stakes business and technical trade-offs, including travel to client sites as engagements require
  • Turn patterns from the field into reusable capabilities, contributing components back to our core platform so every engagement starts further ahead
  • Lead from the front on agentic engineering, both in the AI systems we build and in how our teams use coding agents day to day, and push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI

Ideally you’d have:

  • A strong engineering background, with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 10+ years of post-graduation engineering experience, with demonstrated proficiency in languages such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or C++
  • 5+ years of experience applying AI/ML in production environments, such as building generative/agentic AI applications, RAG systems or evaluation pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with a track record of taking ambiguous, early-stage problems from a blank page to a working prototype and into production
  • Deep expertise in system design and architecture, including experience with cloud-based machine learning tools and platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team or organisation
  • Comfort working directly with clients, from their engineering teams to senior executives
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional environment

Nice to haves:

  • Past experience in a forward deployed engineering role
  • Experience working at a startup, particularly as a founding engineer
  • Experience building and deploying large-scale AI solutions
  • Experience delivering technology programs for governments or regulated industries
  • Experience deploying solutions on-prem or in customer-controlled environments
  • Current or previous UK government security clearance (e.g. SC or DV)

title: Process Automation Engineer - Internship (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
We are Metrify Smart Metering, Germany’s largest competitive smart metering operator, and a new strategic spin-off initiative by Enpal.

Are you ready for one of the great infrastructure challenges of the 2100s? To truly transform into a decentralized power grid that can support a fully electrified, renewable future, millions of homes need to be equipped with smart meters and control systems. That’s why we are performing the fastest smart meter roll-out in the German market at unprecedented scale, shaping the way this digitally transformed grid will operate. Our mission is to enable utilities, grid operators, and energy providers to install and operate smart meters. Our service portfolio covers all aspects of metering operations: from electricity meter installation and market communication to data management and clearing.

While Metrify emerged from Enpal, we now operate independently in the market, serving a broad range of commercial customers, energy suppliers, and municipal utilities

Automate the operations behind every meter exchange

Metrify's Multi-Family Home team runs meter exchanges in apartment buildings, and your code will help run them. In a team of seven, you'll turn the operations we do by hand into automations that save time, reduce errors, and ship faster.

What you'll do

  • Develop the automation layer on our ERP system.

  • Write Python scripts that pull and process data from internal and external APIs, Airtable, and our ERP interface.

  • Map end-to-end operational processes with the team, then design automations that handle every edge case.

  • Build an ops layer so non-technical colleagues can run and understand your tools without asking you.

  • Work directly with the Multi-Family Home team, business operations, and tech and product, and be the bridge between them.

What you'll bring

  • A technical background in computer science or engineering (EEE, mechanical, or similar). Strong business profiles with real tech skills are welcome too.

  • Programming experience, ideally Python, and comfort working in a code repository (e.g., Git, GitHub, or similar).

  • Curiosity about how businesses actually run, and an eye for edge cases.

  • Clear communication, including explaining technical topics to people who don't code.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus.

  • Availability for a 6-month full-time internship, with the chance to stay on.

  • Nice to have: SQL experience.

Why this role stands out

  • Real impact from day one: Your automations will be used in live meter installation and business operations.

  • Design freedom: You choose the tech stack, tooling, and approach. We're early, so you'll shape how things are built.

  • Visibility: You'll work closely with the team lead and see how a business runs end to end.

Are you interested, even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential — regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

What we offer

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step.

  • Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home.

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. We do not make decisions based on skin color, religion or religious beliefs, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or age—neither during the hiring process nor throughout the employment relationship. Enpal is committed to providing a safe workplace and takes a firm stance against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

title: Process Optimization Intern (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Description

QuantumDiamonds (QD) is entering its next phase: with the start of production, we are evolving from a startup into an industrial company. This transition requires an operational foundation built on clean, lean and scalable processes. Join the CEO Office and play a key role in establishing this foundation. As a Process Optimization Intern, you will map our processes in Odoo, from purchase request to bookkeeping, streamline workflows that have grown organically, and automate manual steps. You will work closely with Finance, Procurement and Manufacturing, and your work will have a direct and visible impact on our daily operations.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

  

What will you do

  • Map our end-to-end processes in Odoo, from purchase requests and purchasing to goods receipt, inventory, manufacturing and accounting

  • Analyze existing workflows with Finance, Procurement and Manufacturing, identify bottlenecks and fix them yourself instead of just reporting them

  • Configure and extend Odoo modules, master data and approval flows, and help decide how the ERP grows with QD

  • Take projects live that make a visible difference in daily work, for example barcode scanning in goods receipt and warehouse

  • Automate repetitive manual steps with n8n and connect Odoo to the rest of our tooling stack

  • Build AI agents with Claude that read documents, check data and prepare transactions

  • Document processes and train colleagues so new workflows are adopted and stick

  • Keep data quality high and help set up reporting that gives management a clear view of operations

 

What is expected of you

  • You are enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field

  • You have experience with an ERP system, ideally Odoo

  • You understand processes in purchasing, warehousing, manufacturing, or accounting

  • You have experience with automation tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier

  • Experience with LLM-based workflows or agents, scripting in Python or JavaScript, or knowledge of SQL and data modeling is a plus

  • Experience in a fast-growing hardware or manufacturing company is a plus

  • You have a hands-on mentality: you implement things yourself instead of passing on requirements

  • You are available for a full-time internship of 4 to 6 months and can work from our Munich office

  • Fluent English is required, German is a plus

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 24 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

title: Procurement & Supply Chain Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy & SourceLight

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. As a spin-out of Focused Energy, SourceLight is turning breakthrough laser-driven radiation source technology into practical solutions for some of the world's most demanding inspection and material characterization challenges.

We are building on cutting-edge scientific innovation to develop scalable technology for industrial applications, including nuclear waste characterization, security screening, and non-destructive testing of safety-critical components.

As our technology moves from development toward industrial application, building a robust and scalable supply chain is essential to our success.

Your Role

We are looking for a Procurement & Supply Chain Manager to establish and lead this function from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of procurement and supplier strategy across the company, shaping how we identify, qualify, engage, and manage suppliers while ensuring our engineering teams have the components and resources they need to deliver.

You will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams, Finance, Legal, and external partners to establish company-wide procurement standards, negotiate complex technical and commercial agreements, and build a supplier ecosystem capable of supporting our growth.

Initially operating as a senior individual contributor, you will have significant autonomy and influence over how this function develops. As SourceLight scales, you will have the opportunity to expand the team, introduce new capabilities, and evolve procurement and supply chain into a fully established organizational function.

If you enjoy building structure in a fast-moving technical environment, navigating complex supplier relationships, and creating the operational foundations that enable innovative technology to reach the market, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

What You'll Do

  • Build and lead the Procurement & Supply Chain function: Establish the strategy, processes, tools, and operating standards required to support procurement across all SourceLight product and engineering teams.

  • Develop a strategic supplier ecosystem: Identify, evaluate, qualify, and manage suppliers across specialized technical categories, particularly high-value optical, laser, mechanical, electrical, and other advanced hardware components.

  • Own sourcing and commercial negotiations: Lead supplier selection, RFQs, commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, lead-time agreements, and framework contracts to secure favorable terms while balancing cost, quality, technical requirements, and delivery timelines.

  • Manage complex technical agreements: Lead commercial negotiations for strategic supplier agreements and Joint Development Agreements (JDAs), partnering with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and leadership to ensure appropriate commercial, operational, and contractual outcomes.

  • Enable engineering and product teams: Take ownership of procurement activities from request through purchase order and supplier follow-up, allowing technical teams to focus on engineering, integration, testing, and product development.

  • Establish scalable procurement processes: Implement standardized purchasing workflows, supplier documentation, approval processes, contract management practices, and procurement systems that support transparency, efficiency, and accountability.

  • Drive supply chain planning and risk management: Monitor supplier capacity, component availability, lead times, delivery performance, and potential supply disruptions. Develop mitigation strategies for critical components and proactively communicate risks to stakeholders.

  • Partner with Finance and Legal: Coordinate purchase order approvals, budget alignment, payment processes, contract reviews, and compliance requirements while maintaining clear decision-making and escalation pathways.

  • Ensure quality and compliance: Establish supplier qualification and performance standards that account for technical specifications, quality requirements, cleanroom and safety considerations, and applicable regulatory or industry requirements.

  • Build visibility and accountability: Develop reporting on procurement status, supplier performance, purchasing cycle times, cost savings, delivery risks, and sourcing priorities to support informed operational decisions.

  • Scale the function over time: Identify future capability and resourcing needs, contribute to hiring plans, and establish the processes and knowledge base required to develop and lead a growing Procurement & Supply Chain team.

Who You Are

  • You bring significant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain management, or technical purchasing, ideally within a complex engineering, hardware, deep-tech, industrial technology, or advanced manufacturing environment.

  • You have experience building or significantly improving procurement processes and supplier management practices, ideally within a growing organization where structure and systems are still evolving.

  • You are comfortable managing technically complex sourcing activities, working with engineers to understand requirements, and translating technical needs into effective commercial and supplier strategies.

  • You have a strong track record of negotiating supplier agreements, pricing, delivery terms, and commercial contracts, with the confidence to manage high-value and strategically important supplier relationships.

  • You understand the importance of balancing cost, quality, lead time, technical risk, and long-term supplier reliability when making sourcing decisions.

  • You have experience developing supplier qualification frameworks, evaluating supplier performance, and proactively managing supply chain risks and constraints.

  • You are highly organized and process-oriented, with the ability to establish practical, scalable workflows without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • You operate with a high degree of ownership and independence, bringing structure to ambiguous situations and making sound decisions while knowing when to involve stakeholders or escalate.

  • You are a strong cross-functional partner who communicates proactively, builds trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and can influence decisions without relying on formal authority.

  • You are comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor today while thinking strategically about the capabilities, processes, and team structure needed for tomorrow.

  • You are motivated by the opportunity to build a function, develop future team members, and grow into broader leadership responsibility as the organization scales.

  • You communicate confidently in English; German language skills are an advantage.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.
