title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Ownership & Outcomes

  • Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result.
  • Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds.
  • Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions.

Prototyping & Design

  • Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens.

Collaboration & Continuity

  • Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast.
  • Take over existing product design work and keep quality high.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Senior product design experience, ideally in health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • 1 to 3 shipped case studies that show the problem, your role, your decisions and the measurable impact.
  • Strong UX and UI craft: visual hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes you can screen-share and walk through (Figma, AI tools such as Claude or Lovable).
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools, and enthusiasm for trying new ones.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Close work with engineers, and clear, short communication.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • AI-ready design systems, mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You'd rather show a working thing than describe one.
  • Builder — You ship, starting from nothing if you have to.
  • Bias for action — You don't need to be told what to do or be chased. You spot what could go wrong, pick the one that matters most and fix it.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need a finished brief, all the requirements or all the research before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min)
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.

  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Senior Software Engineer (AI/Data)
descriptionHtml:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

We're building the Advisory Intelligence Platform: Codat's client intelligence delivered inside the assistant a banker already uses (Microsoft Copilot first). Ask it anything about a client and it answers from the client's real books. Don't ask, and it still tells you what's changed, why it matters and what to do about it. Under it we're building the semantic layer, so every answer uses the same definitions, the signal layer that spots what's changed for a client, and the reasoning layer, a Codat-side LLM that turns those signals into advice. The first bank goes live this year. You'll be building the data and reasoning behind all of it.

This is a hands-on job for software engineers who want to build the systems a model reasons over, not configure a warehouse. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS. The product lives inside the AI assistant our clients already use, and we build it the same way: agents do the repetitive work, engineers do the hard parts. You'll build it and you'll run it. Nobody hands it over the wall once it's live. You'll also get a real say in where it goes next. That means making your case to engineers, product and the commercial team, and bringing them along with you.

What You'll Work On

  • The semantic layer. Measures, dimensions and definitions the model is allowed to use, so every answer it gives is the same answer. Yours to grow, persona by persona.

  • The signal layer. Detecting what's changed for a client and surfacing it before the banker asks. You'll be designing and building this.

  • The reasoning layer. A Codat-side LLM that turns signals into advice. Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. You own the calculations the model relies on, and the names, definitions and structure that let it pick the right one.

  • The agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers behind the assistant. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.

  • Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.

You'll Probably Have

  • Built production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. You think about interfaces, failure modes and how the next person will change your code. If we ask about the hardest system you've built, you'll have a story ready.

  • Served data to an LLM and seen where it goes wrong: ambiguous definitions, poor retrieval, no evals. You know why "the model will work it out" isn't a data strategy.

  • Worked with data along the way, and liked it. You may never have been called a data engineer. You've built things that move, shape and serve data, and you know how they break, and how a model breaks on top of them.

  • Solid C#, Python or another backend language. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them.

  • Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server.

  • Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team.

  • An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too.

  • Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don’t want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

title: VP Global Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

UFORCE is looking for a VP Global Supply Chain to build and lead a resilient, compliant supply-chain function across the US, UK and Europe. You’ll connect global sourcing strategy with the realities of production: qualified suppliers, reliable material plans and the right parts arriving when they’re needed.

This is a strategic leadership role with hands-on ownership. You’ll set global sourcing direction, build the team and establish shared standards across sites. You’ll also work directly with engineering, production and suppliers to resolve shortages and keep programmes moving.

A key part of the role is establishing the US supply chain and connecting it to global planning. Your work will make supply risks visible earlier, strengthen supplier performance and help UFORCE scale without every site having to solve the same problems alone.

What you’ll do

  • Build category and supplier strategies that balance cost, quality, lead time and resilience across countries and programmes.

  • Establish the US supply chain: qualify suppliers, put sourcing and logistics arrangements in place, and build material plans aligned with programme and production milestones.

  • Create a cross-site view of material readiness, critical shortages and recovery plans, with clear owners and timely escalation.

  • Identify single-source, long-lead and capacity constraints, and put dual-sourcing, buffer-stock or supplier-development plans in place where needed.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, introduce supplier scorecards and hold partners accountable for delivery, quality and corrective actions.

  • Establish consistent supplier qualification, traceability and counterfeit-part avoidance controls, working with Quality, Legal and Export Compliance on applicable requirements and specialist decisions.

  • Connect demand, bills of materials, supplier lead times and production schedules through a practical sales and operations planning rhythm, supported by shared enterprise resource planning standards and reliable data.

  • Define the global team structure, hire and develop people, and establish clear responsibilities and ways of working with site supply-chain leads.

  • Use agreed baselines and targets to improve supplier delivery, material availability, lead times, inventory performance and landed cost.

Required Skills

  • Experience leading sourcing and supply-chain activity across multiple countries or manufacturing sites, with measurable delivery, cost or resilience improvements.

  • A strong understanding of complex hardware manufacturing and the connection between engineering changes, material availability and build schedules.

  • A track record of identifying supplier risk and implementing practical mitigations that protected production.

  • Experience translating demand and production priorities into credible material plans, including sales and operations planning or an equivalent cross-functional process.

  • Strong commercial judgement and negotiation skills, with the ability to resolve supplier quality, delivery or capacity issues while maintaining long-term relationships.

  • Experience building or significantly improving a supply-chain function in a growing organisation, rather than only operating an established system.

  • Experience building, developing and leading teams across locations, setting shared standards and delivering through site stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of supplier assurance, traceability and applicable export controls, including UK and EU military and dual-use requirements and ITAR/EAR awareness. You know how to implement supplier-side controls and when to seek specialist advice.

  • A hands-on approach, clear prioritisation and the judgement to act quickly when production is at risk.

  • Willingness to travel regularly across the US, UK and Europe.

  • Eligible for Security Clearance

Nice to have

  • Defence, aerospace, maritime, automotive, robotics or other complex hardware supply-chain experience.

  • Experience establishing a US supplier base or supply-chain operation and integrating it with UK or European operations.

  • Experience with Ukrainian or Eastern European suppliers and cross-border logistics.

  • Experience implementing or harmonising enterprise resource planning systems across sites.

  • CIPS, APICS/ASCM or an equivalent professional qualification.

title: Research Engineer - Data Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on the data infrastructure that powers our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the systems that make world-class data possible. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

 

  • Building large-scale data pipelines for collecting, processing, filtering, and transforming datasets used to train state-of-the-art models.

  • Training models used in our data processing pipelines, such as classifiers, quality filters, and labeling models.

  • Designing data curation strategies such as deduplication, quality scoring, labeling, and augmentation that measurably improve model performance.

  • Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers explore and train on massive datasets quickly and reliably.

 

Requirements

We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:

 

  • Experience building data-intensive systems, ideally in support of machine learning training pipelines.

  • Strong engineering skills in distributed data processing at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, or custom pipelines over large datasets).

  • The capacity to autonomously evaluate how data quality, composition, and curation affect model outcomes, and to build the tooling to measure it.

 

Bonus: Experience building or operating web crawlers.

 

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

 

#LI-Remote

title: Responsable enquêtes & plaidoyer
descriptionHtml:
Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous avons été distingués pour notre exclusion des énergies fossiles par Reclaim Finance, bank.green, Bank for Good ou encore Moralscore. Green-Got est aussi lauréat de l'Impact 40 depuis 3 années consécutives.
Depuis cinq ans, nous montrons où va l'argent. Nos membres ont sorti 300 millions d'euros des grandes banques. Notre mission est de définir de nouveaux standards pour le secteur financier, alignés avec la science, et non pas les intérêts des industries fossiles.

Pourquoi ce recrutement ?
Les banques traditionnelles ont des lobbyistes. Ils défendent leurs profits et les industries qu'elles financent. Les citoyens, eux, n'en ont jamais eu. C'est désormais le cas.
Pendant plusieurs mois, nous avons enquêté sur le financement des pesticides par les banques françaises. Mais dénoncer ne suffit pas : la prochaine étape, c'est la loi. Nous recrutons la personne qui enquêtera à nos côtés, dévoilera ce que le système préfère laisser dans l'ombre et proposera des solutions concrètes pour changer les règles. Elle racontera chaque étape du combat à nos membres, en toute transparence.

Missions

Ton travail tient en trois verbes : enquêter, dévoiler, proposer. Tu portes 2 à 3 grandes campagnes par an, de la première piste jusqu'au texte de loi, et tu les incarnes.

1. Enquêter

  • Faire la veille de l'actualité politique, réglementaire et scientifique (Parlement européen, Assemblée nationale, comitologie, ONG), et nourrir l'équipe Média pour nos contenus réactifs.

  • Repérer les sujets de nos grandes campagnes de mobilisation et les valider avec nous : fludioxonyl, TotalEnergies financé par les Livrets A .

2. Dévoiler

  • Mener les recherches sur les campagnes validées. Ce n'est pas de la réaction à chaud : ce sont 2 à 3 combats de fond par an.

  • Creuser les rapports, les bilans et les sources primaires que personne ne lit, et en sortir des informations inédites.

  • Trouver les angles : quelles personnes interroger (un agriculteur, une famille touchée), comment les contacter, quels contenus en tirer avec l'équipe Média.

  • Incarner l'enquête pendant qu'elle se fait, face caméra et sur le terrain :

  • Prendre la parole face caméra (vidéos, lives, interventions médias) et partager régulièrement où en est le combat.

  • Répondre aux commentaires sur tes sujets et publier dans l'onglet Communauté de l'app. Tu vois comment nos membres réagissent, et cela nourrit tes prochaines enquêtes.

3. Proposer : plaidoyer et lobbying institutionnel

  • Construire la feuille de route plaidoyer à partir de nos enquêtes : quelles demandes, auprès de quelles institutions, avec quel calendrier.

  • Évaluer la faisabilité juridique et politique des leviers possibles : interdire certaines substances, encadrer ou interdire les financements aux producteurs de pesticides, exiger la transparence sur la présence d'entreprises fossiles ou de pesticides dans les produits d'épargne.

  • Repérer les fenêtres déjà ouvertes : renouvellements d'autorisation de substances, textes européens en discussion (Omnibus, décisions du SCoPAFF), propositions de loi, projets de loi de finances.

  • Rédiger les notes de position, propositions d'amendements et argumentaires, toujours adossés à la science et à des données indépendantes.

  • Cartographier et rencontrer les décideurs : Parlement européen, Commission européenne, Représentation permanente de la France, Assemblée nationale, Sénat, ministères, agences et régulateurs. Analyser leurs prises de position et leurs votes passés.

  • Rester strictement apartisan : nos demandes s'appuient sur la science, pas sur un camp.

  • Construire des coalitions avec les ONG, scientifiques, juristes et journalistes, et représenter Green-Got dans les coalitions françaises et européennes de la finance durable (Sustainable Banking Coalition/FEBEA, Impact France, Fair Finance). Une victoire collective reste collective : tes contacts doivent être dans toutes les ONG.

  • Devenir à terme un visage récurrent : « votre lobbyiste à Bruxelles ».

Compétences recherchées

Indispensable

  • Une expérience solide en plaidoyer, affaires publiques ou journalisme d'enquête : ONG, think tank, collaboration parlementaire, cabinet ministériel ou rédaction.

  • Un flair d'enquêteur. Tu sais où chercher l'information que personne n'a sortie (bilans, comitologie, listes de vote, thèses), et tu la vérifies avant de l'affirmer.

  • Une maîtrise en profondeur les deux arènes. Tu connais de l'intérieur le fonctionnement des institutions européennes (commissions, trilogues, comitologie) et du Parlement français (navette, amendements, PLF), et tu as déjà travaillé avec l'autre.

  • Un réseau actif de parlementaires, collaborateurs, conseillers et ONG sur ces sujets.

  • Une plume à deux registres : une note de position qui tient face à un juriste, un post LinkedIn qui tient face à un scroll.

  • De l'aisance face caméra et avec les journalistes. Tu acceptes d'incarner un combat, dans le respect strict des faits.

  • Un fibre en contenus : tu sais quels angles vont attirer l’attention, comment raconter des sujets compliqués…

Un vrai plus

  • Une culture scientifique et réglementaire sur la finance durable et la santé environnementale : taxonomie, SFDR, évaluation des risques, cadre européen d'autorisation des substances.

  • Une expérience dans une ONG de finance climat, ou une connaissance de la régulation financière (règles prudentielles).

  • Une expérience d'animation de coalitions.

Profil recherché

Green-Got est un employeur inclusif. Tous les profils qui se reconnaissent dans cette annonce sont les bienvenus, quels que soient leur parcours, leur genre ou leur origine.

  • Tu vas chercher toi-même.
    Tu ne reprends pas les enquêtes des autres : tu remontes aux sources.

  • Tu arrives avec un dossier.
    Pas seulement une dénonciation : ce qu'il faudrait changer, comment, et avec qui.

  • Tu es crédible partout.
    Dans le bureau d'un conseiller ministériel comme dans une story Instagram.

  • Tu tiens la distance.
    Le plaidoyer est lent et échoue souvent. Un échec bien raconté ne te fait pas peur : il prépare la suite.

  • Tu es rigoureux (mais genre, vraiment).
    Une seule affirmation fragile ruinerait la crédibilité de toutes les autres. Chaque chiffre est sourcé, chaque victoire attribuée à sa juste part.

  • Tu es owner.
    Tes réussites comme tes échecs t'appartiennent. Tu avances même quand c'est flou.

  • Tu veux un impact réel.
    Changer les règles, pas seulement en parler.

Le package

Lieu : Paris, avec des déplacements réguliers.

Contrat : CDI, statut cadre

Arrivée : ASAP

  • BSPCEs (equity)

  • RTTs

  • Mutuelle santé Alan

  • Déplacements à Bruxelles pris en charge

  • Une journée d'équipe tous les semestres

Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer.

title: Robotics Data Engineer, Human Motion Data (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About EASE

EASE builds active, AI-powered exoskeletons for logistics and manufacturing. As a TUM spin-off, we have just started series production, and paid pilots with well-known logistics companies have led to first purchase orders. Our goal: move every parcel better, manually with an exoskeleton or autonomously with a robot.

The role

Our exoskeletons are deployed in real warehouses and production plants and capture what video-only datasets miss: body pose, joint kinematics, interaction torques, vision, and hand forces from real human work. Your job is to build pipelines that turn raw exoskeleton recordings into clean, robot-ready training data, including retargeting human motion to the humanoid’s body. So in the future human workers and robots can work side by side on the same tasks.

  • Define signals, formats and metadata for our next exoskeleton generation

  • Build pipelines from devices in the field to storage, incl. sync, calibration and versioning

  • Set up storage and compute together with our robot learning team

What you bring

  • Degree in CS, data engineering, robotics or similar, with hands-on pipeline experience

  • Strong Python and SQL; pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, Ray or Spark)

  • Time-series or multimodal sensor data, incl. synchronization and calibration

  • Cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure), Docker and Linux

  • Solid understanding of GDPR and personal data

Nice to have

  • ROS 2, MCAP or LeRobot; annotation or dataset management tools

Send your CV with links to GitHub or projects you are proud of.

title: Rollout Manager Europe (gn) – KI-Anwendungen
descriptionHtml:
Du weißt, wie Software in vielen Ländern wirklich ankommt? Dann bring jetzt KI in den Alltag einer europäischen Gruppe.

Arbeitsort: Metropolregion Rhein-Ruhr, hybrid. Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort im Team, aber nicht jeden Tag. Der Reiseanteil liegt bei rund 10 bis maximal 15 Prozent.

​

Das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde ist eine etablierte, europäisch aufgestellte Dienstleistungsgruppe mit Landesgesellschaften in einem guten Dutzend Ländern, mehr als 10.000 Beschäftigten und über einer halben Milliarde Euro Umsatz. Das Geschäft lebt von Daten, Prozessen und schnellen Entscheidungen, also genau dort, wo KI den größten Hebel hat. Deshalb baut sich die Gruppe gerade von Grund auf neu: kein Pilot in einer Abteilung, sondern ein Umbau von Organisation, Produkt und Arbeitsweise über alle Länder hinweg. Das große Transformationsprogramm startet jetzt, und du bist von Anfang an dabei. Dahinter stehen ein neu aufgestelltes Leadership-Team, ein CTO, der selbst aus der Top-Beratung kommt, und ein langfristig denkender Eigentümer. Ein eigenes Plattformteam entwickelt bereits die KI-Anwendung und erste Agenten, und mit dem neuen Innovation Hub bekommt die Transformation ihren eigenen Ort.

Die beste KI-Anwendung bringt allerdings wenig, solange sie nur in der Zentrale funktioniert. Ob die Transformation gelingt, entscheidet sich im Alltag der Landesgesellschaften, und genau dort setzt diese Rolle an.

​

Deine Aufgaben

Du berichtest direkt an den CTO, arbeitest Hand in Hand mit dem Produktteam und bringst die eigene KI-Anwendung in die Länder.

  • Du machst Länder und Standorte startklar, planst die Rollouts, behältst Risiken im Blick und bereitest die Go/No-Go-Entscheidung vor.

  • Du klärst lokale Besonderheiten und nötige Anpassungen mit dem Produktteam.

  • Du gewinnst lokale Führungskräfte für die Veränderung, misst die Nutzung und räumst Hürden aus dem Weg.

  • Du organisierst Trainings gemeinsam mit Trainer:innen und Key Usern vor Ort.

  • In der Hypercare bist du erste Anlaufstelle und übergibst stabile Nutzung an die Länder.

  • Mit jedem Release bringst du weitere Features und Agenten in die Fläche und verbesserst dabei das Vorgehen.

​

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst rund 3 bis 7 Jahre Erfahrung mit und hast mehrere Software-Einführungen in verschiedenen Ländern oder an vielen Standorten selbst gesteuert, etwa ERP, CRM, HCM oder SaaS, ob im Unternehmen, beim Softwareanbieter oder beim Implementierungspartner.

  • Du kennst Change, Training und die Arbeit mit Key Usern aus der Praxis.

  • Du verbesserst Adoption anhand von Nutzungsdaten und Feedback.

  • Du verstehst operative Geschäftsprozesse und kannst Menschen für Neues begeistern.

  • Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.

  • Von Vorteil: erste Praxis mit KI-Anwendungen oder Agenten, Erfahrung in einem Unternehmen mit vielen Standorten, eine Sprache aus Mittel- oder Osteuropa.

Zur Einordnung: Du steuerst Rollouts selbst und hands-on. Wenn du heute vor allem als Programmdirektor:in große Teams und Budgets führst, ist die Rolle vermutlich nicht der passende Zuschnitt.

​

Wir bieten

  • Dein Einstieg ins KI-Thema: Deine Rollout-Erfahrung ist das Entscheidende, KI lernst du hier in der Praxis.

  • Viel Gestaltungsraum: Du entwickelst das Vorgehen für die ganze Gruppe mit.

  • International, aber planbar: Du arbeitest mit vielen Ländern, ohne ständig unterwegs zu sein.

  • Sichtbarkeit: direkter Draht zum CTO und zu den Führungskräften in den Ländern.

  • Eine Perspektive in Richtung Programmleitung.

  • Ein attraktives Paket aus Fixgehalt und variablem Anteil.

​

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Der Prozess läuft komplett vertraulich. Vorab bekommst du von uns einen ehrlichen Einblick in Unternehmen, Aufgabe und Rahmenbedingungen, und erst nach deiner ausdrücklichen Freigabe gehen Unterlagen an unseren Kunden. Bitte lade vorher deinen CV hoch, damit wir den grundsätzlichen Match einschätzen können.

title: Sales Manager, AI
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

We need a commercially sharp sales leader who can take ownership of growing Kraken’s Agentic Customer Service business globally. Someone who can decide where we focus, lead the team, shape our biggest deals and make sure growth translates into profitable, contracted revenue.

They would lead both the Principal Engagement Managers and any future sales hires, setting the direction across winning initial deployments and expanding clients into broader adoption. They need to see the whole business while staying close enough to the detail to intervene where it matters.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:

Commercial judgement needs to be their strongest quality

They naturally question the economics of a deal: what the customer is committing to, what we are charging, what it costs us to deliver and how the margin changes as usage grows. They understand how conversation volumes, channel mix, implementation effort, partner costs and contractual commitments fit together.

They can defend our value and negotiate firmly while maintaining a strong customer relationship. Discounts, additional scope and flexible terms are deliberate decisions with a clear return. They recognise when a large headline number hides weak commitments, expensive delivery obligations or an agreement that will be difficult to scale.

They are comfortable working through contracts with Legal and Finance, taking ownership of the commercial decisions and knowing when an issue needs escalation.

They have an agentic background and ideally a utilities background

They need to have sold agentic AI before ideally to large scale customers for enterprise software.

We have identified that a weakness in the wider AI team is an understanding of how agentic translates into real life issues encountered by utilities. This hire would ideally also have a utilities background to ensure both credibility with clients and that we do not become Sierra 2.0.

They can turn customer interest into a buying decision

They can sit with a CEO, COO or CFO and explain what Agentic Customer Service could change about their business, what that change is worth and what it will take to achieve it.

They challenge business cases and distinguish measurable value from optimistic assumptions. They also understand the power of humans and why certain AI needs to remain in the hands of humans to maintain their excellence.

They consistently bring conversations back to who will decide, what budget is available, what evidence is needed and what the customer is prepared to commit to.

They lead capable people and raise their performance

Their team should gain clear direction, strong coaching and useful challenge from this person. They set expectations across qualification, account strategy, negotiation, forecasting and expansion, with clear ownership between the roles.

They can inspect a deal and identify where the team needs help: an absent economic buyer, an unconvincing business case, a weak negotiation position or an expansion opportunity nobody is actively pursuing. They develop the team’s judgement while personally leading the situations that need their seniority.

They make the organisation work around the opportunity

Much of the reality is aligning Sales, existing Account Teams, Product, Delivery, Legal, Finance and Sierra. This person builds trust across those groups and gets clear decisions when priorities conflict.

They protect Kraken’s commercial position within the Sierra partnership, including customer ownership, costs, responsibilities and the route to scale. They also ensure customer commitments reflect what Product and Delivery can support, challenging constraints and securing resources where the opportunity justifies it.

They bring focus and follow through

They can choose which accounts deserve attention, where senior involvement will make a difference and which opportunities should wait. Their forecasts stand up to scrutiny, and they spot slippage early.

They are comfortable with an evolving product and incomplete information. They ask good questions, make decisions and follow through until there is a clear outcome.

title: Senior Adviseur Energie En Laadinfrastructuur Goederenvervoer
descriptionHtml:
Werken aan de energietransitie in transport.

De transportsector staat voor een fundamentele verandering. Elektrificatie en de ontwikkeling van laadinfrastructuur zijn cruciaal voor de toekomst van het goederenvervoer. Panteia ondersteunt overheden, brancheorganisaties en bedrijven met onafhankelijk onderzoek en advies.

Voor ons team Transport en Mobiliteit zoeken wij een senior adviseur die dit werkveld verder uitbouwt.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt aan complexe vraagstukken op het snijvlak van energie, logistiek en beleid. Denk aan de ontwikkeling van laadpleinen, depotladen en de integratie van energie in logistieke systemen.

Jij:

  • leidt onderzoeks- en adviesprojecten van offerte tot oplevering;

  • stuurt op kwaliteit, planning en budget van projecten;

  • vertaalt beleidsvragen naar concrete onderzoeksopzetten en werkplannen;

  • ontwikkelt nieuwe proposities rond laden en energie in transport;

  • onderhoudt en bouwt relaties met opdrachtgevers zoals ministeries, brancheorganisaties en bedrijven;

  • speelt een actieve rol in acquisitie en het binnenhalen van nieuwe opdrachten;

  • werkt samen met nationale en - waar relevant - Europese partners.


Deze vacature daagt jou uit

…om op strategisch niveau bij te dragen aan de oplossing van grote maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Je richt je hierbij op een breed spectrum van goederenwegtransport tot energietransitie vraagstukken als gevolg van strengere klimaat- en energiedoelen. Binnen Panteia is Team Transport & Mobiliteit een onafhankelijke intermediair tussen de transportsector en beleidsmakers en richt zich bijvoorbeeld op onderzoek en advisering van de introductie van batterij elektrische voertuigen, laadinfra tot biobrandstoffen en bijbehorende complexe rekendossiers met forse maatschappelijke belangen en grote financiële gevolgen. Projecten van Panteia hebben vaak een omgeving met meerdere stakeholders en grote politieke aandacht. Panteia T&M biedt scherp inzicht op goederenwegvervoerbeleid en de daarbij behorende omgevingsfactoren, zodat opdrachtgevers verantwoorde beslissingen en beleidskeuzes kunnen maken. Wie die opdrachtgevers zijn? Denk aan lokale, regionale, nationale, en internationale overheden, en brancheorganisaties. Zij kunnen rekenen op gedegen en toepasbaar onderzoek en advies van Panteia. Aan afwisseling en uitdaging geen gebrek dus! Als onze nieuwe senior adviseur zit jij boven op de ontwikkelingen in de samenleving en weet je precies wat onze opdrachtgevers drijft en waar zij behoefte aan hebben.


Wat breng je mee?

Je combineert inhoudelijke kennis met gevoel voor de praktijk en weet hoe beleid, markt en techniek samenkomen.

Jij:

  • hebt ruime ervaring (minimaal 5 jaar) opgedaan met energie- en mobiliteitsvraagstukken;

  • hebt kennis van laadinfrastructuur en/of aanverwante thema’s;

  • kent de transport- en logistieke sector goed;

  • hebt ervaring met het leiden van projecten;

  • kunt zelfstandig opdrachten verwerven en uitbouwen;

  • begrijpt beleidsprocessen en schakelt gemakkelijk met publieke en private partijen;

  • bent een teamspeler die energie krijgt van samen resultaten behalen;

  • werkt gestructureerd en bewaakt de kwaliteit van resultaten;

  • communiceert helder en overtuigend;

  • beschikt over een goede beheersing van de Nederlands en Engelse taal op professioneel niveau.

Wat bieden wij?

Je krijgt de ruimte om een groeiend en relevant thema verder vorm te geven binnen onze organisatie.

Wij bieden:

  • projecten met directe impact op beleid en praktijk in de transportsector;

  • veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap;

  • een compact en deskundig team van collega’s;

  • goede arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden waaronder 22 vakantie – en 12 ATV-dagen;

Je wordt onderdeel van een enthousiast team van transport- en mobiliteitsexperts die actief zijn in de Nederlandse en Europese markt. Jouw toekomstige collega’s staan midden in de samenleving en omschrijven zichzelf als professioneel, gedreven en met passie voor hun vak.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer - Finance
descriptionHtml:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to lead the data architecture behind our most business-critical financial work: billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting. You'll design the data solutions that finance, payments and audit teams depend on, set the standards for how analytics work ships, and mentor others on the team.

This is a shape-the-team role. You'll have real influence over how we work, what we build and the pace we move at.

We expect you to use AI fluently where it adds leverage in modeling, code review and debugging, and to apply clear judgment on where it doesn't.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture and development of high-impact data models in dbt.

  • Architect data solutions across business-critical financial workflows, including billing, regulatory reporting (EMI), SOX compliance, financial forecasting and executive reporting.

  • Mentor analytics engineers and review code to uphold standards across the team.

  • Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the data stack.

  • Translate business problems into clean, efficient data solutions in close partnership with stakeholders.

  • Set team-wide standards for documentation, CI/CD, observability and testing.

  • Set the team's norms for where AI belongs in our workflow, from model development to code review, and where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering or a similar role, with a track record of designing data models that hold up to cross-functional use.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with dbt, SQL and Python on a modern data platform (Databricks or equivalent).

  • Strong grasp of pipeline orchestration, testing frameworks and the practices that keep them healthy at scale.

  • Comfortable setting technical direction, mentoring engineers and working closely with finance, payments and audit stakeholders. You can explain a trade-off clearly and influence the decision that follows.

  • You use AI hands-on in your day-to-day technical work and can show specific examples of how it has changed the way you build, review or debug data models.

  • You catch AI's errors before anything ships, including hallucinations, overconfident answers and plausible-but-wrong code, and you have a clear sense of where human oversight stays non-negotiable.

title: Senior Android Developer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin

The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships.

The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions, renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day. The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user.

On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Kotlin & Android Internals Expertise: You will own the core development and optimization of the adjoe Ads SDK, which runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. We are looking for someone with 8+ years of Android experience (or 3+ years specifically in SDK/library development) who works primarily with Kotlin and has a deep understanding of Android lifecycles, ProGuard/R8, and multithreading to ensure zero tolerance for instability on millions of devices.

  • High-Performance Network Design: You will collaborate with backend teams to design APIs and capture behavioral signals that power 50 billion daily ML predictions. You need a strong track record in API design, maintaining strict backward compatibility for thousands of external integrators, and working with high-performance networking protocols like gRPC, Protobuf, Wire, and OkHTTP.

  • Resource-Constrained Optimization: You will ensure every ad impression feels native and fast while participating in 120 million daily auctions. You must know how to design for minimal footprint, optimizing battery impact and memory usage, as your code executes directly inside someone else’s app and device.

  • Data-Driven Observability: You will monitor, debug, and maintain SDK reliability at scale across millions of global users. You will leverage observability and data tools—including Sentry, Kibana, and AWS (S3, QuickSight, Athena)—to track errors, investigate SDK behavior, and turn raw data into clear engineering decisions.

  • Build Automation & Delivery: You will maintain and improve our CI/CD pipelines to guarantee efficient, reliable SDK delivery. This requires hands-on experience with Gradle and GitLab CI to automate the testing, building, and packaging of our mobile libraries.

  • Plus – AdTech & Low-Level Systems: It is a major plus if you bring experience in ad-tech or programmatic advertising (aligning products with IAB specifications). Additionally, experience with NDK/JNI (C/C++ interop on Android) or parallel iOS development experience is highly valued to help support our cross-platform ecosystem.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Our modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor, working directly with our Platform Lead, who sets Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering organisation. It's a small team, so you'll cover a wide surface area, with no dedicated DevOps or QA function to hand work to.

This is a high-ownership seat. You'll take on substantial, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives, agree the direction with the Platform Lead, then drive them from first analysis through to completion with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a significant topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role. If you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be up to

  • Designing and building scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
  • Spotting and scoping problems and initiatives yourself, not just picking up assigned tickets: weighing impact, priority and timing.
  • Contributing to architectural decisions and design discussions, and bringing other teams along.
  • Driving substantial, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, coordinating with stakeholders across engineering.
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that help teams deliver faster and more reliably.
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
  • Sharing knowledge through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and helping raise technical standards.
  • Spotting where AI and automation can improve how we build and run software.

Some of the challenges waiting for you

You'll take ownership of one of these as your first initiative, with no other distractions.

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database.
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform.
  • Extracting and reworking common services to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you'll bring to the team

  • 5+ years of backend development experience, with a track record of owning significant technical work from ambiguity through to completion.
  • Substantial hands-on ownership of infrastructure, reliability or performance, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms. We care more about how you think than which stack you've used.
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals and genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
  • Comfort with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests, as we don't have a dedicated QA function.
  • A project you can talk about in depth: the problem, what you did and the impact it had.
  • Fluent English.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS or Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other approaches (like CloudFormation).
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ or SQS are good transferable equivalents).
  • Experience owning observability and logging for highly available systems.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers, and introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

Culture & Growth

What We Offer

  • An International Team: Work alongside colleagues from over 20 nationalities.
  • Growth and Development: 360° feedback reviews, an evolving career framework and an annual learning budget of €1,000+.
  • Autonomy and Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We trust you to make decisions and contribute directly.
  • Real Impact: Join a fast-growing scale-up transforming hospitality. From day one, your work drives real impact.
  • Fair Pay: Competitive salaries guided by benchmarking data, with recognition for performance and contribution.
  • Flexible Work: Work from home, the office or a hybrid mix. We focus on results, not clocking hours.
  • Time Off and Wellbeing: 30 days of vacation and an EGYM Wellpass membership.
  • Free Public Transport: A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for travel across Germany.
  • Team Connection: Regular team dinners, company meetups and offsite events.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation and growth is a shared journey.

What We're Looking For:

Essential 

  • Experience (typically 3+ years) in BI, reporting or analytics roles

  • Strong SQL skills — comfortable building complex queries and validating data

Desirable

Career Development

  • Develop and approve study plans, validation protocols, analytical reports and associated study documentation.
  • Review, evaluate and approve analytical data to ensure scientific integrity and regulatory compliance.
  • Ensure all study activities are conducted in accordance with applicable SOPs, regulatory requirements and client expectations.

Client Management

  • Provide regular project updates and maintain strong communication throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Support client meetings, scientific discussions and audits as required.

Operational Excellence

  • Coordinate laboratory activities and ensure efficient study execution.
  • Train, mentor and support assigned laboratory personnel.
  • Contribute to process improvements and continuous enhancement of laboratory operations and quality standards.
  • Support bioanalytical data management activities and documentation review processes.

Additional Responsibilities for Senior-Level Candidates

  • Lead complex or strategic client programs.
  • Provide scientific mentoring and guidance to junior Principal Investigators and laboratory staff.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for ligand-binding and cell-based assay technologies.
  • Contribute to business development activities, client presentations and scientific initiatives.

Our requirements

  • BSc / MSc in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology or related field
  • At least 2 years professional experience, at least 6 years for senior position
  • Practical experience in relevant bioanalytical techniques (e.g. LBA, cell-based), preferably in an industry setting

Funktionalität Durchdachte Details und einfache Anwendung, die den Alltag leichter machen.

Unser Ziel: die Go-to-Brand für funktionale Home-&-Living-Lösungen in Europa werden.

DEINE MISSION

Du machst YourCasa zur Marke, an die Kundinnen und Kunden bei Haus, Küche und Garten zuerst denken. Und Du baust die Abläufe, mit denen unser Wachstum planbar und skalierbar wird.

WAS DU BEWEGST

Marke & Wachstum

  • Du schärfst Positionierung und USP von YourCasa und verantwortest Markenauftritt und Content über alle Kanäle.

  • Du priorisierst das Portfolio, planst und timst Launches und sorgst dafür, dass wir uns klar von Nachahmern abheben.

  • Du entwickelst unsere internationalen Märkte weiter: Frankreich und Italien gezielt ausbauen, UK, USA und weitere EU-Märkte erschließen.

  • Du findest und bewertest neue Produktideen und Marktchancen.

Marktplätze & Performance

  • Du erstellst und optimierst Amazon-Listings in mehreren Sprachen (mit KI-Unterstützung) und hältst Otto, Kaufland, eBay und unseren Shopify-Shop auf demselben Stand.

  • Du steuerst das Amazon-Tagesgeschäft mit Blick auf Buy-Box, Rankings und Bewertungen.

  • Du legst gemeinsam mit unserem Advertising-Freelancer die PPC-Strategie fest und misst sie an klaren TACoS-Zielen.

  • Du briefst unsere Content-Agentur für Bilder und Videos und passt Visuals bei Bedarf selbst mit KI-Tools an.

Einkauf & Operations

  • Du platzierst Bestellungen bei unseren Lieferanten in Europa und Asien, verfolgst Mengen, Termine und Verschiffung und steuerst die Lagerreichweiten.

  • Du pflegst Lieferantenvereinbarungen, gleichst Rechnungen mit Liefer- und Versanddaten ab und klärst Abweichungen.

  • Du wertest Retourengründe aus, stellst Ursachen ab und bist erste Anlaufstelle für unseren Kundenservice bei kniffligen Fällen.

Zahlen, Compliance & Prozesse

  • Du behältst Umsatz, Marge, Bestand und Werbekosten täglich im Blick (Sellerboard und internes Dashboard) und kalkulierst Margen pro Produkt und Marktplatz.

  • Du verantwortest das monatliche KPI-Reporting mit TACoS, SKU-Profitabilität, Deckungsbeiträgen und Sondereffekten.

  • Du stellst EPR-Meldungen, Verpackungslizenzen und GPSR-Angaben in allen Ländern fristgerecht sicher.

  • Du machst unsere Abläufe mit KI und Automatisierung schneller und sauberer.

Klingt nach viel? Ist es auch. Deshalb arbeitest Du nicht allein: Freelancer und Partner übernehmen PPC, Retouren, Kundenservice und Fulfillment, eine Agentur Bilder und Videos. Du setzt die Prioritäten.

DEINE ERSTEN 12 MONATE

NACH 1 MONAT Ankommen: Du kennst Portfolio, Kanäle, Partner und Zahlen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt das Amazon-Tagesgeschäft.

NACH 3 MONATEN Übernehmen: Listings, Einkaufsplanung und Reporting laufen über Deinen Tisch. Erste eigene Optimierungen sind live.

NACH 12 MONATEN Gestalten: Du treibst Launches und Länderausbau eigenständig voran und verantwortest erste Bereiche komplett.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

Das brauchst Du

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Amazon-Seller-Erfahrung auf Marken- oder Agenturseite

  • Erfahrung mit einem weiteren Kanal, z. B. Otto, Kaufland, D2C-Shop, bol.com oder TikTok Shop

  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du entwickelst eigene Lösungen, statt nur Vorgaben umzusetzen. KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Bild-KI nutzt Du selbstverständlich

  • Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch sowie Erreichbarkeit zu deutschen Kernarbeitszeiten (ca. 9–17 Uhr MEZ)

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Internationale Marktentwicklung über DACH hinaus, idealerweise FR, IT oder UK

  • Praxis mit Amazon Advertising (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display)

  • Kenntnisse in EPR, Verpackungsgesetz oder GPSR

  • Einkaufs- oder Lieferantenerfahrung, gern mit China-Import

  • Französisch, Italienisch oder Polnisch

  • Grundkenntnisse in Canva oder Bildbearbeitung

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb Dich trotzdem. Uns ist wichtiger, wie Du denkst und arbeitest, als eine perfekte Liste.

WAS WIR DIR BIETEN

  • Gehalt: 60.000–80.000 € brutto pro Jahr je nach Erfahrung, unbefristete Vollzeitstelle

  • Freiheit: 100 % remote, auch aus dem Ausland möglich (nach Absprache), mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten rund um gemeinsame Kernzeiten, ohne Pendeln und ohne Bürokratie

  • Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung, Entscheidungen fallen schnell

SO BEWIRBST DU DICH

title: Senior Commercial Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Opportunity:

We’re looking for an exceptional commercial lawyer to join our lean, high-impact legal team as our second commercial lawyer. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of law and business strategy — a deal-maker with sharp instincts, sound judgment, and genuine excitement about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech.

Our legal team has a real seat at the table. You’ll close deals that matter, shape legal strategy at the frontier of AI, and craft commercial frameworks that are being built for the first time in this space. You’ll also help establish a legal function that scales with a company on a steep trajectory, reporting directly to our AssociateGeneral Counsel (Commercial). This role will be based in the UK/EU and will play a lead role in supporting our growing UK/EU and APAC business, including our expanding presence in the UK, EU, India, Australia, and Singapore.

This is a role for a builder.

What You’ll Do

  • Structure, negotiate, and close enterprise sales and partnership agreements, along with supporting a range of other commercial deals (including vendor and services agreements, data licenses, and marketing arrangements)

  • Serve as a trusted partner to our sales and business development teams, helping them move faster and smarter

  • Bring customer empathy to every negotiation, understanding the businesses we serve well enough to craft agreements that close faster and hold up longer

  • Design and implement scalable legal processes — standardizing deal terms, building templates, and streamlining the path to signed agreement

  • Provide clear, practical guidance on privacy, intellectual property, data security, and AI-specific legal issues as they arise

  • Navigate cross-border commercial and regulatory issues across the UK/EU and APAC and structure appropriate data transfer mechanisms (SCCs, adequacy decisions, BCRs) for our voice data processing

  • Stay ahead of the evolving legal landscape for AI technologies and their impact on customers, translating developments into actionable guidance for our teams

  • Roll up your sleeves on the full breadth of legal issues that come with being a fast-growing startup

You’ll Love This Role If You

  • Value working with leadership that has tenure and a track record of success, along with A Players as cross-functional partners

  • Get energized by building systems from scratch and establishing foundational practices

  • Are very practical in addressing legal issues and allergic to unnecessary friction

  • Have an abiding spirit of idealism about your chosen profession — you’re not just closing deals, you’re building something that matters

  • Have a point of view on what good lawyering looks like and a healthy sense of humor about everything else

It’s Important To Us That You Have

  • JD, LLM, or equivalent law degree/qualification from an accredited institution and 5–12 years of experience in legal practice (or more), in-house, at a firm, or both

  • Demonstrated strength in commercial transactions internationally, particularly across UK/EU and APAC markets, across enterprise deals, partnerships, and other strategic relationships

  • Fluency in the issues that matter most to us: IP, privacy, data security, and data licensing. A successful candidate will have depth of experience in at least some of these areas, and a willingness to learn the rest.

  • Practical experience with data protection regimes relevant to our footprint and with structuring cross-border transfer mechanisms

  • Recognize that law is about the grey areas, and are comfortable living in them, while giving clear and actionable advice.

  • Exceptional writing — precise, plain, and compelling

It Would Be Great if You Had

  • Experience helping a high-growth startup scale its sales motion — you know what good looks like and how to build legal infrastructure that accelerates rather than slows the business.

  • Hands-on experience with commercial and legal issues in the AI space

  • Prior experience supporting a U.S.-headquartered company’s commercial expansion into the UK/EU and/or APAC

We read cover letters! If you want to stand out: Tell us about your strategy for effectively closing deals, or how you’ve used AI to increase the impact of your work

We offer an unparalleled opportunity to be part of the future of the travel experiences industry.

Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, Experiences, the Senior Director of Destination Management leads Viator's global destination management team. You will bring a deep understanding of the global operator community and use it to develop strategies that solve business problems and support our mutual goal with operators: delivering exceptional experiences to travelers. 

This is an operational role. You will be expected to deliver significant business outcomes by leading and motivating a global team, with decisive leadership and a strong bias for action.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2 to 3 days per week in our London Office.

Key Responsibilities: 

Operator Community and Destination Strategy

  • Hold a deep, current understanding of the operator community: its needs, economics, competitive options and pain points. Use it to shape how we win and retain supply.

  • Own the 3 year destination management strategy and translate it into clear regional charters and measurable KPIs, growing revenue and market share in leading destinations.

  • Develop strategies that solve business problems for both operators and Viator, in support of delivering exceptional traveler experiences.

  • Own financial rigor: use fresh business data and pacing to steer the business, and help your team understand the financial impact of its decisions and be accountable for it.

Team Leadership and Talent

  • Act as chief architect of the global destination management organization. Lead and mentor Regional Managers, and design an organization and operating model that fits the business as it evolves.

  • Set and hold the hiring bar, run rigorous and consistent performance management, and calibrate with peers across Supply.

  • Build and retain top talent, and maintain a leadership bench and succession plan for Regional Manager roles.

  • Set the standard for leadership: humble, open to feedback, and skilled at leading teams through change.

  • Be clear on what each person and region owns, and hold them accountable for it. Push decisions to the lowest appropriate level while stepping in personally on cross-regional or cross-functional problems no one else owns.

Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Set the standard for hypothesis quality and test design. Define what the team needs to learn, require evidence and experimentation over opinion, and prioritize what operators and travelers actually do over what they say.

Connectivity

  • Ensure industry-leading connectivity with the features and support operators need. Oversee the connectivity support team and partner with R&D to build enhanced connectivity features.

Innovation and AI

  • Drive innovation by bringing in outside ideas through industry conferences, councils and competitor insight, and share what works across functions.

  • Advocate for and implement AI and automation to transform productivity and quality, including rethinking roles and workflows. Scale proven wins across regions, build team AI skills, and use AI responsibly within our governance and data-privacy guidelines.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Inspirational Leader: An authentic, humble leader who builds trust, develops talent and cultivates a winning culture.

What We Offer

  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.

  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. title: Senior Director, Digital Marketing
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity 

Digital marketing has been fundamentally restructured by AI — and we need a leader who doesn't just understand that shift, but is actively shaping it. This is not a role for someone catching up; it's for someone who's already operating in the new paradigm. 

As Senior Director of Digital Marketing, you will own AvePoint's end-to-end digital presence and performance — from how we're discovered by AI answer engines to how we convert pipeline on the website. You'll lead SEO/GEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), paid media, and web conversion strategy, building a fully AI-powered digital org that stays ahead of the curve on every front. 

What You'll Own 

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & GEO 

  • Define and lead AvePoint's strategy for AI-driven search visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Gemini, and emerging LLM platforms. 
  • Build AEO accountability frameworks: benchmark tracking, citation monitoring, share-of-voice in AI-generated answers, and input/output OKRs across contributing teams. 
  • Partner with Brand, Demand Gen, and AR teams on content and structural approaches that increase AvePoint's citation frequency in AI answer surfaces. 
  • Stay 6–12 months ahead of platform changes — from structured data to semantic search to agent-based browsing — and translate emerging signals into actionable strategy. 

SEO Strategy & Organic Performance 

  • Own organic search strategy across the full funnel — from brand and category terms to long-tail buying-stage content — with direct ownership of Ahrefs (Brand Radar) and GA4 reporting. 
  • Lead technical SEO: site architecture, Core Web Vitals, crawlability, schema markup, and content velocity programs. 
  • Build AI-assisted content workflows that accelerate topical authority without sacrificing quality signals or E-E-A-T. 
  • Establish and track SEO/GEO channel benchmarks across impressions, clicks, and campaign members as part of the full marketing funnel measurement model. 

Paid Media & Performance Marketing 

  • Oversee paid media investment across Google, LinkedIn, display, and programmatic — with direct accountability for MQL volume, cost per MQL (benchmark: $4K), and SAL conversion rates. 
  • Deploy AI-native campaign management: automated bidding, creative testing at scale, predictive audience modeling, and intent signal integration from 6sense and Clearbit Reveal. 
  • Partner with RevOps and Analytics to connect paid spend to pipeline attribution as the attribution model matures (Dreamdata evaluation in progress). 
  • Manage paid media budgets with rigor — optimizing channel mix across regions (AMER, EMEA, ANZ) and product categories (AI Governance, Resilience). 

Website & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) 

  • Own the AvePoint website as a revenue-generating asset: information architecture, UX, messaging alignment, and conversion performance across all campaign and product landing pages. 
  • Lead CRO programs — A/B testing, personalization (in partnership with 6sense and Clearbit), and conversion path optimization — with GA4 and pipeline as the primary success metrics. 
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing on solution and persona-based web journeys; with Brand on design system consistency; and with Demand Gen on campaign landing page performance. 
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools for dynamic content, intelligent chat, and web personalization to improve engagement and self-service pipeline creation. 

Building an AI-Powered Digital Org 

  • Model and enforce AI proficiency standards across the Digital Marketing team — targeting L4 proficiency (The Neuron's 5-Level Framework) by year-end, with at least one L5 agent deployed. 
  • Identify, pilot, and scale AI tools across every digital function: content generation, keyword research, ad creative testing, reporting automation, and audience intelligence. 
  • Create a culture of continuous learning and experimentation — running fast, documenting what works, and distributing knowledge across the broader growth marketing org. 
  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on AI-driven digital marketing, educating the ELT and cross-functional stakeholders on implications and opportunities. 

How We'll Measure Success 

You'll be accountable to AvePoint's full marketing funnel — from impressions to pipeline — with digital owning specific stages:

Who You Are 

  • 8+ years of B2B digital marketing experience, with at least 3 years in a senior leadership role owning paid media, SEO, and web. 
  • Demonstrated expertise in AEO and GEO — you've been tracking and optimizing for AI-generated answer surfaces, not just reading about them. 
  • Deep hands-on experience with GA4, paid search/social platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn), SEO tooling (Ahrefs, SEMrush), and marketing automation (Marketo preferred). 
  • Proven ability to connect digital spend to pipeline outcomes — you understand attribution, work well with RevOps, and don't hide behind vanity metrics. 
  • Experience scaling AI tooling across a team — not just using AI yourself, but building processes, workflows, and capability frameworks for others. 
  • Strong analytical instincts: you read data, form hypotheses, test them, and ship results. 
  • Executive-ready communication — you can translate digital performance into business impact for ELT and board audiences. 

Strongly Preferred 

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, security, or data governance — familiarity with complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes. 
  • Experience with ABM platforms like 6sense or intent data tools (Bombora, Clearbit Reveal). 
  • Exposure to Dynamics 365 and Marketo in a pipeline-reporting context. 
  • Comfort operating in a global org with regional go-to-market nuance (AMER, EMEA, ANZ). 
  • Active participant in digital marketing communities, newsletters, or public thought leadership on AI-driven marketing. 

The Signal We're Looking For 

The right person for this role doesn't wait for the industry to settle before making a move. They're already running experiments in AEO. They've replaced manual reporting workflows with AI agents. They have a point of view on where search is going in 18 months — and they're building for it now. They hold themselves accountable to pipeline, not just impressions.
