title: Senior Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

Senior Product Engineer

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 2 in-person days a week.

Compensation: £120k base salary plus equity

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

How we do it

Most tools start and stop with dashboards. We start with the hard part: turning fragmented, messy enterprise data into a consistent foundation people can trust. Then we use AI to make it conversational, so anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer they can act on.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

The data is only half the story. As AI gets better at analysing large volumes of data, the hard part shifts to the product: helping customers explore and understand what the model finds, designing for trust, and turning insight into action.

You’ll shape how customers work with agentic AI, balancing the stability and reliability enterprises expect with the new, agent-driven experiences we’re building at the cutting edge. You’ll have real autonomy in how you approach it, working in a small, high-trust team with genuine influence over product, architecture and how engineering grows.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and ship high-quality frontend experiences across Deducta's platform.

  • Work directly with customers to understand their problems, and turn those insights into product decisions.

  • Build interfaces that make large datasets, dynamic metrics and AI-generated analysis clear and useful.

  • Design for the limits of AI, so customers know when to trust an answer and how to check it.

  • Push the boundaries of applied AI, both in the product and in how we build it.

  • Own problems end to end, from definition to deployment, making sound calls on architecture, usability, performance and maintainability along the way.

Success in this role means:

  • Customers go from data to decisions: Features you've shipped help customers explore AI-generated analysis and act on it, not just search through data.

  • Trustworthy AI experiences: Customers can see where an answer came from and when to check it, so their confidence in Deducta grows as they use it more.

  • A product foundation others build on: The components and patterns you've built are fast, consistent and reused across the product by the team.

Who you are

You're a senior product engineer who cares as much about the problem as the code, and takes ideas all the way to production. You don't need a background in enterprise data or procurement. We care about how you think and the quality of the products you've built.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Strong JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals, with experience building high-quality frontend applications.

  • Experience making complex data, information or workflows easy for people to understand and act on.

  • A clear view of what AI systems can and can't do, and how good product design accounts for outputs that aren't always right.

  • Sound judgement on architecture and product trade-offs, and the ability to explain the reasoning behind your decisions.

  • A track record of owning problems from investigation through to production.

  • High standards for testing, code quality and maintainability, and clear communication with engineers, customers and stakeholders.

  • A founder mindset: you see a problem and feel empowered to work out how to solve it.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call

  2. Background interview

  3. Technical interview

  4. Final interview

  5. Offer, referencing and start

Your Role

As Senior Product Manager for Integrations & AI Foundations, you're the product owner for bunch's integration and AI platform. You have two kinds of customers: external developers and fund-manager teams connecting to bunch, and the internal product teams building on top of what this team provides.

Integrations & AI Foundations is a new platform squad. It owns the infrastructure that lets data move securely between bunch and other systems, and lets every other product team build AI capabilities — extraction, retrieval, agents and evaluations — without each one solving the same hard problems again.

The team covers five connected areas:

  • Integrations / API layer — API contracts, authentication, versioning and deprecation, rate limits, uptime and SLA, and a Developer Portal

  • MCP layer — agent-callable tools built as thin wrappers over the same API contracts, including a customer-facing MCP offering

  • Document Parsing — a reusable ingestion, decomposition and extraction pipeline, with human-in-the-loop review and accuracy monitoring

  • Retrieval / RAG — chunking, embedding, vector store and retrieval, with access control enforced on every query, offered as a callable service

  • AI Agentic Layer — the agent framework, memory, guardrails, evaluation harness, observability and agent registry other teams use to ship their own agents

Document extraction, agent workflows, evaluations and multi-provider model fallback under EU data residency are already in production.

Fund managers don't want to retype data that already lives in their own systems, and they want to pull their bunch data into their own tools and their own AI. Customers and prospects ask for APIs, CRM and accounting syncs, automated exports of capital accounts, and MCP access.

You'll turn those signals into a coherent platform: one that customers integrate with, and that our own product teams build on, instead of a string of one-off builds.

You will:

  • Set platform strategy and sequencing across the five areas: decide how to slice the work and what ships first

title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
  • Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
  • Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.
  • Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.
  • Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.
  • Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.
  • Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent on high-scale search or ranking systems: web search, feed ranking at a large social platform, or a large ad engine.

  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how retrieval fits into agentic workflows.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, moving between strategy and execution without losing the thread.
  • The ability to influence and align cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Depth in information retrieval, NLP, or applied machine learning beyond what the role requires.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Company

At AccountsIQ, part of the AIQ Group, we’re on a mission to deeply understand our customers and deliver technology that enriches their lives. Alongside ExpenseIn, a leading expense management platform within the group, we provide smart, feature-rich financial management software designed for ambitious businesses that have outgrown basic starter systems or seek a simpler, more affordable alternative to complex, costly ERP solutions.

Our cloud-based accounting software transforms the finance function, making it easier for multi-entity businesses to capture, process, and report their financial data with ease and efficiency.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to take the foundations set out in our growth strategy, our product vision and our customer focus and drive a throughline across every team, every launch and every customer touchpoint. You'll report to our Product Director and work closely with marketing, sales, account management, implementation and customer success, so the whole business tells the same story to the right customers. 

It's a hands-on role that balances strategy, operations and execution. You’ll inform critical decisions, do the work yourself and build the systems that let it scale. You'll also be the voice of our product, inside the business and out. There's plenty of room for this role to grow as the function does. 

What you'll be doing:

Understand 

  • Know our best fit customers better than anyone. Deepen our understanding of who we serve best, our core segments and the people involved in buying and using our products. Feed that directly into product decisions, and make sure messaging and launches are built around it. 
  • Reset competitive intelligence. Build a clear view of the landscape that helps teams win against the systems customers are outgrowing and the alternatives they're weighing up. 

Shape 

  • Develop the complete value proposition. Work with product and service leads so today's product, what's coming and the service experience (onboarding, implementation and customer success) all deliver on our positioning. 
  • Shape how customers see what we offer. Help evolve how our products and services are structured, named and packaged, in step with the roadmap, so the offer is easy to understand, shows where it's heading and gives every launch an obvious place to fit. 
  • Connect product value to commercial results. Understand how each release adds value for customers, and help us capture it in new business, expansion and retention. Measure the impact of launches and enablement on pipeline, win rates and adoption. 

Deliver 

  • Lead the go-to-market rhythm. Run how product, marketing and customer-facing teams across our product family prepare for and deliver launches, so the right work happens at the right time and everyone knows where things stand. 
  • Be the voice of our product. Speak at customer roadshows, events and webinars, and give our point of view on market shifts, such as what AI means for finance leaders in the UK and Ireland. 
  • Strengthen our core, open up what's next. Make our proven go-to-market motion sharper while building new ones for the new segments our product roadmap opens up.  
  • Enable the whole business. Make sure every team, from sales and customer success to support and product, understands our customers, segments, competitors and positioning well enough to move their own work forward at pace. Clear enough to act on, deep enough to rely on. 
  • Turn positioning into pipeline. Work hand in hand with demand generation on campaign messaging, ABM plays, paid copy and outbound sequences. 
  • Build a go-to-market system that stays current. Use AI and automation to keep customer and market insight flowing in, and keep messaging, battle cards, proof and customer stories up to date and easy to find. 

What you'll need:

  • Typically six or more years in B2B SaaS product marketing, including launches for a product bought through a considered, sales-led process. 
  • Experience being part of building or scaling a product marketing function, ideally in a scale-up. 
  • Scale-up instincts. You know what breaks as a business outgrows its earlier stage habits, and how to fix it. 
  • Hands-on use of AI to run product marketing better: synthesising research, keeping content current, and building workflows that save the team time, with the judgement to know when the output is right. 
  • Ownership of positioning and messaging, seen through to how the business sells, onboards and supports customers. 
  • A track record of running go-to-market across product, sales and customer success, leading through influence rather than authority. 
  • Customer understanding you've built first-hand: interviews, win/loss, segmentation and personas, and evidence it changed what a product team built. 
  • Based in the UK or Ireland, with regular time in our London and Dublin offices. 

Desirable: 

  • Experience in finance, accounting or fintech software, especially selling to finance leaders 
  • Marketing a multi-product suite, or bringing products and teams together 
  • Working with an offer where experience (implementation, onboarding, customer success) is part of the value 

What's the hiring process?

  1. An initial call with our People Team to discuss your experience, career goals and interest in joining AccountsIQ.
  2. An interview with our Product Director and our Product Consultant to explore your product marketing experience, strategic approach and commercial impact.
  3. A short practical exercise presented to a panel from Product, Operations and Finance, focusing on your approach to positioning and bringing a product to market.

Why work with us?

AIQ Group brings together AccountsIQ and ExpenseIn, two ambitious SaaS businesses helping finance teams work smarter. In 2026, AccountsIQ was recognised as SaaS Provider of the Year at the International Accounting Awards and ranked #477 in the Financial Times FT1000 list of Europe's fastest-growing companies.

Following a €60M investment in 2024, we're continuing to grow our products, our people and our impact, making this an exciting time to join the business.

Our TEAM values aren't just words on a wall; they shape how we work every day:

  • Together - We work towards shared goals, support one another and celebrate success as one team.
  • Energy - We bring curiosity, positivity and urgency, focusing on what matters most for our customers and colleagues.
  • Action - We take ownership, make decisions and deliver with purpose.
  • Mindset - We embrace feedback, think big and continually raise the bar for ourselves and each other.

If you're looking for a business that's growing quickly, values collaboration and gives people the opportunity to make a genuine impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Some of our perks 

  • 28 days annual leave + bank holidays + your birthday off
  • Working from abroad - up to 6 weeks per calendar year 
  • Private Health Insurance 
  • 5% Pension contribution 
  • Life Assurance - 4 x Salary 
  • Income Benefit 
  • Wellbeing initiatives  

By submitting your application, you agree that AccountsIQ Group may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organisation planning, and related purposes. title: Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) - Agentur für Handelsmarketing
descriptionHtml:
TEAMWFP ist eine Agentur für kreatives VkF-Marketing in Mönchengladbach. Seit 45 Jahren betreut die Agentur Unternehmen aus Handel und Finanzen in der Verkaufs- und Markenkommunikation: Prospekte, Mailings, Instore Design, Verpackungen und Kampagnen, für Kunden wie PENNY, Kaufland oder die Sparkassen. Gesucht wird eine erfahrene Beraterin oder ein erfahrener Berater als Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) in Vollzeit: die Schnittstelle zwischen Kreation und Kunde, mit eigenen Kunden und einem Beraterteam von fünf bis sechs Leuten.

Das Besondere bei TEAMWFP: Jeder Kunde wird auf Senior-Level betreut. Es gibt keinen Kunden, der an Praktikanten und Junioren abgegeben wird, und keine Ebene, die zwischen dir und deiner Arbeit steht. Im Agenturverbund arbeiten rund 30 Leute. Große Meetings gibt es kaum, vieles wird kurz über den Flur abgestimmt, und die beiden Creative Directors arbeiten selbst mit am Produkt. Du berätst viele Kunden aus Handel und Finanzen, ohne mehrere Ebenen zwischen dir und den Entscheidungen und ohne jeden Tag nach Düsseldorf zu pendeln.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Kreation und Kunde und koordinierst jedes Projekt vom Briefing bis zur Produktionsreife.
  • Du vertrittst die Agentur in Abstimmungen beim Kunden und arbeitest dich inhaltlich in alle Projekte ein.
  • Du bereitest Briefings verständlich für dein Team auf und erarbeitest kommunikative Lösungen, allein oder mit der Kreation.
  • Du prüfst alle Werbemittel formal und inhaltlich, bevor sie an den Kunden gehen, und kalkulierst und überwachst die Kosten selbst.
  • Du übernimmst Beratungsaufgaben der Geschäftsführung und steuerst das Beraterteam mit.

Was du mitbringst

  • Eine Ausbildung als Kaufmann oder Kauffrau für Marketingkommunikation oder ein Studium im Bereich Marketing. Erfahrung zählt mehr als der Abschluss.
  • Erfahrung im Agenturumfeld oder in einer Marketingabteilung auf Kundenseite, Handelsmarketing ist ein Plus.
  • Fundiertes Marketingwissen, mit dem du Kunden strategisch berätst und Leistungen verkaufst.
  • Du greifst gern zum Hörer, behältst in vollen Phasen die Ruhe und bist sicher in Excel, Word und PowerPoint. Sehr gutes Deutsch ist Voraussetzung.

Was dich bei TEAMWFP erwartet

  • Ein Gehalt ab 4.000 € im Monat, je nach Erfahrung nach oben offen.
  • Senior-Level auf jedem Kunden: In Beratung und Kreation sitzen erfahrene Leute am Tisch, Entscheidungen fallen schnell und direkt.
  • Viele Kunden und nie dasselbe: Vom Handel bis zur Bank übernimmt die Agentur fast jede Aufgabe, die ein Kunde stellt, und arbeitet bei den meisten Kunden nicht in festen Teams.
  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit von 10 bis 15 Uhr, Überstunden werden ausgeglichen. Wochenend- und Nachtschichten gibt es nicht.
  • Ein fester, eigener Arbeitsplatz in kleinen Büros für eine bis drei Personen statt Großraum und Desk Sharing.
  • Ein Backsteinbau im Nordpark mit Aufenthaltsraum und Billardtisch, aus Gladbach auch gut mit dem Fahrrad erreichbar.

Ehrlich gesagt: Als Schnittstelle hängst du an vielen Leuten. Vom Kunden brauchst du Infos, von Konzept und Gestaltung pünktliche Ergebnisse, und phasenweise wird es stressig. Der Tipp aus dem Team: von Anfang an die eigenen Grenzen setzen.

Diese Stelle wird über JobMatches vorgestellt. Bewirb dich jetzt als Senior Projektmanager Marketing (m/w/d) bei TEAMWFP in Mönchengladbach. Nach einem kurzen Telefonat lernst du Kim Finocchiaro und die Geschäftsführung persönlich kennen.

title: Senior Proposal Writer
descriptionHtml:
At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's why we're looking for people who are bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about what's possible, and committed to delivering results.

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

Senior Proposal Writer- Open to UK, France and Netherlands

The Senior Proposal Writer leads the most complex, high-stakes and non-standard RFX responses from intake to submission, as a trusted partner to Sales. Alongside Solution Consulting and subject-matter experts, this role guides strategy shaping, pulls the contributions together and delivers proposals that are clear, accurate and give buyers confidence in the outcomes OneStream delivers. The role also coaches other writers and helps raise the standards, content and tools the whole team works with. 

Primary Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Lead complex, high-stakes and non-standard RFI, RFP and RFQ responses from intake to submission, maintaining the highest standards of execution and submission integrity. 
  • Work with Sales to understand the deal behind each response (the buyer’s priorities, the competition, the evidence that builds confidence) and shape the proposal around it. 
  • Coordinate concurrent contributions from Sales, Solution Consulting, Finance, Legal, Product and other specialist teams. 
  • Set and run the project cadence (including kick-off, RFP tool setup, check-ins, reviews, packaging and close-down), creating clarity, facilitating multiple contributors and consistently meeting deadlines and milestones. 
  • Take each response over the line, checking structure, formatting, accuracy and clarity before it goes. 

Knowledge & Continuous Improvement 

  • Keep knowledge of OneStream’s platform and competitive positioning current, and catch outdated or inaccurate product information before it goes out. 
  • Spot gaps and help close them, in how responses are crafted and positioned and in the standards, workflows, templates, tools and content library behind them. 
  • Turn lessons from completed proposals and their outcomes into guidance, content and examples the whole team can use. 
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully across the workflow, and share the prompts and practices that improve insight, quality, consistency and pace. 

Collaboration, Coaching & Influence 

  • Build strong relationships with the teams relied on, know their remit and boundaries, and route requests well so that colleagues’ time is used efficiently. 
  • Coach junior and mid-level writers with practical feedback on their work and the thinking behind strong proposal decisions, and help new joiners get up to speed. 
  • Shape how the team approaches content, quality and process, and model the standards expected of the team. 

Competencies 

  • Sound judgement on structure, messaging and emphasis when requirements are ambiguous, incomplete or non-standard, a willingness to adapt when the standard approach doesn’t fit, and ownership of the decisions made. 
  • Influence without direct authority, built on trust. 
  • The confidence to hold a reasoned position with Sales on quality and standards, with an open mind and a realistic view of what each deal needs. 
  • A commercial view of how proposals drive revenue, and the focus to put effort where it most influences the buyer’s decision. 
  • Self-motivation and accountability, working independently and delivering as part of a team. 
  • A habit of learning, spotting opportunities in their own skills and developing them. 

Required Education and Experience 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, English, Marketing or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • Seven or more years writing and managing RFI, RFP and RFQ responses, working alongside sales teams on competitive, high-value deals. 
  • Professional experience using AI tools in a writing, editing or content workflow. 
  • Experience coaching or mentoring colleagues and contributing to team knowledge sharing. 

Preferred Education and Experience 

  • Experience in a cloud or SaaS environment, ideally in finance or a related domain. 
  • Experience with Ombud or a comparable proposal management platform. 
  • Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM in opportunity and proposal workflows. 
  • APMP preferred but not required. 

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 

  • Ability to analyse complex business processes, enterprise technology and buyer requirements, and work out what they mean for the response and where the gaps are. 
  • Exceptional writing, editing and verbal communication, turning complex technical, business and commercial information into accurate, persuasive content. 
  • Ability to prioritise competing projects, manage time effectively and stay accurate as deadlines shift. 
  • Solid grasp of sales frameworks, buyer enablement, and revenue operations. 

Supervisory Responsibilities 

n/a. 

Travel 

Regular travel is not expected for this position.

title: Senior QARA Engineer
descriptionHtml:
🏨 L’entreprise

Resilience Care, acteur majeur de la télésurveillance médicale et partenaire de la recherche clinique, est une société française fondée en 2021 avec une mission : mieux soigner.
Notre entreprise propose des solutions de télésurveillance en oncologie, gastro-entérologie et psychiatrie, basées sur la collecte d’ePRO associées à des techniques d’IA. Elles s’appuient sur une plateforme de suivi pour les professionnels de santé, permettant une détection précoce des effets secondaires pour une prise en charge continue et anticipée, et une application mobile pour les patients, permettant de mesurer et gérer leurs symptômes grâce à des ressources adaptées.
Nos solutions permettent d’optimiser les prises en charge, d’enrichir la compréhension des patients en continu pendant leur parcours de soin et d’accélérer la recherche clinique grâce à la collecte, la structuration et l’analyse fine des données de vie réelle. Elles sont aujourd'hui déployées en routine auprès de 35 000 patients, dans plus de 200 établissements de santé, mais également dans le cadre d’une vingtaine d’études cliniques académiques et industrielles.
Nous mettons ainsi la donnée au service du soin et de l’innovation thérapeutique avec l’ambition de permettre à chaque patient de bénéficier d’une médecine personnalisée.

📝 Ton rôle

En quelques mots : En tant que Senior QARA Engineer, tu assures la conformité et la robustesse de notre dispositif médical logiciel tout au long de son cycle de vie, en travaillant au plus près des équipes produit et tech.

Ton impact : Tu contribues directement à la continuité de nos activités critiques (maintien sur le marché, certifications, et support de la recherche clinique) en garantissant un niveau de qualité et de conformité adapté à une scale-up en croissance.

Ton quotidien :

  • Produire et tenir à jour la documentation réglementaire (dossiers techniques, éléments de conformité).

✨ Ton équipe

Ici, on ne travaille pas en silo. Tu rejoins une structure agile où la conformité est un vrai sport d'équipe :

  • Ta Manager : Yasmine, la gardienne de la conformité réglementaire de nos dispositifs médicaux (DM). Elle t'apportera sa vision stratégique du secteur santé et sera ton point d'appui sur les arbitrages les plus sensibles.

  • Ton équipe de cœur : Un trio d'experts passionnés. Ce sont tes interlocuteurs quotidiens pour tout ce qui touche au SMQ, aux dossiers techniques et à la préparation des audits.

  • Le petit ➕ de l'équipe : Un contexte unique où sécurité, clinique et réglementaire se rejoignent pour mieux servir les patients portée par une équipe qui allie rigueur et bienveillance.

  • ⚙️ Tu es la bonne personne si tu sais :

    • Collaborer avec des équipes Produit/Tech dès le design pour “faire la qualité” dans le delivery.

    • Piloter ou contribuer à des sujets PMS, réclamations, CAPA.

  • 🙂 Tu es la bonne personne si tu as :

    • Capacité à challenger avec tact et à fédérer sans hiérarchie.

    • As déjà travaillé sur des études clinique

💛 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Une mission de santé à fort impact, portée par une ambition de médecine personnalisée.

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

VP Sales - Europe

• Own the full sales cycle for a portfolio of enterprise accounts — from first conversation through to close — and grow revenue across both existing relationships and new business within CPOs, retail, hospitality, amusement & recreation, and telecoms.

Requirements

title: Senior SecOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior SecOps Engineer to take ownership of security operations at Flagstone. That covers everything from alert triage and incident response through to detection engineering and continuous improvement of how our SOC works.

This is a hands-on role that sits right at the operational end of security. You’ll spend real time in the alert queue, as well as building the detections and automation that make it better. You’ll be right in the middle of complex investigations and P1s, while also shaping how the function operates. You’ll also own our relationship with our managed SOC provider, setting the standards they work to rather than simply receiving their output.

About the team

You’ll sit within Security Engineering, reporting to our Security Team Leader. In this role you’ll own detection, triage and incident response, and act as the technical counterpart to our managed SOC provider. That means directing their scope, holding them to clear detection and response standards, and keeping ownership of anything escalated or high severity in house.

Does this sound like you?

You’re an engineer at heart. You’d rather write the detection than describe it, and you treat detections and automation like any other engineering work: version controlled, tested and documented. You’re the go to expert when something serious happens, and you can explain security risk just as clearly to engineers as to senior stakeholders.

You’re curious about new technology, AI included, and you have a clear view on where it genuinely helps and where it introduces risk.

What you’ll do

You’ll take ownership of our SOC operations and report on their performance and health to stakeholders across the business. You’ll run investigations and incident response for complex or high severity alerts, managing parallel workstreams, keeping stakeholders informed and running post incident reviews through to real changes in detections or process.

You’ll own the detection engineering backlog, building, tuning and retiring detections across Microsoft Sentinel and Defender, mapped to a coverage model such as MITRE ATT&CK. You’ll turn threat intelligence into detection logic and hunting activity, and drive our automation and SOAR maturity by building Logic App playbooks that reduce manual effort without losing judgement on the nuanced cases.

You’ll manage our managed SOC relationship day to day: defining scope and escalation criteria, reviewing performance against SLAs and acting as the technical escalation point for anything they can’t close. You’ll keep playbooks, escalation paths and documentation in shape so the practice scales beyond any one person, and you’ll track metrics like triage time, false positive rate and coverage gaps to drive continuous improvement.

You’ll also explore and introduce AI assisted tooling into SOC workflows, such as triage and enrichment copilots, detection authoring and alert summarisation, where it clearly makes a difference, with sensible boundaries on where human judgement stays in the loop.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in a SOC, security operations or detection engineering role, with progression into a senior IC position

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel and Defender, building detections rather than just consuming alerts

  • Experience running investigations and incident response, including communicating with stakeholders under pressure

  • Experience building SOAR and automation content (for example Sentinel Logic Apps), including monitoring for silent failure

  • A strong grasp of attack patterns and MITRE ATT&CK, and how to turn them into a detection coverage model

  • Experience directing a managed or outsourced SOC or MDR provider, setting scope, SLAs and escalation criteria

  • Practical experience applying AI or LLM tooling to SecOps work

  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders

  • Critical thinking and a real curiosity for new technologies and frameworks

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience in regulated financial services

  • Exposure to identity centric detection (Entra ID) and cloud native threat detection

  • GCIH, GCFA or an equivalent hands-on IR or detection certification

  • Links to the SOC and detection engineering community, through conferences, speaking or open source detection content such as Sigma rules

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Around the World scheme - 3 months work from anywhere scheme

  • Mental wellbeing support – Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Learning and development – £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave – enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.  

All are welcome.

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Application
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

ROLE SUMMARY 

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Senior Security Engineer, Application for our Engineering and Technology team. You own application security for Firmus AI Cloud and the internal software that runs it. Automation is how you scale that ownership. Customers provision GPU compute through API and console, software engineers build against it, and our operators run the platform through the same control plane. You own the security of that software: the public APIs, the services behind them, how tenants stay separated inside the application, and the AI assistants and agents we ship on top. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Automation and secure delivery 

  • Own the CI/CD security gates that every production repository passes through: SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, and SBOM generation. 
  • Build the systems that do the repeatable work: finding triage, dependency uplift, evidence collection, and draft threat models.  
  • Ship the secure paved roads other teams build on: reusable libraries, service templates, and developer tooling. 
  • Write and review code in the services you protect, including the security-critical paths that tools miss. 

Security architecture and standards 

  • Set the application security standard and control for authentication, authorisation between services, tenant isolation at the application boundary, secret handling and logging. 
  • Lead threat modelling and secure design review. Define what an attacker can do and what must be true before it ships. 
  • Set the security requirements for the AI assistants and agents we ship e.g. prompt injection, context poisoning. 
  • Govern which tools and tool servers our AI agents and software engineers may reach, and how those integrations are scoped, allow-listed, and audited. 

Assurance and vulnerability management 

  • Own application security posture across our services: what is covered, what is open, what is accepted with a named owner and an expiry, and what is overdue. 
  • Prioritise fixes on exploitability and exposure alongside CVSS and hold them to the Firmus vulnerability SLAs. 
  • Drive remediation with the teams that own the code so issues close at the source. 
  • Extend SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 into the software delivery path as services and sites grow. Evidence that a control ran should be a query, not a spreadsheet exercise. 

Enablement and escalation 

  • Coach security champions inside each team so secure design decisions get made without waiting for you. 
  • Provide application-security expertise during incidents and convert recurring failure modes into gates, tests, standards, or developer tooling. 
  • Give engineering leadership a straight read on application risk and release readiness. Join customer conversations when the question is application security. 

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field. 
  • 7+ years in application security, product security, or software engineering with a security focus. 
  • Experience securing a public cloud or multi-tenant platform with a public API. 
  • Deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP API Security Top 10. Has threat modelled multi-tenant APIs in production: identity, authorisation between services, tenant isolation, and the ways a client abuses a published contract using STRIDE or an equivalent method, both for REST and gRPC. 
  • Has improved the security posture of software built by other engineering teams through standards, tooling, review, or secure-by-default patterns. 
  • Has owned CI/CD security gates in production (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, SBOM) and tuned them to deliver actionable findings with low false-positive rates that engineers trusted and acted upon. 
  • Writes production-quality code in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript. 
  • Has replaced manual security work with automation: finding triage, dependency uplift, evidence collection, or regression tests that run without someone watching them. 
  • Hands-on with LLM-backed or agentic features: prompt injection, tool misuse, agent identity and delegated credentials, cross-tenant data leakage, and controls on generated code reaching production. Familiar with OWASP guidance for LLM and agentic applications. 
  • Deep practical experience with OAuth, OIDC, JWT, RBAC or ABAC, application-layer cryptography, token handling, and secrets in software. 
  • Has worked under SOC 2 Type 2 or ISO 27001 and can produce evidence that a control ran. 
  • Willing to join incident response for application and API security. 
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally when the role requires it. 
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English 

Bonus Points 

  • Experience securing AI agents, sandboxed code execution environments, or systems where AI-generated output can trigger automated actions. 
  • Has run a vulnerability disclosure programme. 
  • Security certifications with application-security depth, such as CSSLP or OSWE. 

LOCATION 

Singapore or Australia

title: Senior Software Engineer, Climate
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Climate Matters More Than Ever

Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions.

Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold.

The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action.

The Opportunity

Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions.

You will be the primary engineer for Climate, working independently of our existing engineering teams and partnering closely with the Climate Manager, your main day-to-day business stakeholder.

Think of it as a small startup within Flexport: direct access to the business, a broad scope, and substantial ownership. Together with the Climate Manager, you will identify the most valuable problems to solve, shape the product direction, and turn ideas into reliable software. This role calls for someone who enjoys both deciding what to build and building it.

Things We ❤️

  • Turning complex shipment and emissions data into clear, actionable choices.
  • Working directly with stakeholders and users to understand what would make their lives better.
  • Building simple, reliable products and learning from how people use them.
  • Finding opportunities where lower costs and lower emissions go together.
  • Taking an idea from an ambiguous problem to a useful product in production.

You Will

  • Work closely with Climate Programs Manager to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and translate business goals into a practical product roadmap.
  • Own delivery from problem discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, operation, and iteration.
  • Build emissions intelligence into everyday supply chain decisions, including routing, transport mode, shipment timing, and inventory planning.
  • Help customers identify opportunities to reduce emissions using Flexport’s shipment data.
  • Make lower-emission choices easier to understand and act on within existing workflows.
  • Develop products that help customers understand the wider environmental footprint of their supply chains, beyond freight.
  • Deliver useful improvements incrementally, balancing speed, scope, maintainability, and data accuracy.
  • Coordinate with other engineering teams when your work depends on shared systems, integrations, or expertise.
  • Measure whether what you ship solves the underlying problem, and use that evidence to decide what comes next.

You Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong engineering foundation and experience delivering production software.
  • A track record of working independently: you can bring structure to an unclear problem, set priorities, unblock yourself, and follow through without a detailed specification or constant direction.
  • Strong product judgment: you understand user needs, identify what is worth building, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between impact and effort.
  • Experience working closely with business stakeholders: you ask good questions, explain technical choices in plain language, and constructively challenge ideas when needed.
  • The ability to own features across the stack, including user interfaces, backend services, and data integrations.
  • A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
  • Comfort taking responsibility for the reliability and maintenance of what you build.
  • A bias for action, combined with the judgment to recognize when you need input or help.
  • An aptitude for learning quickly, including unfamiliar business domains and technologies.

Nice to Have

  • A personal motivation to work on climate and environmental challenges.
  • Experience in climate technology, emissions accounting, logistics, or supply chain software.
  • Experience building products in a startup or another small team with broad ownership.
  • Experience turning complex data into customer-facing insights and decision tools.

Prior climate experience is a plus; curiosity and the ability to learn the domain matter more.

How We Work

  • Your day-to-day work will center on a close partnership with the Climate Manager, with collaboration across engineering as needed.
  • You will have substantial autonomy and will be expected to keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, progress, and tradeoffs.
  • We build and launch incrementally, using feedback to guide the next step.
  • In Amsterdam, we come to the office two to three times a week to collaborate, whiteboard, and spend time together.
  • Flexport’s broader technology stack includes React, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Kubernetes, GraphQL, gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, and Snowflake. We welcome candidates from different technology backgrounds.

What’s in It for You?

  • Direct ownership of products that help customers make better supply chain and environmental decisions.
  • The opportunity to shape Climate technology with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Flexport.
  • Equity participation and a defined pension contribution scheme.
  • 25 vacation days based on full-time employment.
  • Fully paid premiums for Flexport’s collective health insurance plan.
  • Catered lunches, breakfast, snacks, and drinks in the office.
  • Covered home-to-office commuting costs for employees living outside Amsterdam.
  • Employee assistance and parental leave benefits.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Data Core is the storage abstraction layer behind Celonis' data pipelines. It sits between ETL workloads and the backends that run them, such as Databricks, Snowflake, StarRocks, Spark, and PostgreSQL. You will work mainly on three codebases:

  • Data Core, a Java / Spring Boot service with gRPC and message-queue APIs.
  • sqlglot, where we translate and optimize SQL across dialects.
  • StarRocks, the OLAP engine we use as a backend.

What You Will Do

  • Implement features and fix bugs in Data Core backend integrations.
  • Add and fix sqlglot dialect support: parsing, SQL generation, and transpilation correctness.
  • Investigate StarRocks behavior and compatibility issues, and contribute fixes or workarounds.
  • Debug slow or incorrect queries by following them from SQL text to query plan to results.
  • Write unit and integration tests, especially for SQL translation edge cases.
  • Take part in design discussions, write short design docs for your own work, and give and receive code reviews.
  • As a Senior: lead small to medium projects end to end and help onboard newer teammates.

What We Are Looking For

  • Solid Java, or strong Python with the willingness to work in Java daily.
  • Good SQL skills: joins, aggregations, window functions, and an understanding of how queries execute.

  • Good testing and debugging habits.
  • Clear written and spoken communication, and a habit of asking questions early.

Strong Plus

  • Exposure to how SQL parsers, ASTs, or query planners work.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack) - Merchant EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Fullstack Engineer (Go / Kotlin & React)

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

  • Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.
  • Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.
  • Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

How We Work

  • Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.
  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.
  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.
  • Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.
  • Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.
  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.
  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.
  • The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.
  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.
  • Integrations with external business systems.
  • Kafka or other streaming technologies.
  • Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

You can read more about our recruitment process here. here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Software Engineer

Office Location: Temple, London - hybrid working environment (3 days in office per week)

Experience Level: +5 years commercial software engineering experience

About Investa

Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that. Investa is the first FCA-regulated platform to offer completely free US share trading with no FX, no commission, and no other fees.

Our Traction So Far:

  • £3.5M+ raised in funding with 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision

  • FCA-regulated and multi-award winning in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) & Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN)

  • Available on iOS and Android, scaling rapidly toward our next milestones of 10,000 and 100,000 active users

  • 8,000+ trades processed, 2,500+ early supporters rewarded, and 150+ 5-star reviews

Our Mission: To democratise options trading for UK investors

Our Vision: Think Options, Think Investa

We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

We are growing and looking for ambitious talent to help us democratise retail investing across the UK.

The Role

The Investa app was installed over 1,000 times within the first 24 hours of our priority access launch and we’re now looking for a high-impact Senior Software Engineer to join our founding engineering team as we scale.

You will have extensive commercial experience designing, building and maintaining systems used in critical services or those handling significant volumes of activity.

 

You will play a crucial role in building key parts of our platform and apps, ensuring the robustness, scalability, and security of our systems.

 

If you’re passionate about building best-in-class products to tackle complex challenges and you excel in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

 

What the role involves

  • Founding Team Ownership: Designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable services by joining our founding team of 4 engineers. Working directly with the founders with zero middle-management red tape, you won’t just pull tickets from a backlog - you will actually own your work end-to-end, see your code ship, and see its immediate impact on users.

  • Building the Engineering Culture: Joining our founding engineering team means you are actively building our engineering culture, not just stepping into one. You will have a direct voice in shaping how we collaborate day-to-day, how we learn from each other, and how we preserve a friendly, agile, and tight-knit environment as we grow.

  • Full-Stack Versatility & Growth: Hands-on Building: Writing high-quality, secure code for our FCA-regulated platform. You’ll navigate our stack to ship features that delight users. Driven by our fast-paced environment, you will have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone and get hands-on with the wider technical stack, levelling up your skills significantly faster than in a traditional, highly specialised role.

  • System Design & Architectural Influence: Partnering directly with the CEO and Principal Engineers to tackle complex systems design and actively shape our evolving architecture. Your technical perspective will give you a strong voice in our high-level design choices. You will have true design ownership over the specific services and systems you build, ensuring they remain robust, secure, and performant as we scale.

  • Technical Excellence: Maintaining a high bar for code quality, testing, and documentation. You’ll participate in (and drive) meaningful code reviews.

  • System Integrity: Monitoring and improving system reliability, ensuring our trading platform is always "always-on."

  • Production Support: Root-causing real-time production issues; we all take pride in the stability of what we ship.

Your Background

  • Coding: You are a "doer." You love shipping code, crave the responsibility that comes with joining a founding team, and are comfortable driving tricky engineering problems forward with high autonomy and support from the team.

  • Adaptable & Impact-Driven: Technical Depth: You have +5 years experience in software engineering, specifically building and maintaining production-grade distributed systems. You are a flexible engineer who is excited to jump in wherever the business actually needs you most to solve interesting problems across the board. You are proficient in at least one or two modern languages (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, etc.) and have experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Pragmatic Mindset: You balance structural integrity with contextual relevance, ensuring we don't just build the "perfect" system, but the right system for our current needs.

  • Collaborative Spirit: You enjoy working in a tight-knit team, giving/receiving candid feedback, and contributing to a culture of shared learning.

  • First-Principles Thinker: You don’t just follow patterns; you understand why they exist. You can pick up new technologies or domains (like complex options Greeks) quickly, and you welcome a setup that actively forces you to grow into a much more versatile engineer.

On-call

  • All engineers at Investa are involved in providing support for our products. This involves responding to events outside of working hours and is a core part of the role of all engineers.

What we offer:

Career Ownership & Impact: While we provide clear levels to grow into, you also have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.

Collaboration & Proximity: You’ll work directly alongside our Co-Founders, Alec and Ross, and our founding engineers to co-author both the product roadmap and our engineering architecture. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a direct voice in how we solve deep technical issues as we scale.

Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company EMI equity. Our success is your success.

The Package and Perks: Competitive base salaries, private medical insurance, team socials chosen by you, milestone celebrations, and hybrid flexibility.

Compensation and Benefits

Financial Growth 💸

  • Base Salary: £85,000 – £105,000 per annum, commensurate with experience.

  • Equity: Initial grant of 0.1% - 0.25% in stock options. We reward impact with additional performance-based grants and milestone-linked top-ups.

  • Annual Review: Structured salary and performance reviews conducted every year to ensure your growth stays on track.

Health & Wellbeing 🌴🦷

  • Annual Leave: 30 days (including bank holidays) + your birthday off.

  • Premium Coverage: Private medical and dental insurance via Bupa.

Office Environment & Lifestyle ☕

  • The Office: Work from a vibrant, spacious office featuring a private gym and a rooftop terrace for fresh-air breaks.

  • Fuel & Socials: Enjoy tea, coffee and snacks daily. Every last Wednesday of the month, we host a Team Lunch where the menu is chosen by you. We also run regular team socials, alongside company and individual milestone celebrations.

Tech 💻

  • Custom Setup: You’ll receive a high-spec MacBook Pro and £150 toward a mouse and keyboard of your choice.

Interview Process

  • Stage 1: Screening with Talent Lead

  • Stage 2: Technical & Architectural Deep Dive

  • Stage 3: Coding/Systems Design Interview

  • Stage 4: Final Behavioural interview

  • Offer

Looking at both our Senior and Mid-Level roles?

Please choose the single position that best matches your current experience and apply once. Our hiring team cross-reviews all engineering applications, so if the other level turns out to be a better fit, we’ll automatically switch your application.

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Du willst Software bauen, die echte Menschen jeden Tag nutzen und nicht das zwölfte Ticket in einem Konzern abarbeiten?

Dann komm zu Matelify.

Wir sind ein Startup aus Rödental bei Coburg. Mit Matelify helfen wir Unternehmen, auf Social Media nicht nur zu posten, sondern es zu verstehen. Herzstück sind unsere Mates: fünf KI-Agenten: Cleo erstellt Content, Finn plant, Nova denkt Strategie, Alex analysiert, Max kümmert sich um die Community. Sie arbeiten im Chat live zusammen und beraten sich gegenseitig. Diese Zusammenarbeit ist das Produkt.

Jetzt suchen wir dich als Software Engineer in Vollzeit. Jemanden, der Features von der Idee bis in Produktion trägt.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du baust Features end-to-end: Datenmodell, API, Oberfläche, Deployment, Messung. Kein Weiterreichen über drei Teams.

  • Du entwickelst unsere KI-Agenten weiter: von Tools und Prompts bis hin zu Orchestrierung und Evaluation. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Mates immer smarter, zuverlässiger und besser im Zusammenspiel werden.

  • Du arbeitest in einer echten Cloud-Architektur: Go-Services auf AWS, serverless, Infrastruktur als Code.

  • Du schaust nach dem Release auf die Daten: Wird das Feature genutzt? Wo steigen Leute aus? Und baust danach weiter.

  • Du gestaltest nicht nur mit, wie wir etwas entwickeln, sondern auch, was wir bauen. Dabei bringst du eigene Ideen ein und tauschst dich direkt mit unseren Kunden aus, um ihre Bedürfnisse besser zu verstehen.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Plattform kontinuierlich weiter mit automatisierten Tests, CI/CD und Observability. Dabei sorgst du für sauberen Code, stabile Prozesse und eine Architektur, die mit uns wächst.

Kurz gesagt: Du bist kein Ressourcen-Slot im Sprint, sondern baust das Produkt mit.

Unser Stack

  • Frontend: TypeScript, React

  • Backend: Go-Microservices auf AWS, MongoDB, Python

  • Infra & Ops: Terraform, GitLab, CI/CD

Du musst nicht alles davon kennen. Aber du solltest Lust haben, dich in jeden Teil einzuarbeiten.

Wie wir arbeiten

KI ist bei uns Werkzeug, kein Buzzword. Wir entwickeln selbst mit KI-Coding-Agents im Alltag und erwarten, dass du damit souverän umgehst. Schnell sein ist gut. Verstehen, was da generiert wurde, ist Pflicht.

Ownership statt Zuständigkeit. Wer etwas baut, kümmert sich auch darum, dass es läuft.

Kurze Wege. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Founder-Team. Entscheidungen dauern Minuten, nicht Wochen.

Shippen schlägt Perfektion, aber mit Tests, Code-Review und grüner Pipeline.

Hybrid & flexibel: Du entscheidest, wo du am produktivsten arbeitest, von zu Hause oder gemeinsam mit dem Team in Rödental.

Was du mitbringst

Studium, Ausbildung, Quereinstieg, egal was, es ist uns egal. Uns interessiert, ob du Software verstehst, Bock hast und zeigen kannst, was du draufhast. Wichtig ist uns:

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre echte Praxis in der Softwareentwicklung: ob im Job, in eigenen Projekten oder Open Source und hast Features eigenständig in Produktion gebracht und danach betreut.

  • Du bist sehr sicher in TypeScript und/oder Go und arbeitest dich schnell in den jeweils anderen Teil ein.

  • Du triffst Architekturentscheidungen selbst, kannst sie begründen und weißt, wann „gut genug“ wirklich gut genug ist.

  • Du verstehst, wie Web-Apps funktionieren: APIs, Datenbanken, Auth, Deployments.

  • Du hast mit LLMs oder Agenten schon mehr gemacht als einen Chatbot gefragt oder brennst darauf, genau das zu tun.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und sprichst sehr gut Deutsch und Englisch, mündlich wie schriftlich.

Ein Plus, kein Muss: AWS/Serverless, Terraform, MongoDB, Produktanalytics, Erfahrung in einem frühen Startup.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Echte Produktverantwortung in einem wachsenden KI-Produkt

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Founder-/CEO-Team

  • Moderner Stack und Raum, ihn mitzuprägen

  • Ein kleines, motiviertes Team ohne Politik und Meeting-Marathons

  • Viel Raum für eigene Ideen: die beste Idee gewinnt, nicht die lauteste

  • Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns:

  • deinen Lebenslauf oder ein gepflegtes LinkedIn-Profil

  • einen Link zu etwas, das du gebaut hast (GitHub, GitLab, Projekt, Demo)

Kein Anschreiben, keine Zeugnisse, kein Notenschnitt. Uns interessiert, wie du denkst und was du gebaut hast.

Unser Prozess: kurzes Kennenlernen → technisches Gespräch über echten Code statt Leetcode-Rätsel → persönliches Kennenlernen mit dem Team vor Ort in Rödental.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!
