title: Software Engineering Internship - London
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara interns dive into challenging, real-world projects with the same freedom and responsibility as our full-time engineers. You won't just be learning; you'll be building and making a tangible impact on our global customers from day one. You'll join a team working at a scale few engineers encounter early in their careers: millions of IoT devices deployed globally, petabytes of real-time data, and software that directly affects the safety of people doing some of the most essential work in the world. You'll be paired with an Engineering mentor, get rare exposure to customers, and have visibility to engineering leadership throughout your internship. You'll also have access to the latest AI tools, with generous token allotments, giving you the leverage to ship more and learn faster.

At Samsara, interns can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, an intern may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, an intern could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments.

Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged.

You should apply if…

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.
  • You want to build for scale. You'll work on technology that powers physical operations at a scale most engineers never experience.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Our engineers are deeply invested in our customers and the daily problems they face. They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with success and product teams, and use metrics to ensure your work translates into real outcomes.
  • You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.
  • You're drawn to hard problems and own them end to end. You dig into complexity, research it thoroughly, and find the simplest solution that works - then see it through, holding yourself to a high standard along the way.
  • You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.
  • You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Currently in your penultimate year of study (or second-to-last year of an integrated Master's / MEng), on track to complete a Bachelor's or integrated Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, or Data Science, with expected graduation no earlier than Summer 2028.
  • This internship is hybrid: 3 days per week in our London office.
  • This internship is a full-time, paid experience — interns are expected not to be enrolled in school or university full-time while working at Samsara.

In your application

  • Include your CV / résumé.
  • Answer all of the application questions.
  • We're reviewing applications on a rolling basis, and we expect to finalize our cohort by late November/early December. Applications will close October 30th at 6:00pm (UK). Please do not email us to inquire about the status of your application.

We know that applying for internships can be time-consuming, and we truly appreciate your effort. We're looking forward to learning more about you through your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

title: Software Engineering Manager (Hands-On, Frontend)
descriptionHtml:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team - from Finance to HR - to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake or Siemens, use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario. With a team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software. At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

We're hiring an Engineering Manager who wants to spend 80% of their time writing code, not attending management meetings.

About the role

Are you an experienced Software Engineer who loves writing code, solving complex technical problems and helping other engineers become better at what they do?

At Pigment, our Engineering Managers are engineers first.

Unlike traditional Engineering Manager positions, this role is designed for someone who wants to remain deeply involved in building software while taking on meaningful people-management responsibilities.

You'll spend approximately 80% of your time designing, coding and shipping production features, with the remaining 20% dedicated to coaching engineers, running regular 1:1s, providing feedback and supporting their development.

We're particularly interested in Senior Software Engineers who have naturally taken on coaching, mentoring or technical leadership responsibilities and are ready to develop further as people managers.

You don't necessarily need to have held an Engineering Manager title before. What matters most is your technical ability, your experience helping others grow and your motivation to combine engineering with people leadership.

You'll join Pigment's Reporting & Collaboration community, building sophisticated frontend experiences that help customers interact with complex data, configure workflows and make better business decisions.


What you'll do

🧑‍💻 Software Engineering (80%)

You'll remain an active contributor to our production codebase, working alongside other engineers on challenging frontend projects.

  • Write, review, refactor and ship production code regularly using React, TypeScript and JavaScript.

  • Design and build sophisticated user interfaces for interacting with large datasets, including filtering, visualisation and complex configuration.

  • Take ownership of engineering tasks and features from technical design through implementation, testing and deployment.

  • Solve challenging problems involving frontend performance, scalability, state management and user experience.

  • Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, debugging and architectural decisions.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Tech Leads and Software Engineers to deliver high-quality features.

  • Contribute to AI-powered product experiences and use modern development tools where appropriate.

  • Maintain the same technical expectations and engineering standards as our Senior Software Engineers.

    • You'll continue to write production code, not simply oversee the engineers who do.


    📚 Coaching & People Management (20%)

    Alongside your engineering responsibilities, you'll help other engineers develop their skills, confidence and careers.

    • Coach and mentor engineers, sharing technical knowledge and helping them improve their problem-solving abilities.

    • Hold regular 1:1 meetings with your direct reports to discuss progress, challenges and career development.

    • Provide constructive feedback, recognise achievements and support individual development plans.

    • Help engineers establish clear goals and understand the skills required to progress.

    • Support performance reviews and development discussions, including more challenging conversations when necessary.

    • Work alongside Tech Leads to understand engineers' technical contributions and development needs.

    • Help foster a collaborative engineering culture where people continuously learn from one another.

      • At Pigment, technical leadership and people management are intentionally separated. Tech Leads own the technical direction of teams, while Engineering Managers focus on coaching and developing engineers alongside their own coding responsibilities.

      You'll initially focus on contributing as a Senior Engineer before gradually taking on direct reports.


Who we're looking for

You're an engineer first, with a genuine interest in developing people.

  • You have substantial professional software-engineering experience and are technically operating at a strong Senior Engineer level.

  • You're currently hands-on with production code and want coding to remain the majority of your working week.

  • You have strong frontend development experience with React, TypeScript and JavaScript.

  • You've built complex, scalable applications, ideally within B2B SaaS, enterprise software, analytics or data-intensive environments.

  • You have experience coaching, mentoring or supporting other engineers through code reviews, pairing, technical discussions or structured feedback.

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping other engineers improve.

  • You're interested in taking ownership of 1:1s, career development and people-management responsibilities, or already have experience doing so.

  • You're comfortable solving complex technical challenges independently while collaborating with others.

  • You care about product quality, engineering standards and delivering meaningful value to customers.

  • You're fluent in English. French is not required.

    • Previous formal people-management experience is a plus, but not a requirement. We're equally interested in strong Senior Engineers who have demonstrated the ability to coach others and are ready to take the next step.


Our interview process

Because Engineering Managers at Pigment spend approximately 80% of their time coding, they go through the same core technical assessments as our Software Engineers.

We want you to understand these expectations from the beginning.

1️⃣ Technical Screen

A technical discussion including a 15-minute code refactoring exercise.

AI assistance is not permitted during the refactoring exercise.

2️⃣ Live Coding

A hands-on algorithmic coding interview focused on problem-solving, code quality and technical reasoning.

AI assistance is not permitted.

3️⃣ System Design

A discussion exploring your approach to designing software systems, evaluating technical trade-offs and solving complex engineering problems.

4️⃣ Final Interview with the EML (Engineering Manager Lead)

A conversation exploring your motivation, engineering mindset, approach to coaching and alignment with Pigment's culture and expectations.

Important: Our Engineering Managers are assessed against the same senior technical engineering standards as our Software Engineers. This is a role for people who genuinely enjoy coding and want to keep doing it.


Is this role right for you?

You'll probably love this role if:

  • You enjoy writing code more than spending your day in management meetings.

  • You're a strong Senior Engineer who wants to help others grow.

  • You want to develop people-management skills without moving away from engineering.

  • You enjoy the challenge of balancing meaningful individual contributions with coaching responsibilities.

    • This probably isn't the right role if:

    • You're looking to move away from hands-on software development.

    • You prefer managing delivery, budgets and team strategy over building software.

    • You haven't written production code regularly for some time.

    • You're looking for a traditional Engineering Manager position where engineering work is mainly delegated to others.

      • At Pigment, you don't have to choose between being an excellent engineer and helping other engineers grow.


What you will get
  • Competitive salary
  • Equity
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue is entirely free for you and your family 💙
  • Trust and flexible working hours
  • Brand new offices in the heart of Paris, London, New York, and, Toronto

You will work closely with RF Engineering at the intersection of software, hardware, and real-world RF, helping turn technical evidence into confident product decisions.

Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel, Germany office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor software from design through release, adding rigor through regression, integration, and real-world validation.
  • Design and own test strategies spanning feature, regression, integration / interface, system, and field validation. Combine automated coverage with targeted manual validation based on risk and technical feasibility.
  • Develop in-depth functional tests for individual components of the RF sensor software, and keep those tests maintainable as the product evolves.
  • Reproduce, isolate, and characterize issues on real sensor hardware and in test environments; capture clear reproduction steps, logs, and environment details.
  • Build and maintain hardware-backed automated regression tests and supporting test tooling.
  • Monitor and improve development and test systems and test hardware so environments stay stable, observable, and ready for daily use.
  • Partner closely with RF Engineering and independently verify behavior in realistic environments and across system interfaces. Execute system, release, field, and acceptance testing with release stakeholders.
  • Document test results and defects clearly, and contribute to software design reviews and after-action reviews for the work you own.
  • Share knowledge with the wider team, give actionable feedback, and support newer engineers and interns through pairing, reviews, and onboarding.
  • Use approved agentic AI tools regularly to design tests, analyze results, and draft documentation and review AI output against quality, security, and performance standards before you rely on it.

What You Bring

  • A degree or vocational qualification in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded systems, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience testing software that runs on or with hardware (embedded products, devices, sensors, or similar systems), including independently owning the test and quality approach for that work.
  • Experience with RF, embedded, sensor, or similarly hardware-integrated systems, with the technical aptitude and curiosity to develop deep expertise in RF sensor technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests or test tooling, ideally in Python pytest, with the ability to independently support hardware-backed regression testing.
  • Comfort working in Linux-based systems (SSH, Networking).
  • A collaborative, quality-focused working style: you Join Forces with others, Own It on the quality of the work you take on, and speak up with candor when something is unclear or broken.
  • It’s a plus if you have experience with drones or hardware-in-the-loop / continuous integration test setups and an interest in supporting others as they grow.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

This role requires a broad, multi-disciplinary architecture background, with the ability to work across multiple technology domains rather than specialising in a single area. You'll provide architectural leadership across cloud, infrastructure, workplace technologies, networking and security, helping to shape both current delivery and future technology direction.

Responsibilities:

  • Report to the System Design Authority and support architectural governance activities.
  • Define solution architectures and technical designs that meet business requirements within agreed cost, time and technical constraints.
  • Support the development and evolution of technology standards, strategies and roadmaps across workplace and enterprise technology portfolios.
  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to programme and engineering teams throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Work closely with internal and external technology suppliers, ensuring technical governance and delivery expectations are met.
  • Ensure security principles are embedded into solution designs and support ongoing security improvement and remediation activities.
  • Maintain knowledge of current technologies, industry trends and emerging architectural practices to inform future business strategy.
  • Collaborate with the wider architecture community to promote consistency, best practice and architectural integrity across programmes.

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience designing and delivering solutions within modern hybrid cloud environments.
  • Strong knowledge of hosting and workplace technologies, including Microsoft 365, Azure and AWS.
  • Experience delivering cyber-secure solutions and applying secure-by-design principles.
  • Proven experience in systems engineering, network design and technology delivery.
  • Strong understanding of recognised architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, MODAF or Zachman.
  • Experience operating across multiple technology domains, including cloud, infrastructure, networking, workplace technologies and security.

We're seeking a versatile architect who can comfortably operate across a broad technology landscape. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills, enabling them to translate complex concepts into practical solutions and influence stakeholders at all levels.

title: Solutions Architect – Digital Sovereignty
descriptionHtml:
FEQ128R99

Location: Germany (remote or from a Databricks office – anywhere in Germany) Languages: Fluent German and business-level English

At Databricks, we build the platform that makes data and AI usable across an entire organization. More and more of our customers in Germany – public sector, critical infrastructure (KRITIS), financial services, healthcare, defence and industry – need to keep control over where their data lives and who can access it. They want the full power of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform without giving up data residency, jurisdictional control or the option to switch providers.

As a Solutions Architect for Digital Sovereignty, you are the technical lead for this motion in Germany. You design sovereign data and AI architectures with customers, run proofs of concept end to end, and help our sovereign cloud partners and account teams turn a proven pattern into production workloads.

The impact you will have

  • Act as the trusted technical advisor on digital sovereignty for strategic and regulated customers across Germany, from the first conversation with the CIO/CISO through to production.
  • Design and validate sovereign reference architectures
  • Run complex proofs of concept and pilots – performance, scalability, security and network connectivity tests with different data volumes – and translate the results into clear go/no-go recommendations.
  • Work hand in hand with sovereign cloud and storage partners: joint solution design, enablement of partner technical teams, co-selling and joint customer workshops.
  • Position Databricks clearly in the sovereignty discussion – CLOUD Act, GDPR, NIS2, DORA, BSI C5, EU Data Act, open formats and exit strategies – and articulate how our open architecture reduces lock-in compared with competing approaches.
  • Feed field requirements back to Databricks Product and Engineering, and collaborate with Legal, Security and Compliance on customer questions.
  • Build repeatable assets: reference architectures, demos, PoC playbooks, Terraform/automation templates and customer-facing collateral in German and English.
  • Build Databricks' visibility on sovereignty in the German market through workshops, meetups, webinars and conference talks.
  • Turn customer conversations into working prototypes fast, using AI-assisted development to build demos in hours rather than weeks.

What we look for

  • Fluent German and business-level English. Both are used daily with customers, partners and internally.
  • Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solution architecture or consulting, including complex enterprise customer interactions across the full sales lifecycle.
  • Hands-on experience with data platforms in at least one major public cloud (Azure, AWS or GCP), ideally including Apache Spark and/or Databricks.
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure: networking (private connectivity, VPN, private endpoints), identity and access management, encryption and key management (BYOK/HYOK).
  • Experience with object storage and open table formats (S3-compatible storage such as MinIO, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg) and with secure data sharing patterns.
  • Good working knowledge of the regulatory and sovereignty landscape in Germany and the EU (e.g. GDPR, CLOUD Act implications, NIS2, DORA, BSI C5, KRITIS) and the ability to discuss it confidently with CISOs, data protection officers and procurement.
  • Ability to drive technical and business conversations with C-level executives, orchestrate cross-functional and partner teams, and influence outcomes toward long-term customer success.
  • Hands-on coding ability in Python and SQL; infrastructure-as-code experience (e.g. Terraform) is a plus.
  • Daily, fluent use of AI tools in your own work. Coding assistants and agents are part of how you operate, not something you try out occasionally.
  • Able to vibe-code a demo: assemble a credible, working prototype for a specific customer problem with AI assistance, and recognize where the output still needs your own judgment.
  • Experience working with or for European / sovereign cloud providers, public sector or regulated industries is a strong plus.
  • Judgment to prioritize the right use cases and investments, and to navigate a competitive landscape.
  • Willingness to travel within Germany for customer and partner meetings.

Why this role

  • You will shape a new, strategically important motion for Databricks in Germany and EMEA – building on a proof of concept that has already delivered results.
  • You will work at the intersection of data and AI, cloud infrastructure, regulation and partnerships.
  • You will collaborate closely with Field Engineering leadership, Product, and our partner ecosystem.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Solutions Architects are good listeners and respected thought leaders that help guide large projects and teams to success outcomes and your efforts will be directly visible in customers' ability to make global change actionable.

title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, DACH
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

  • Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

  • Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

  • Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

  • Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

title: Solutions Engineer - Sr.
descriptionHtml:
About OpenTable: 

With millions of diners,70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

We are seeking an experienced Senior Solutions Engineer to lead complex API integrations and high-impact technical engagements across our partner and restaurant ecosystem. This role independently owns sophisticated implementations, partners cross-functionally to drive successful outcomes, and helps establish strong technical and operational standards across Solutions Engineering.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience with APIs and system integrations, thrives in ambiguous and technically complex environments, and can confidently drive initiatives from technical discovery through implementation and launch. They use strong technical judgment to navigate tradeoffs, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and influence scalable improvements across our integrations and developer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead complex API integrations and technical initiatives from discovery and solution design through implementation and launch.
  • Independently own complex, quarter-length technical projects and high-impact partner implementations, establishing clear milestones, dependencies, and delivery expectations.
  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for sophisticated partners, restaurant groups, and strategic initiatives.
  • Translate business and partner requirements into clear technical approaches, balancing implementation complexity, scalability, reliability, and partner needs.
  • Diagnose and resolve sophisticated API and integration challenges using logs, API requests and responses, authentication flows, and system behavior.
  • Navigate ambiguous technical problems by identifying assumptions, evaluating tradeoffs, and driving decisions toward resolution.
  • Proactively identify technical risks, dependencies, and implementation gaps and partner with stakeholders to develop mitigation plans.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to clarify scope, investigate technical challenges, and identify appropriate short and long-term solutions.
  • Communicate changes to delivery expectations, blockers, and technical risks early and clearly.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex technical issues and implementations.
  • Build and maintain deep expertise across our off-the-shelf APIs, integrations, and broader technical ecosystem.
  • Ensure Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and implementation commitments are met while balancing multiple high-priority initiatives.
  • Partner with Security teams to ensure integrations follow established security and compliance standards and proactively identify potential risks.
  • Work closely with Sales, Partnerships, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to connect technical decisions and tradeoffs to business outcomes.
  • Develop scalable troubleshooting approaches, implementation patterns, and technical guardrails that improve consistency and quality.
  • Partner with Engineering domain owners during complex incidents and technical investigations, using available logs and observability tools to drive resolution and identify opportunities to prevent recurring issues.
  • Develop scalable troubleshooting guides, implementation playbooks, and technical resources that improve partner self-service.
  • Identify and raise product improvement opportunities based on technical patterns, implementation challenges, and partner feedback.

Minimum Qualifications

  • You have significant experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, Integration Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • You have deep experience working with REST APIs, JSON payloads, authentication methods, webhooks, and system integrations.
  • You are experienced in reviewing logs, debugging API requests and responses, and diagnosing complex integration issues.
  • You have successfully led complex technical implementations from discovery through production launch.
  • You are comfortable owning complex, quarter-length initiatives and driving work forward across multiple stakeholders.
  • You can navigate ambiguity, proactively identify risks and dependencies, and drive technical decisions toward resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You have excellent communication skills and can translate complex technical concepts and tradeoffs for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You have experience partnering with Engineering and Product teams to investigate technical challenges and deliver scalable solutions.
  • You can balance multiple complex projects and priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.
  • You demonstrate strong technical judgment and know when to independently drive a solution and when to engage additional expertise.
  • You contribute technical knowledge and expertise in ways that improve the effectiveness of those around you.
  • Experience in restaurant technology, hospitality technology, SaaS platforms, or system integrations is a plus.

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Generous paid parental leave, vacation & time off for your birthday
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts inc. Bike2Work, Season ticket loan
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Income protection and life assurance
  • Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice
  • Pension plan contributions
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Social events & Thursday happy hours
  • Free lunch 2 days per week

The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

title: Specialist Solutions Architect, Fraud & Risk
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.

Stripe Radar is Stripe's fully integrated fraud and risk management platform. The Radar team's mission is to evolve from a best-in-class payment fraud product into a unified risk intelligence platform that protects businesses from all forms of financial loss—from sophisticated payment fraud and account takeovers to first-party misuse and policy abuse. With Radar, businesses can confidently navigate the evolving fraud landscape, accept more good revenue, and focus on growth.

What you’ll do

You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities. You will serve as the domain and product expert to our users and GTM team for Stripe Radar globally.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Radar product suite to accelerate opportunities globally
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of trends in the fraud and risk management ecosystem, including AI-powered detection, processor-agnostic architectures, and the shift from payment fraud to holistic business risk (policy abuse, account takeover, first-party misuse)
  • Develop expertise with the functional and architectural patterns for deploying advanced fraud systems, including the lifecycle of rule management, ML model tuning, and manual review optimization
  • Understand the ecosystem of risk and identity integrations (device fingerprinting, identity verification, bot mitigation, case management) Stripe must support for users to be successful
  • Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
  • Create reference architectures to uplevel the team and refine reference solutions based on product enhancements and customer feedback
  • Partner closely with the Radar product sales team on Stripe's largest and most complex Radar opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
  • Partner closely with the Radar product team to get early exposure to new products and features
  • Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization, providing actionable insights on the competitive landscape and emerging fraud vectors
  • Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
  • Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
  • Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in a pre-sales, technical consulting, product, or risk strategy role focused on e-commerce fraud prevention, risk management, or trust and safety
  • Deep working knowledge of the fraud and risk ecosystem, including payment fraud (CNP), account takeover (ATO), first-party misuse (friendly fraud), and policy/content abuse
  • Demonstrated knowledge of risk management architectures, including the role of rules engines, machine learning models, and manual review queues in fraud decisioning
  • Strong knowledge of the signals and data used in fraud detection: device/IP data, behavioral biometrics, identity verification, and graph-based analysis
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering and architecture patterns, with the ability to understand how a wide variety of technologies and systems interact
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, comfortable explaining complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating Stripe or other RESTful APIs into web applications
  • Experience with processor-agnostic fraud solutions and multi-processor payment environments
  • Experience with risk management for platforms/marketplaces, subscription services, and digital goods
  • Familiarity with liability shift programs (chargeback guarantees) and value-based pricing models for risk products
  • Understanding of how to extend fraud protection across the payment lifecycle—payouts (Issuing), in-person (Terminal), or recurring (Billing)
  • Experience as a subject matter expert in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

title: Spécialiste Support Comptable (Télétravail complet possible depuis Nantes)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

🤝 Process de recrutement

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

title: Sr Manager Quality Assurance
descriptionHtml:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

At Hasbro, play is at the heart of everything we do, and so is making sure that play is safe. 

We are looking for an experienced quality, regulatory and compliance leader to head our EMEA team, driving product safety and technical compliance across Hasbro and licensed product. You will lead a specialist QA team, act as Hasbro's technical voice in the industry bodies that shape toy regulation, and partner with global stakeholders to ensure our products meet the highest safety standards in every market they reach. 

You will join a global QA team that is every bit as passionate about safety as we are about having fun. If you want to make a measurable impact on an iconic brand portfolio, we would like to hear from you. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Represent Hasbro in industry and standardization bodies including TIE, TA, ATPA, BTHA, FJP, AFNOR, CEN and ISO, shaping proportionate regulation and standards for the company and the wider toy industry. 
  • Lead and develop the EMEA QA team, setting technical direction and providing authoritative interpretation of regulatory and licensing requirements. 
  • Monitor regulatory change across EMEA, assess business exposure, and lead engagement with industry associations to mitigate impact. 
  • Own the Regulatory Change Management Process for the region, ensuring new requirements are implemented on time and verified. 
  • Develop compliance strategies for complex markets, notably distributor territories and the GCC region including Saudi Arabia, and equip local teams to meet their national requirements. 
  • Partner with global QA licensing and EMEA licensing leadership to define, communicate and operate licensing compliance processes. 
  • Support global development teams on new product lines: research applicable requirements and translate them into product specifications and certification programs. 
  • Act as escalation point for market surveillance authorities and consumer safety complaints, applying balanced, ethical judgment where compliance and commercial pressures meet. 

What will you bring 

  • 8+ years in product regulatory or compliance, including experience leading or mentoring across multiple markets. 
  • Deep working knowledge of toy safety standards and legislation worldwide. 
  • Command of EMEA and global regulation affecting Hasbro and licensed product, including REACH, the General Product Safety Regulation and the wider framework. 
  • Working knowledge of requirements beyond the toy scope, covering 14+ product, adult collectibles and games, where the General Product Safety Regulation and related standards apply rather than toy safety legislation. 
  • Proven experience leading a Regulatory Change Management process end to end. 
  • Practical grounding in consumer product safety testing requirements. 
  • Understanding of children's play patterns and how they interact with toys and games. 
  • Experience representing a business with trade associations, regulators and market surveillance authorities. 
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and influence across a global, multicultural team. 
  • Fluent English; additional European languages an advantage. 
  • Navigate tight deadlines, shifting regulation and ambiguity with a positive mindset, a focus on solutions and a sense of humor. 
  • Thrive in an environment of continuous improvement and learning. 

We are an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer 

Hasbro is committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment. We are committed to making all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, or any other legally protected status. 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you have a disability and require assistance in this application process and need to request an accommodation, please contact your recruiter or coordinator. 

Employees may be eligible for annual and long-term incentives as part of their overall compensation package, depending on role, location, and eligibility. Benefits and programs may include:

  • Health & Wellness
  • Time Off to Recharge
  • Financial Well-being
  • Life & Family Support
  • Volunteer and Community Initiatives
  • Learning & Development 
  • Exclusive Perks

Please review our Applicant Privacy Notice to learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information in connection with the application process.

title: Sr. Medical Director, Germany
descriptionHtml:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals   Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

Position Summary

The Sr. Medical Director, Germany will lead the development and execution of the local medical affairs strategy together with the field Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) and in line with the European Medical Affairs strategy and the local country strategy for RETT syndrome including the integrated medical plans with full medical budget ownership and responsibility. Responsibilities will include building and maintaining external stakeholder relationships and collaborations, as well as continuing to position Acadia as a thought leader and valued partner with patient advocacy groups (PAG) and medical/scientific RETT community in Germany. This individual will be responsible for the effectiveness and compliance of scientific exchange conducted to meet the needs of clinicians, patient advocates, and other key external and internal stakeholders.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide scientific and medical leadership, including development of strategic country medical affairs (post-launch) plans, identifying specific unmet medical needs, and data gaps.
  • Leading the local medical affairs team.
  • Ensure strong medical/scientific leadership in coordination and participation in country MRC/MLR procedures.
  • Establish appropriate strategic partnerships with Centers of Excellence, KOLs, and PAGs, in areas of scientific interest.
  • Ensure aligned and close cross-functional collaboration, with country GM, Market Access, other relevant country and international staff to optimally manage relationships and ensure alignment and effective execution of the German medical strategy.
  • Coordinate and ensure operational medical excellence, in collaboration with EU medical teams and aligned with country strategy, to capture and track key medical tactics and medical (post-launch) activities in Germany.
  • Provide medical expertise and editorial support in data dissemination at conferences and in medical journals, as appropriate.
  • Involvement with key HCPs in the exchange of scientific and medical information including Advisory Boards and presentations at national meetings and conferences.
  • Develop and maintain, together with MSLs, close professional relationships with KOLs and emerging scientific leaders in the community.
  • Oversee gathering and reporting field medical insights through existing Veeva CRM system and in line with company rules and requirements.
  • Oversee and communicate to cross-functional stakeholders the insights the MSL team gains about competitive landscape, unmet needs of physicians and advocacy groups. Develops potential actionable plans to address these local insights.
  • Manages publication activities, including review and approval of abstracts and manuscripts, local publication strategy and real-world evidence development and compliant collaboration with authors, as needed.

Education/Experience/Skills

  • MD highly preferred; PhD, PharmD, or an equivalent qualification may also be considered.
  • 15+ years of Medical Affairs leadership experience in the biopharmaceutical industry in Germany or the DACH region; broader regional experience is advantageous.
  • Prior team-management experience is required.
  • Substantial rare-disease—preferably neurological—experience in Germany and/or the DACH region.
  • Extensive knowledge of the German healthcare system and applicable national rules and regulations.
  • Significant experience coordinating and participating in national MLR/MRC procedures.
  • Experience engaging with rare-disease patient advocacy groups is highly preferred.

Key Skills

  • Extensive knowledge to critically appraise studies and clinical evidence to allow engagement on higher scientific level with HCPs.
  • In depth understanding of compliance and regulatory requirements, including extensive personal experience and expertise with MRC/MLR procedures, for pharmaceutical Medical Affairs, R&D and Commercial activities in Germany.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills, and experience in the delivery of scientific presentations.
  • Agile, independent and proactive working style.
  • Personal sense of purpose, confidence, and stand fest in challenging situations.
  • Ability to build strong cross-functional and cross-company relationships.
  • Ability to collaborate and share information to contribute to the planning process and execute the agreed local Medical (pre)launch plan, together with MSL team, and in line with Regional Medical Affairs strategy.
  • Fluency in German at native or near-native level and strong English proficiency are required, with the ability to communicate complex details clearly.
  • Ability to travel both locally and internationally is required.

title: Sr. Product Designer
descriptionHtml:

Senior Product Designer

At Databricks, we design tools that make complex data and AI workflows intuitive and powerful. Our mission is to simplify how data is connected, understood, and activated so organizations can turn information into business outcomes. Designers at Databricks combine strong visual craft with systems thinking. They shape products used by some of the most advanced data teams in the world, and increasingly by the business users and AI agents working alongside them.

We're hiring Product Designers to join our design team and own design for an area of the Databricks Platform. Teams span the platform, from data engineering and analytics to databases, apps, and AI agents. We match each designer to the area where their skills and interests will have the most impact. You'll design for both technical and business users of data, making powerful capabilities feel clear, controllable, and trustworthy for enterprise customers.

The impact you will have

  • Own your area end to end. Sharpen the problem, set the design direction, and carry the work from framing and interaction models through visual polish and shipped detail.
  • Set the quality bar. Make the critical design decisions in your area, review work from designers, PM, engineering, and AI tools, and have the hands-on skill to improve it yourself.
  • Advocate with evidence. Stay in regular contact with customers, choose research methods that fit the decision, and turn research into insights others can act on.
  • Show the experience got better. Define what success looks like for the key tasks users need to get done, and show the improvement through usability testing, research, and how people actually use what shipped.
  • Influence through the work. Move product and engineering decisions with prototypes, keep design reviews focused, and communicate clearly in writing and in person.
  • Prototype to explore and align. Use interactive prototypes as a primary thinking tool to explore ambiguous problems, reduce risk, and align the team on a direction.
  • Design directly in the codebase with coding agents. Use AI coding agents to ship well-scoped design changes alongside engineers, rather than handing off static mocks.
  • Define reusable UX principles. Create interaction patterns and frameworks other teams reuse, and drive consistency through a strong, cross-platform design system.
  • Raise the level of critique. Give and invite high-quality feedback, and help make clear decisions together with product and engineering.

What we look for

  • 5+ years of product design work experience.
  • A bachelor's or master's degree in design, computer science, human-computer interaction, or a related field.
  • A portfolio demonstrating your end-to-end design process, from inception to production.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead large and complex design projects and balance the needs of diverse stakeholders.
  • A systems thinker who has the vision to design the big picture, and the tactical ability to break it down so that engineering can succeed in building it incrementally.
  • A deep understanding of business goals, customer needs, emerging AI capabilities, and the evolving data and technology landscape.
  • Self-directed and comfortable in ambiguity. You help shape product direction when the path isn't defined.
  • Beautiful visual and interaction work rooted in a data-driven, well-researched UX process.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing developer tools, data/analytics products, AI/ML products, or enterprise software.
  • Experience designing products that bridge the gap between technical and business users.
  • The strongest candidates have demonstrated experience using modern development and AI-assisted coding tools to prototype ideas, understand implementation tradeoffs, and collaborate deeply with engineering teams.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. title: Staff Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

 

Architecting the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

 

The Demand Core team and backend platform squads build the foundational infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure: downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. As a Staff Backend Developer, you will own the architectural integrity, reliability, and long-term evolution of the distributed systems that power these decisions 200 million times every day across multiple teams.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals like geo, fraud status, budget caps, to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. Beyond individual services, you will define architectural patterns across the entire ad interaction chain: high-throughput processing of clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer, and reward-triggering in-app events. You will govern our hybrid messaging architecture using SNS/SQS and Kafka, standardize backend data patterns across DynamoDB, relational, and analytical data stores, and ensure our core ad scoring pipelines remain resilient under massive load.

 

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

 

  • Production Golang Systems & Architecture Mastery: You bring extensive backend development experience (7+ years, with deep production Go expertise in distributed environments). You will define service boundaries, concurrency models, and runtime optimizations for our +99% Go microservice architecture, scaling the platform reliably beyond hundreds of millions of monthly active users.

  • High-Throughput Event Streaming & Architecture Patterns: You have deep experience architecting and standardizing asynchronous microservice communication using event backbones like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will establish org-wide streaming standards, schema evolution, and CDC patterns to process billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

  • Large-Scale Data Architecture & Platform Optimization: You understand database internals, distributed storage trade-offs, and low-level web standards. You will standardize data patterns (sharding, replication, DR) across hundreds of terabytes in DynamoDB, MySQL, Druid, and Athena, while leading high-stakes, zero-downtime database migrations and deprecations.

  • Data Science & Algorithmic Integration at Scale: You quickly grasp complex technical topics, distributed systems trade-offs, and applied mathematics. You will partner with our Data Science team to architect the runtime infrastructure that serves predictive models and machine learning algorithms directly within our sub-millisecond real-time ad targeting engine.

  • Technical Leadership & Organizational Leverage: You communicate fluently and precisely in spoken and written English. You drive alignment across squads through RFCs and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), define org-level SLIs/SLOs, sponsor major technical migrations, and mentor Senior engineers across an international engineering team.

  • Plus: Cloud Resilience & Tooling: Hands-on experience with continuous profiling (e.g., Pyroscope, goroutine dumps), chaos engineering drills, and infrastructure automation using Terraform, Kubernetes, or AWS cloud networking.
    ‌

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

 

What’s in It for You?

 

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re shaping the architectural foundation behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems and patterns you design will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

 

  • Go Big. Own the technical direction and platform architecture with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, establish golden paths that unlock engineering speed, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve complex architectural bottlenecks openly and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with and elevate a diverse, global team of engineers from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, solve hard computer science challenges, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.
